faq_logTimeReminders_q: WitnessWork ishobora kunyibutsa kwandika igihe cy'umunsi nateganyije?
faq_logTimeReminders_a: Yego. Jya kuri Amahitamo → Gahunda, ufungure Unyibutse kwandika igihe, maze uhitemo isaha ya Unyibutse saa (saa mbiri z'ijoro keretse uyihinduye). Niba umunsi ufite gahunda ariko nta gihe cyanditse, uhabwa urwibutso rumwe kuri iyo saa nyuma y'uko gahunda z'uwo munsi zirangira: gahunda ya mu gitondo ikwibutsa nimugoroba, naho gahunda igikomeje ku isaha wahisemo ikwibutsa bukeye. Gahunda nyinshi zo ku munsi umwe zitanga urwibutso rumwe, kandi iyo inyibutsa z'iminsi ibiri zigomba kuza icyarimwe, zihuzwa. Kwandika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose cy'uwo munsi bihagarika urwibutso rwawo kandi bikuraho urwo wari wamaze guhabwa; gukuraho gahunda z'uwo munsi cyangwa kuzimya iri genamiterere nabyo birabikora. Umunsi ufite gahunda idafite igihe ntukwibutsa, kandi iminsi wasibye mbere y'uko ufungura iri genamiterere ntirimo. Gukanda ku rwibutso bifungura Ongeraho igihe, itariki, igihe cyateganyijwe n'ubwoko byamaze kuzuzwa. Urwibutso kandi rugaragara mu nzogera ya Ahabanza mu cyumweru, nubwo amamenyesha ya sisitemu yaba azimye. Iri genamiterere rigaragara iyo wandika amasaha; Ababwiriza basanzwe babanza gufungura Andika amasaha yanjye. Kuyifungura bisaba uruhushya rw'amamenyesha, cyangwa bigufungurira igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe niba wari warabyanze. Inyibutsa zibarwa kuri telefoni yawe ukurikije gahunda zawe n'igihe cyawe, kandi ntizoherezwa ahandi. Buri gikoresho gitegura inyibutsa zacyo kugeza ku byumweru bibiri imbere, bityo fungura WitnessWork nibura buri byumweru bibiri kugira ngo zikomeze kuza. Niba wanditse igihe ku kindi gikoresho, fungura WitnessWork kuri iki kugira ngo gihagarike urwibutso rw'uwo munsi. Kuri Android, sisitemu ishobora gutinza urwibutso iminota mike kugira ngo ibike bateri. Niba inyibutsa zitaza, reba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork mu igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe kandi ko Focus cyangwa Ntugire uwo unsuhuza (Do Not Disturb) bitazihagarika. Niba zikomeje kutaza, menyesha ikibazo ukoresheje Ikigo cy'ubufasha utavuze amazina cyangwa andi makuru bwite.
faq_streaks_a: Urukurikirane rwawe rugaragaza uko ukomeza gukurikiza gahunda ushyiraho. Ku bapayiniya no ku bandi banditse amasaha, buri munsi wari ufite gahunda wandikaho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose wongeraho umwe, nubwo wakwandika igihe kiri munsi y'icyo wateganyije. Iminsi idafite gahunda ntiyongera ku rukurikirane kandi ntiyarurangiza, bityo tegura iminsi ushaka kujya kubwiriza. Ku babwiriza, buri kwezi ugira uruhare mu murimo wongeraho kimwe, waba ugushyize ku Ahabanza cyangwa wandika igihe. Urukurikirane rwawe rugaragara ku mutwe wa Ahabanza no ku Mwirondoro wawe iyo rugeze kuri 3. Iyo kwandika umunsi bigejeje urukurikirane ku ntambwe nka 3, 5 cyangwa 10, hakinwa ibyishimo bigufi; indi minsi, no kwiyongera kuza mu bundi buryo, nko mu gihe cyanditswe kuri watch yawe cyangwa ku kindi gikoresho, bituma urumuri ruri kuri Ahabanza rwaka cyane. Iyo rwenda kurangira, rukande kuri Ahabanza kugira ngo wandike umunsi usigaye.
faq_streakEnds_q: Urukurikirane rwanjye rurangira ryari, kandi nabigenza nte ngo rukomeze?
faq_streakEnds_a: Umunsi wari ufite gahunda ushobora kwandikwa kugeza ku iherezo ry'umunsi ukurikiraho. Iyo bwije nta gihe cyanditswe, urukurikirane rwawe rurangira. Iyo rwenda kurangira, urumuri ruri kuri Ahabanza rugaragaza igihe gisigaye, kandi Urwibutso rw'urukurikirane ruza saa kumi n'ebyiri z'umugoroba ku munsi wa nyuma. Ku babwiriza, ukwezi gushobora kwandikwa kugeza ku iherezo ry'ukwezi gukurikira, kandi urwibutso ruza iminsi itatu mbere y'uko ukwezi kurangira. Niba udashobora kujya kubwiriza ku munsi wari ufite gahunda, kuraho gahunda z'uwo munsi hakiri kare: kanda buri imwe kuri Ingengabihe, ukande Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda. Ku gahunda yisubiramo, itariki imwe gusa ni yo ikurwaho. Umunsi ukomeza kugira gahunda igihe cyose hari izisigaye kuri wo. Niba wagiye kubwiriza ariko ukibagirwa kwandika, ongeraho igihe kuri uwo munsi maze urukurikirane rwawe ruragaruka. Zimya Inyibutsa z'urukurikirane muri Amahitamo → Gahunda. Zisaba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork.
faq_streakBuddies_q: Bagenzi banjye bashobora kubona urukurikirane rwanjye?
faq_streakBuddies_a: Yego, iyo rugeze kuri 3 kandi urusangiza. Bagenzi bawe babona umubare ku ikarita yawe mu rutonde rwa Buddies rwabo, ariko ntibabona igihe cyawe cyangwa raporo zawe. Rurarinzwe n'ibanga kuva ku gikoresho kimwe kugeza ku kindi (end-to-end) nk'ibindi usangiza. Kugira ngo uhagarike kurusangiza, fungura Igenamiterere rya Buddies ukuzimye Urukurikirane. Urukurikirane rwarangiye ruhagarara kugaragara kuri telefoni za bagenzi bawe nubwo porogaramu yawe itafunguwe kuva icyo gihe.
faq_navigationShortcuts_q: Nigenza nte kugira ngo ngendere ku mfunguzo z'ibyoroshyo kuri iPad?
faq_navigationShortcuts_a: Huza clavier ya iPad ikoresha iPadOS 26 cyangwa irenzeho, hanyuma ufate ku kintu cya Command mu gihe imiyoborere nyamukuru igaragara. Utwandiko duto tw'ibyoroshyo tugaragara iruhande rw'utubuto two hasi cyangwa ibintu byo kuri sidebar. Kanda Command n'umubare ugaragara kugira ngo ufungure iyo ecran; irekure Command kugira ngo utwandiko dutwikirwe. Imibare ikurikiza uko imiyoborere igaragara, bityo mu buryo busanzwe Ahabanza ni Command 1 naho Abantu ni Command 2. Indi mibare iterwa n'ibintu bigaragara, harimo Igenamiterere kuri sidebar. Funga fomu cyangwa indi ecran yose ifunguye mbere yo gukoresha ibi byoroshyo; ntibibika cyangwa ngo bitere kureka inyandiko. Ikoreshwa ry'ibyoroshyo ni ryo ribarwa gusa, si ibyo wandika. Bisaba porogaramu yashyizweho ifite ubushobozi bwa clavier kandi ntibiboneka kuri iPhone cyangwa Android. Niba utwandiko tutagaragara, reba ko clavier ihujwe, garuka ku miyoborere nyamukuru, ushyire porogaramu ku gihe maze uyifungure bundi bushya. Burigihe ushobora gukanda ibintu by'imiyoborere. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha aho ubufasha bwa bwite buri mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru bwite mu bitekerezo rusange.
updatesUnavailable: Kugenzura ibishya ntibishoboka kuri iyi verisiyo. Shyiraho verisiyo nshya iboneka mu iduka rya porogaramu rya telefoni yawe.
faq_pointerHover_q: Nakoresha nte trackpad, mouse cyangwa Apple Pencil kuri iPad?
faq_pointerHover_a: Huza trackpad cyangwa mouse kuri iPad yawe, cyangwa wegereze Apple Pencil ishyigikiwe hejuru gato ya ecran. Utubuto, imirongo n'iminsi y'ikalendari bigaragara cyane mu gihe indanga ibinyuzeho. Iyo umurongo w'ibumoso wagabanyijwe ukaba ufite amashusho gusa, gushyira indanga ku shusho bigaragaza izina ryayo; utundi tubuto tudafite inyandiko, nko ku bikoresho by'ikarita no Amamenyesha, na two tugaragaza amazina yatwo. Shyira indanga ku rukuta rw'ibikorwa, ku gishushanyo cy'umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo, cyangwa ku nkingi y'ibirometero kugira ngo ubone itariki n'agaciro byayo. Ku ikarita, shyira indanga ku kimenyetso kugira ngo ubone izina ry'umuntu, cyangwa ku muntu uri ku rutonde rw'uruhande rw'ikarita kugira ngo ubone ikimenyetso cye. Gukanda kwa kabiri (gukanda n'intoki ebyiri) bifungura menu n'igaragaza rimwe nko gukanda ugakomeza. Umurongo wo guhindura ubugari bw'umurongo w'ibumoso ugaragaza imyambi yerekeza aho ushobora kwimukira, kandi gukurura n'intoki ebyiri bimura ifoto y'umuntu mu gihe uyikata. Byose biracyashoboka ukoresheje gukoraho: kanda, kanda ukomeze, cyangwa kurura nk'ibisanzwe. Gushyira indanga nta cyo bihindura ku nyandiko zawe. Hapimwa gusa ko indanga cyangwa Pencil byakoreshejwe, inshuro imwe ku munsi nibura; nta myanya, amazina cyangwa agaciro byoherezwa. Kuri Android, mouse igaragaza imirongo, amazina n'agaciro ku bishushanyo, ariko ibimenyetso ku ikarita ntibigaragaza amazina iyo indanga ibiriho. iPhone nta ndanga ifite. Niba nta kintu gisubiza, reba ko trackpad, mouse cyangwa Pencil bihujwe, ushyire porogaramu ku gihe maze uyifungure bundi bushya. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha aho ubufasha bwa bwite buri mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru bwite mu bitekerezo rusange.
faq_menuBar_q: Nakoresha nte menu bar kuri iPad?
faq_menuBar_a: Kuri iPadOS 26 cyangwa irenzeho, koresha Windowed Apps cyangwa Stage Manager maze unyereze urutoki umanuka uvuye ku nkombe yo hejuru kugira ngo ugaragaze menu bar. Nyuma yo kuyitegura, Amahitamo ya WitnessWork afungura igenamiterere ryo muri porogaramu; ikintu gisanzwe Igenamiterere gifungura igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe. Dosiye ifungura Andika gusura…, Ongeraho igihe iyo kwandika amasaha bifunguye, Ongeraho umuntu, Gahunda nshya, na Kubika no Kugarura. Hindura → Shakisha umuntu bifungura urutonde rw'abantu kandi bigashyira ikarita ku gushakisha. Ubufasha bufungura Ikigo cy'ubufasha, Ibishya, porogaramu yawe ya imeri ku bufasha bwa bwite, cyangwa Genzura ibishya. Ibi byoroshyo bikoresha ecran zisanzwe; gufungura fomu nta byo bibika cyangwa ngo bisangize inyandiko zawe. Genzura ibishya igenzura niba hari ivugurura rya porogaramu rihuye kandi ikoresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gukuramo no gutangira bundi bushya iyo ririho. Ntishobora gushyiraho verisiyo nshya ya porogaramu, kandi ntiboneka mu miterere y'iterambere. Gushyigikirwa kwa menu bar bisaba porogaramu yashyizweho irimo ubwo bushobozi kandi ntiboneka kuri iPhone cyangwa Android. Niba ibintu bibura, vugurura ukoresheje iduka rya porogaramu maze ufungure WitnessWork bundi bushya. Ushobora gukoresha ibikorwa bimwe mu porogaramu. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha aho imeri ya bwite iri mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru bwite n'ibyabitswe mu bitekerezo rusange.

updateReveal_buddies_caption: Reba igihe bagenzi bawe bateganya kujya kubwiriza. Kanda Buddies muri Ingengabihe.
updateReveal_notifications_caption: Wamaze igihe udahari? Inyibutsa zitegereza mu nzogera, ntizuzura ku Ahabanza.
updateReveal_home_caption: Andika gusubirayo kw'uyu munsi ukoze ku cyerekezo kimwe.
updateReveal_contacts_caption: Ibikurikira, na buri gusura, ubibone icyarimwe.
updateReveal_year_caption: Reba niba uri imbere, ukwezi ku kwezi.
updateReveal_mileage_caption: Andika ingendo n'ikiguzi cya lisansi. Ni ubushake.
updateReveal_calendar_caption: Bihuzwa na kalendari yagenewe WitnessWork gusa.
updateReveal_watch_caption: Ongeraho igihe, tangiza igihe kibarwa, kandi urebe ukwezi kwawe uri ku kuboko.

milestoneReveal_tagline: Our biggest update yet — packed with the features you asked for.
milestoneShowcase_closingBody:
Namaze umwaka wose nkora iyi nyandiko. Twizeye ko bizakugirira akamaro mu murimo wo kubwiriza.

Mu rukundo rwa kivandimwe,
milestoneHero_liquidGlass_description: Igishushanyo gishya hamwe na tab bar izunguruka, amakarita akonje, hamwe nibikoresho byihariye bifata umucyo. Amaherezo, iyo app iba iri mu rugo kuri telefoni yawe.
milestoneHero_progress_description: Isura nshya y'ukwezi, umwaka, n'ibihe byose, hamwe n'intambwe zisanzwe, gusenyuka kw'ibyiciro, amasaha y'ubuzima, na fireworks igihe urenze intego.
milestoneHero_contacts_description: A dedicated Contacts tab with fuzzy search, smart sort, stacked filters, and inline avatars. Find anyone in two taps.
milestoneHero_iCloudSync_description: Your reports, contacts, and plans sync seamlessly across all your devices through iCloud. Optional photo sync keeps avatars in step too. Supporter feature.
milestoneHero_iCloudSync_descriptionAndr: Raporo, abantu na gahunda byawe bihuzwa ku bikoresho byawe bya Android binyuze kuri Google Drive yawe. Guhuza amafoto ni ubushake kandi bituma n'amafoto y'umwirondoro ahuza. Ni ikiranga cy'abaterankunga.
milestoneHero_widgets_description: Porogaramu ya USU-Soft ikora amasaha y'ukwezi, amasaha n'amahugurwa y'igihe gito kuri ecran yawe y'urugo. Kanda kuri widget iyo ari yo yose kugirango usimbuke neza aho ukeneye kujya.
milestoneSecondary_onboardingFounder_des: Onboarding yubatswe kuva hasi kugera hejuru, hamwe n'inyandiko yihariye y'umuterankunga hamwe n'urutonde rw'intego zawe.
milestoneSecondary_fireworks_description: Beautiful celebrations the moment you cross a milestone or annual goal.
milestoneSecondary_avatars_description: Ongeraho ifoto cyangwa avatar ya emoji kuri buri contact, ukoresheje gukanda kugirango kwagure umureba wuzuye.
milestoneSecondary_sharing_description: Hand off a contact to another publisher with a secure universal link.
milestoneSecondary_missedConversations_d: A gentle home-screen nudge for follow-ups that slipped past — dismiss them once you've reached out.
milestoneSecondary_followUpRework_descri: Urupapuro rusobanutse rwa reschedule hamwe na chips zihuse, inzira ngufi yo gusura log, hamwe na tappable contact previews.
milestoneSecondary_recurring_description: Gahunda y'umunsi w'icyumweru n'icyumweru cy'ukwezi, hamwe n'ibisobanuro n'ibiciro by'ibicuruzwa.
milestoneSecondary_rollover_description: Iminota mike ikomeza mu kwezi gutaha, intoki cyangwa mu buryo bwikora.
milestoneSecondary_supporter_description: A little thank-you for those already supporting the app — exclusive perks like a custom accent color.
milestoneSecondary_appIcon_description: Abashyigikiye barashobora guhinduranya icon ya porogaramu ya ecran yo mu rugo kuri imwe mu mpinduka nyinshi.
milestoneSecondary_schedule_description: A focused calendar view of your day plans and repeating conversations.
milestoneSecondary_shaders_description: Ubuzima bwawe bw'umurimo mu buryo bumwe: izina, inshingano, igihe cyakorewe, n'imibare ishimishije.
milestoneSecondary_mapEmpty_description: A friendlier empty state and refined location prompts on first use.

160.c1: Conversations are now editable. Notifications are configurable
160.c2: Swipe gestures to edit or delete conversations, contacts, etc.
160.c3: Added haptic feedback to various important actions

161.c1: Added more minute options for time entries

162.c1: Adjusted special pioneer hour requirement from 70 to 100

181.c2: Added store review request after certain criteria is met

182.c1: Updated all time to reflect the current locale

190.c2: [iOS] Select between Google, Apple, and Waze as your default navigation app in preferences.
190.c3: Ubu wagena igihe gisanzwe cyo gukurikirana n'imenyekanisha mu igenamiterere.
190.c5: New progress bar organizes your time entries by category
190.c6: Now add custom tags to your time entries
190.c7: Updated Time Reports screen to be better organized and separated by month

191.c1: Resolves an issue navigating to time screens.

192.c1: Ubu wa kanda ku kiganiro kugira ngo ugire ibyo uhindura, cyangwa ushobora gusunika ibumoso nka mbere.
192.c2: Fixes an issue where some devices have an overflowing progress bar.
192.c3: Adds more verbose handling of link errors for certain devices lacking required applications.
192.c4: Navigate directly to a month from the monthly routine section of the home screen.
192.c5: Time Reports screen better handles empty and future months.

1100.c1: Adds annual report to Time Reports screen! Keep track of your service year progress at a glance.
1100.c2: Adding time from Time Reports screen now defaults the report to the selected month.
1100.c3: Fixes an issue exporting January service report.

1110.c1: Hongewemo gukoreshwa na iPad na Tablet neza!
1110.c2: Hahinduwe imiterere imwe n'imwe kugira ngo ikore neza muri ekara nini.
1110.c3: Adjusted the method of submitting Bug Reports and Feature Requests to Github.

1111.c1: Hongewemo i paji yo gutanga impano kubifuza gutanga impano. Reba mu igenamiterere.

1120.c1: Hongewemo ubryo bwo kugarura no kubika amakuru bwite ya application. Ushobora kubika kuri Cloud, ukabigarura nyuma no mu bindi bikoresho bya elegitoroniki. Wabyohereza no ku zindi platform. Reba iyi miterere mishya mu igenamiterere.

1200.c1: Hongewemo ubryo bwo kugarura no kubika amakuru bwite ya application. Ushobora kubika kuri Cloud, ukabigarura nyuma no mu bindi bikoresho bya elegitoroniki. Wabyohereza no ku zindi platform. Reba iyi miterere mishya mu igenamiterere.

1201.c1: Huza n'igihe igice cya buri kwezi ahabanza kugira ngo ubone amezi abanza n'akurikira.
1201.c2: Hanonosowe ubuhinduzi bwo mu rurimi rwa Korean - Muvandimwe Paul, wakoze. Niba ushaka gufasha guhindura mu rurimi rwawe, reba mu igenamiterere.

1210.c4: Hanonosowe ubuziranenge kuri ekara y'ikarita harimo n'amakuru akenewe ndetse na buto yo kongeramo byihuse.

1211.c1: Hongewe izindi ngingo z'ingenzi inshuro imwe aho bikenewe.

1220.c3: Added Calendar to time reports screen.
1220.c1: Preferences are now better organized by category.
1220.c2: Improved import & export screen to be visually clearer.
1220.c4: Occasionally notifies you to create a new backup. This is configurable in the settings.

1221.c1: [iOS] Date and Time pickers now use the correct locale
1221.c2: Fixed an issue where editing a conversation would incorrectly navigate.
1221.c3: Other minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
1221.c4: Improved Spanish translation - thank you brother Cleen. If you'd like to help translate your own language, see 'Help Translate' in the settings.

1230.c1: Added new Annual Overview screen to view your service year progress by month.
1230.c2: Added 'Today' button to quickly navigate back to current month when viewing previous months or years.
1230.c3: Updated Special Pioneers to not have an annual goal by default.
1230.c4: Added 'Annual Goal' setting to publisher preferences. This allows you to override the default setting for your publisher type.
1230.c5: Greatly improved Italian translations, thank you brother Giuseppe!

1240.c1: Hashyizwemo uburyo bwo kwihindurira ahantu hashyizwemo kuri buri karita. Ukandaho ukagumishaho agatoki, ubundi ukajyana aho ushaka.
1240.c2: Added small map view to contact details screen and resolved errors for invalid coordinates.
1240.c3: Resolved an overflow visual issue that sometimes occurs on small screens when viewing map contact cards.

1250.c1: Big update! Added scheduling & plans! 🚀 You can now create one-time plans, recurring plans, and view your month's schedule.
1250.c2: Improved clarity by adding 'toast' notifications for notable app actions.
1250.c3: Updated various sections of time reports screen to have more information and easier navigation.
1250.c4: Resolved minor visual issues and other bugs.
1250.c5: Added font size offset setting to preferences. This allows you to adjust the font size of the app.

1260.c1: Fixed issue where scroll position would be lost on TimeReportsScreen. Resolved other issues related to time reports screen.
1260.c2: Amasaha ya LDC ntabarwa mu kurenza amasaha 55 mu kwezi uko ari ko kose ku ntego y'umwaka.
1260.c3: Gahunda zisubiramo zasibwa n'ibizaba vuba cyangwa ibizaba vuba byose mu gihe kiri imbere.
1260.c4: New custom fields for contacts! You can create any number of custom fields you wish.
1260.c5: You can now share your time directly with NW Publisher!

1270.c1: Added Timer! ⏱️ (Stopwatch). You can now start and stop a timer to track your time directly within the app.
1270.c2: Resolved crashing issue for some devices when navigating to the Contact Details screen.
1270.c4: Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

1280.c3: Update dependencies and add security updates.
1280.c2: Updated Portuguese translations, thank you brother Sérgio!
1280.c4: 📝 A little personal note: I have been very busy with congregation responsibilities and life recently. After my upcoming convention next week, things will return more back to normal. I will be working on many more updates in the coming weeks! Thank you for your patience and for choosing WitnessWork! ❤️

1290.c1: Added new schedule section to month summary screen which helps you keep track of your time pacing.
1290.c2: Kuri ekara y'ahabanza, hakozwe neza ikibazo cy'ibyiciro byakingirizaga ibindi kigakunda kuba kuri ekara ntoya.
1290.c3: You can now edit time entries! Tap on them!
1290.c4: Many improvements have been made to clarity of how to add, update, and delete various items across WitnessWork. Hints have been removed as they're no longer necessary.
1290.c5: I'm looking for 2 volunteers who have experience in Software QA to assist in testing releases before they reach the public. If you have interest in spending a few hours a month testing, your support would be greatly appreciated. Please contact me: levi@leviwilkerson.com. In the future and as expenses allows, a portion of donations will go to QA for their time.
1290.c6: Annual time overview screen now is compressed for better readability.

1291.c1: [ANDROID] Resolved crashes that occurred when editing time.

1300.c1: Add 'Annual Schedule' to Plan Schedule screen for those with an annual goal, allowing you to easily see if you have planned enough time for your entire service year.
1300.c2: Hides 'today' schedule view when the month is in the future because it's not applicable.
1300.c4: If a contact pin was dragged for a contact, navigation will now prioritize the manually adjusted pin over their address. Editing a contact's address will return the address to priority.
1300.c7: Contact pin colors on Contact Details Screen now matches the map screen.
1300.c9: Month and annual total calculations now properly limit your credit time to 55 hours per month. Standard time is not affected by this rule. If you exceed this time using credit, you'll have overage displayed on your month's details screen.
1300.c10: Added time credit support. Existing users will be able to update their old time entries automatically.
1300.c11: Resolved issue with add button overlapping compass on iOS.

1310.c1: Greatly improved performance when navigating to time related screens.
1310.c3: Resolve date localization issue that occurred in some regions.
1310.c4: Updated styles and locations of commonly used items. Month and Service Year reports can be easily accessed in the tab bar at the bottom of the screen.
1310.c5: Resolved style overflow issues that occurred on certain screen sizes for the map screen.
1310.c6: Now automatically prefills recently used addresses when creating multiple contacts on the same day.
1310.c7: You can now toggle visibility of the home screen sections. Visit Preferences > Home Screen.
1310.c8: The app now is named WitnessWork, formerly 'JW Time' due to legal reasons.
1310.c9: Languages now attempt to find your exact region, otherwise it falls back to any locale with your language. If nothing can be found, it defaults to English.
1310.c10: Bemba language added! We need your help to translate. Please visit Settings > Help Translate

1320.c1: Now create coordinate only contacts. If your territory is very rural or with bad mapping information, there is now no need to rely on an address.
1320.c2: Easily toggle between device, dark, and light mode color scheme. Visit Preferences > Appearance.
1320.c4: 'Add Time' screen now allows for increments of 1 minute.
1320.c5: Wongeyeho ururimi rwa Kinyarwanda, rwahinduwe byuzuye na Semana D. Urakoze cyane kubufasha bwawe!
1320.c6: Urashobora noneho guhitamo uburyo igihe cyawe cyerekanwa. Hitamo hagati ya cumi nka: 13.5 cyangwa uhitemo 13 Hrs 30 Mins. Sura Ibyifuzo & gt; Kugaragara.

1330.c1: Hongewemo gutoranya ururimi. Reba Ibyatoranijwe kugirango uhindure ururimi.
1330.c2: Ikibazo cyakemutse kuri gahunda y'umusi umwe ifite itariki ntarengwa.

1340.c1: Wongeyeho ibihembo bidasanzwe mugihe ugenzuye igihe cyawe cyangwa wongeyeho umwanya!
1340.c2: Urashobora noneho gushiraho agaciro ka cumi kumigambi yisaha kuri & apos; gakondo & apos; ubwoko bw'abamamaza.

1350.c1: Urashobora noneho gukoresha autocomplete kugirango ushakishe adresse! Gusa tangira wandika kugirango ubone ibyifuzo. Iyi ngingo irashoboka gusa nimpano zawe nyinshi. Urakoze ku nkunga yawe!
1350.c2: Ikibazo cyakemutse aho urupapuro rwumunsi rudafunga byikora mugihe wongeyeho umwanya kumunsi wukwezi.
1350.c3: Gukemura ikibazo cyuzuye hejuru murugo murugo rwa tableti.

1360.c1: New: Share Contacts and easily import them. Transfering calls is now easier than ever.
1360.c2: Added a color key to the map view! You can now customize the colors of the pins on the map.
1360.c3: NEW: Dismiss Contact feature - You can now dismiss contacts you no longer wish to visit and receive notifications when it's time to return to them.
1360.c4: Added notes support to time reports - You can now add notes to your daily time entries to keep track of important details.
1360.c5: Improves visibility of Map on Contacts Details screen.
1360.c7: Added statistics sections to your Monthly and Yearly reports to better track your progress and patterns.
1360.c8: You can now change your calendar's first day of the week. Visit Preferences > Appearance.
1360.c9: Improved progress bar animations throughout the app and added additional encouragement messages.
1360.c10: Enhanced follow up topic input - Now supports multiple lines for easier writing of longer topics.
1360.c11: There are now no restrictions on when you can add or schedule time, in the future or past.
1360.c12: Added visual indicators on calendar days to show when notes are present.
1360.c13: Resolves issue with Korean and Panama phone number formatting.
1360.c14: Improves visibility of Map on Contacts Details screen with better zoom levels.
1360.c15: Fixed various navigation issues when adding time and scheduling plans.
1360.c16: Improved readability and consistency throughout the app with better spacing and button sizes.

1382.c1: The Milestone Update is here. Isura nshya yose hamwe na bar ya tab ireremba, amakarita akonje, hamwe nuburyo bushya, bugezweho muri porogaramu.
1382.c2: New Contacts tab with fuzzy search, smart sort, and stacked filters. Your contacts are now a first-class destination.
1382.c3: Progress Screen 2.0: isura nshya y'ukwezi, umwaka, n'ibihe byose, hamwe n'ibihe by'ingenzi bigezweho, gusenyuka kw'ibyiciro, n'amasaha y'ubuzima.
1382.c4: iCloud sync arrives (Supporter): your reports, contacts, and plans stay in step across all your devices. Optional photo sync keeps avatars synced too.
1382.c5: Onboarding has been rebuilt from the ground up. Ibaruramari ryihariye ryububiko bwibicuruzwa, igenamigambi ryihariye, hamwe nuburyo bwo kugenzura ibicuruzwa byawe.
1382.c6: Brand new home screen widgets: monthly calendar, appointments, hours, and contacts. All one tap away.
1382.c7: Contact avatars are here. Amafoto cyangwa emoji, hamwe na tap-to-kwagura fullscreen viewer.
1382.c8: Sangira contact n'undi mwanditsi ukoresheje secure universal links.
1382.c9: Smarter repeating plans. Schedule by day-of-week and week-of-month, with per-instance overrides and deletions.
1382.c10: Time rollover: Fractional minutes carry forward into next month, manually or automatically.
1382.c11: Beautiful new celebrations the moment you cross a goal.
1382.c12: New Supporter tier with personalization, including a custom accent color.
1382.c13: Schedule screen: a focused calendar view of day plans and repeating conversations.
1382.c14: Ikarita y'umwirondoro ivuguruye kuri ecran yo mu rugo yerekana uruhare rwawe, igihe cyakorewe, n'imibare ishimishije.
1382.c15: Ibiganiro byihariye n'ibyabuze ubu bigaragaramo kuri ecran yo mu rugo kugira ngo utazigera utakaza icyerekezo.
1382.c16: Telephone region code now persists across new contacts. Porogaramu yo kugenzura ibicuruzwa bya elegitoroniki byihuse kandi byihuse.
1382.c17: Map empty state, location prompts, and contact map clustering have all been polished.
1382.c18: Ibicuruzwa bito bitabarika, impinduka mu mikorere, no kunoza amashusho muri porogaramu.

1383.c1: Gahunda ubu zigira ikiciro. Shyira ikiciro kuri gahunda wateganyije maze igiteranyo giteganyijwe kigaragaze ubwoko bwa credit bukwiriye.
1383.c2: Igiteranyo giteganyijwe ubu ni cyo cyukuri. Cyubahiriza urugero rwa credit rwawe rwa buri kwezi kandi ntikibarira inshuro ebyiri igihe wamaze kwandika uyu munsi.
1383.c3: Ijwi ryo kwishima ubu ryubahiriza buto yo kuvuza cyangwa guceceka ya telefoni yawe.
1383.c5: Aderesi nshya n'impinduka ku makuru y'aho atuye ubu bibikwa ako kanya, ndetse na mbere y'uko ikarita irangiza kubona aho biherereye.
1383.c6: Kalendari yihuza n'igihe ako kanya numara kongeraho, guhindura, cyangwa kuvanaho gahunda.
1383.c7: Pin zo ku ikarita ziguma zigaragara nyuma yo kuzikandaho.
1383.c8: Kugenda hejuru na hasi kuworoshye ku rutonde rw'Aderesi.
1383.c4: Impano watanze ubu zigaragaza neza igihe cyo kwishyura n'igiciro by'umufasha wiyandikishije buri mwaka cyangwa wahawe.

1400.c1: Switching from MyTime? You can now import your contacts and visit history straight from a MyTime backup, with a preview before anything is added, so there's no manual re-entry.
1400.c2: Date format, clock style, and start of the week are now separate from your app language. Set each one in Settings > Date & Time, with an Auto option that follows your region or device.
1400.c3: You can now customize the day thresholds and colors behind contact staleness. Tune them in Settings > Personalization > Color Key.
1400.c4: The map search box keeps focus while you type, so filtering contacts no longer interrupts you.
1400.c5: Locating contacts on the map now shows live progress, and you can skip it midway without losing your place.
1400.c6: Faster, smoother scrolling in the Contacts list, plus quicker home screen widget updates.
1400.c7: Fixed projected totals around time zone changes, enlarged header buttons for easier tapping, and polished countless small details throughout the app.

1410.c1: New: Meet Scribe AI. Paste your field-ministry notes — a handwritten-style log or an export from another app — and Scribe AI turns them into contacts, visits, and time entries for you to review before anything is saved. Ntuzongera kwinjiza intoki, kandi urashobora gutangira kwinjiza mu buryo bwihuse.
1410.c2: Your Supporter status now restored more reliably across sign-ins and devices.
1410.c3: Gukemura impanuka idasanzwe yashoboraga kubaho mugihe cyo gufunga picker.
1410.c4: Kwizerwa kunoza iyo porogaramu ikubise ububiko bw'igihe gito cyangwa hiccup y'ahantu, bityo contacts zawe n'amavugurura azigama yizewe ndetse no ku murongo udasanzwe.
1410.c5: Hourglass and NW Publisher export are back, so submit your Service Report through your congregation's app is just a tap away again.
1410.c6: Choose your default Service Report submission method once, then WitnessWork can remind you at month-end and open your preferred option automatically.
1410.c7: Gahunda zoroshye gucunga, hamwe n'urutonde rusukuye, gutunganya byihuse, hamwe n'amahitamo asobanutse yo guhindura itariki imwe isubiramo, amatariki y'igihe kizaza, cyangwa gahunda yose.
1410.c8: Gahunda ubu yerekana uko buri munsi uhagaze, harimo imbere, inyuma, inzira, imbere, guhuza, cyangwa kutagira gahunda.
1410.c9: Time rollover now keeps Credit Time in its original month by default, with a preference if you want Credit Time included in rollover.

1411.c1: Gishya: Menya Scribe AI. Omekaho inyandiko zawe z'umurimo wo kubwiriza, zaba zanditse nk'inyandiko y'intoki cyangwa amakuru yoherejwe n'indi porogaramu, maze Scribe AI izihindure aderesi, gusura n'ibyanditswe by'igihe kugira ngo ubanze ubisuzume mbere yo kubika. Ushobora kunoza ibyavuyemo ubiganiraho ako kanya, gutangira kwinjiza amakuru mu itangira rya porogaramu, kandi nta Nguzanyo yo Kwinjiza uzatakaza igihe nta makuru yabonetse.
1411.c2: Hongewe ahantu hashya h'Uku Kwezi kuri ecran y'ibanze ushobora guhindura. Intego, igiteranyo giteganyijwe n'umuvuduko wa gahunda byawe biri ku makarita ushobora gutondeka no kwagura, naho Raporo y'Umurimo ikaguma ku ikarita imwe itondetse neza. Kanda raporo kugira ngo urebe ibisobanuro byose.
1411.c3: Hindura intego y'ukwezi kumwe. Shyiraho intego itandukanye y'ukwezi kumwe igihe imimerere yawe ihindutse, kandi urebe amasaha wateganyije ku ruziga rwayo rw'iterambere.
1411.c4: Teganya ibintu birenze kimwe ku munsi. Gahunda z'umunsi zo ku itariki imwe ubu zirateranywa, buri imwe igakomeza kugira icyiciro cyayo, kandi gahunda zitabarwa kuri uwo munsi zigaragazwa neza.
1411.c5: Guhindura ibintu byaroroshye hose. Gahunda, ibyanditswe by'igihe n'ibiganiro ubu bifite akamenyetso k'utudomo dutatu karimo Guhindura no Gusiba; gahunda zisubirwamo na zo zitanga amahitamo asobanutse yo guhindura itariki imwe, amatariki azaza cyangwa gahunda yose.
1411.c6: Raporo z'Umurimo: Kongera gutanga raporo ukoresheje Hourglass na NW Publisher birahari, ushobora guhitamo uburyo busanzwe bwo kuyitanga, guhindura ibisobanuro bya raporo mbere yo kuyohereza no kubona urwibutso ku mpera z'ukwezi. Ubu ushobora no kugabanya amateka y'imyaka cyangwa kongeramo imyaka yabanje.
1411.c7: Gahunda ubu igaragaza uko buri munsi uhagaze mu kanya gato: uri imbere, uri inyuma, uri ku murongo, uraza, urahuye cyangwa nta gahunda ihari.
1411.c8: Ubu kuba Umufasha bikurikira Apple ID yawe ku bikoresho byose, umubare w'ibyo Scribe AI yemera kwimurirwa ku yindi gahunda, kandi ecran y'Umufasha yarorohejwe.
1411.c9: Hakosowe ibyanditswe by'igihe na gahunda byajyaga ku munsi utari wo mu turere tw'isaha twa UTC+12 no hejuru yaho, hamwe n'amatariki yajyaga ku munsi utari wo nijoro mu burengerazuba bwa UTC. Hakosowe n'udushusho two ku ikarita twafunguraga aderesi itari yo nyuma yo kunyereza amakarita. Ubu kwimurira igihe mu kwezi gukurikira bisiga Igihe cy'Inguzanyo mu kwezi kwacyo.
1411.c10: Akamenyetso k'Inguzanyo ku byiciro ubu karaboneka ku Mubwiriza wese wandika amasaha. Hakosowe kandi ikibazo kidasanzwe cyafungaga porogaramu igihe ufunze igikoresho cyo guhitamo, hagarurwa inyenyeri z'abo ukunda n'ikimenyetso cy'icyigisho cya Bibiliya cy'ukwezi turimo, havugururwa Expo SDK 57, kandi ingano ya porogaramu iragabanywa.

1420.c1: Imiterere mishya ya iPad yerekana abantu, amakarita na gahunda iruhande rw’amakuru arambuye yabyo.
1420.c2: Hindura imyanya y’amakuru y’abantu: hindura uko telefoni, imeyili n’imyanya yihariye bikurikirana, uhishe telefoni cyangwa imeyili, kandi usibe burundu imyanya yihariye yashyizwe mu bubiko.
1420.c3: Reba igihe wanditse ukurikije ibyiciro mu mwaka w’umurimo wose, kandi uhindure umubare ntarengwa w’amasaha yemewe y’indi mirimo buri kwezi mu mahitamo y’ibyiciro by’ababwiriza bibyemera.
1420.c4: Raporo zoherezwa muri Hourglass ubu zitandukanya igihe cyo kubwiriza n’amasaha yemewe y’indi mirimo.
1420.c5: Umufasha wa kalendari yongeye kuboneka, kandi ushobora kumugena mu mahitamo ya Gahunda.

1430.c1: Uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru ku babwiriza bo mu Bumwe bw'u Burayi, mu Bwongereza no mu Busuwisi bubika amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu mu rugero itegeko ryemera, harimo gukurikirana uruhushya rwabo no gusiba aderesi umaze igihe udasura.
1430.c2: Ongeraho aderesi uhereye ku kamenyetso ushyize ku ikarita.
1430.c3: Ababwiriza b'Ubwami bashobora guhitamo kwandika amasaha yabo bakoresheje kubara igihe, intego y'ukwezi itari ngombwa n'igice cy'Iterambere.
1430.c4: Igice cy'Umwaka ubu kigaragaza igiteranyo cy'umwaka w'umurimo ku cyiciro cy'ababwiriza cyose, niyo nta ntego y'umwaka yaba ihari.
1430.c5: Guteganya gusubira gusura ubu ntibikiri ngombwa, kandi ushobora kuzimya amajwi ya porogaramu mu Mahitamo.
1430.c6: Hakosowe amatariki yahindukaga ku babwiriza bari mu turere tw'isaha two mu Burasirazuba bwa Kure.

1440.c1: Kugenda byoroshye hamwe n'utubuto enye twanditseho ushobora gutondeka. Ikarita ubu iri hejuru ya Abantu, naho Igenamiterere riri munsi y'ifoto yawe.
1440.c2: Abantu bongeye gutegurwa ku bijyanye n'ibikurikira, na buri gusura biri ku murongo w'igihe. Andika gusura ukoresheje menu ya +, ubone ibitekerezo by'abari hafi, kandi wongere imyanya yihariye mu biganiro.
1440.c3: Ingengabihe ifite kalendari y'umwaka n'ukwezi ushobora kwagura, kandi gahunda ishobora kuba amasaha gusa cyangwa igihe cyuzuye.
1440.c4: Reba umuvuduko w'umwaka wawe w'umurimo ukwezi ku kwezi, kandi wishimire urukurikirane n'ibimenyetso ku nzira.
1440.c5: Kurikirana ibirometero ni ubushake, kandi byandika ingendo zawe n'ikiguzi cya lisansi.
1440.c6: Gusubirayo bishobora guhuzwa na kalendari yagenewe WitnessWork gusa, ubu no kuri Android, aho ushobora no kubika no guhuza ukoresheje Google Drive.
1440.c7: Inyibutsa zitegereza mu nzogera y'amamenyesha aho kwirundanya ku Ahabanza.

notesImport_description: Paste field-ministry notes or an export from another app. Scribe AI turns them into Contacts, Visits, and Time Entries for you to review before anything is saved.
notesImport_disclosureTitle: How Scribe AI reads your notes
notesImport_disclosureBody: Scribe AI yohereza inyandiko zawe ku rurimi rw'indi sosiyete y'indi yashyizweho mu karere kagezweho hakurikijwe amasezerano yo kubungabunga amakuru. It reads your text and keeps nothing afterward. WitnessWork ibika nta kopi y'inyandiko zawe kuri seriveri zacu, kandi nta kintu na kimwe cyongeweho ku nyandiko zawe kugeza igihe ugenzura no kwemeza.
notesImport_inputHint: Paste free-form field-ministry notes for Scribe AI to prepare an import preview.
notesImport_reviewNotice: Nta kintu na kimwe kiba gisigaye kugeza igihe wemeye ko habaho igenzura ryimbitse.
notesImport_privacySummary: Scribe AI yohereza inyandiko zawe binyuze kuri OpenRouter ku batanga serivisi bizewe b'ibyitwa language models bo mu Burengerazuba bafite Zero Data Retention, bityo ntizibikwa. Inyandiko zimara gusa igihe kwinjiza biri gukorwa; amateka yawe aguma kuri telefoni yawe. WitnessWork ntigurisha cyangwa isangiza inyandiko zawe kandi ntizikoresha mu kwigisha ibyitwa models. Ibyo wavuze n'amafoto bihindurwa inyandiko kuri telefoni yawe; amajwi n'amashusho ntibyoherezwa.
notesImport_privacyLink: Soma politiki ya ZDR ya OpenRouter
notesImport_helpSubtitle: Paste anything — formatting doesn't matter. Dore uburyo bwo kwinjiza inyandiko zawe n'ibikwiriye gushyirwamo.
notesImport_helpNotesStep2: Kanda kuri Share, hanyuma uhitemo Copy (cyangwa uhitemo inyandiko na Copy).
notesImport_helpNotesStep3: Ngaho nimugaruke hano maze muyishyire mu kiganiro.

notesImport_helpIncludeNote: Don't worry about formatting or leaving things out — paste it however it's written and review everything before it's saved.

notesImport_descriptionCapture: Shyiramo inyandiko, wandike mu majwi, cyangwa usikane ifoto. Scribe AI ibihindura Abantu, Gusura n'Inyandiko z'igihe kugira ngo usuzume mbere y'uko hagira icyo kibikwa.
notesImport_voiceEmptyBody: Nta magambo yumvikanye. Ongera ugerageze wegereye mikoro, ahantu hatuje.
notesImport_voiceUnsupported: Kumenya amajwi kuri telefoni ntibishoboka ku rurimi rwawe kuri iki gikoresho. Ushobora kwandika cyangwa gushyiramo inyandiko zawe.
notesImport_voiceModelError: Model y'amajwi yo kuri telefoni ntiyashoboye gukurwa. Huza interineti hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
notesImport_voiceAudioError: Mikoro iri gukoreshwa. Rangiza guhamagara cyangwa kwandika amajwi, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
notesImport_micDeniedBody: Kugira ngo wandike mu majwi, emerera WitnessWork gukoresha Mikoro mu Igenamiterere.
notesImport_micSpeechDeniedBody: Kugira ngo wandike mu majwi, emerera WitnessWork gukoresha Mikoro na Speech Recognition mu Igenamiterere.
notesImport_photoEmptyBody: Ongera ugerageze urupapuro rudakubiswe, rufite urumuri ruhagije kandi rwuzuye mu kadirishya.
notesImport_cameraDeniedBody: Kugira ngo usikane inyandiko, emerera WitnessWork gukoresha Kamera mu Igenamiterere, cyangwa uhitemo amafoto.
notesImport_helpCaptureVoice: Nyuma yo kuganira, kanda mikoro uvuge ibyabaye: uwo muganiriye, ibyo mwaganiriyeho, n'igihe uzasubirayo. Kanda ikimenyetso cyo kwemeza ukirangije.
notesImport_helpCapturePhoto: Kanda kamera kugira ngo usikane inyandiko zanditse n'intoki cyangwa inyandiko y'umurimo wo kubwiriza ku nzu n'inzu, cyangwa uhitemo amafoto.
notesImport_helpCaptureReview: Inyandiko igaragara mu gasanduku k'ubutumwa. Kosora icyumvikanye nabi cyangwa cyasomwe nabi, hanyuma wohereze. Amajwi n'amafoto bigumana kuri iki gikoresho.
onboardingPickUp_description: Waba umaze gukurikirana umurimo wawe ahandi? Mujye mutanga ubuhamya.
onboardingPickUp_notesDesc: Hindura inyandiko z'ubuntu cyangwa log ivuye ku yindi porogaramu muri records.
onboardingPickUp_icloudUnavailable: Nta kimenyetso na kimwe cyabonetse kuri iki gikoresho cy'ubucuruzi.
onboardingPickUp_icloudUnavailableAndroi: Google Drive isaba Google Play services kuri iki gikoresho.
backupRecommendations: Birasabwa ko ubika backup zawe mu bubiko bwa Cloud. Bituma utabura amakuru yawe niyo igikoresha cyawe wakibura cyangwa kikangirika.
backupReasoning: Kubera ko amakuru yawe atazigera abikwa kuri seriveri, porogaramu nta buryo bya 'Sync' izagira. Ahubwo ugomba kuvana no kujyana amakuru hanze ubyikoreye. Ibi bituma amakuru yawe ahora mu burinzi.
sharingIsNotAvailable: Gusangiza ntabwo biboneka kuri uru rubuga.
errorExporting_description: Ikibazo mu kujyana hanze. Genzura neza ko igikoresho cyawe gifite umwanya uhagije kandi ko gusangiza byemwe, wongere ugerageze.
map_noContactsWithGeocodes: Nta aderesi zifite coordinates kugeza ubu ufite. Shyiramo cyangwa ugire aderesi uhindura, kugira ngo ushyiremo coordinates.
didYouKnow_longPressCopy_body: Kora kuri nimero ya telefone, imeyili, cyangwa aderesi y'umuntu ufite contact kugira ngo uyikope ako kanya kuri clipboard yawe.
didYouKnow_swipeEditConvo_body: Swipe a conversation row from the left to jump straight into editing — no need to open the full form.
didYouKnow_dragMapPin_body: Ku ikarita, kanda ku kimenyetso cy'umuvugizi w'ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe ujye ahantu nyakuri kurushaho. Ahantu havugururwa mu buryo bwikora.
didYouKnow_longPressMap_body: Mugihe uhindura aho umuntu aherereye, kanda igihe kirekire ku ikarita kugirango ushyireho aho aherereye, hanyuma uhindure neza ukoresheje gukurura.
didYouKnow_notAtHome_body: Mark a conversation as not-at-home and it will resurface later in your missed-conversation reminders.
didYouKnow_accentColor_body: Supporters can switch the accent color from green to one of nine curated palettes in Preferences → Personalization.
didYouKnow_fontSizeOffset_body: Adjust the global text size without touching system settings — Preferences → Appearance → Font Size.
didYouKnow_hideHomeSections_title: Home Amakuru Amakuru Mashya Bye Bye Home Screen
didYouKnow_hideHomeSections_body: Hide the sections you don't use in Preferences → Home Screen. Jya ushyira mu gaciro gusa ku bintu by'ingenzi kuri wowe.
didYouKnow_followUpOffset_title: Andika Igitekerezo Cyawe Mugihe Cyo Gukurikirana
didYouKnow_followUpOffset_body: Choose how far ahead return visits surface and when you're notified, down to the minute. Preferences → Conversations.
didYouKnow_planNotifications_body: Shyiramo igihe mbere y'uko gahunda iteganyijwe wifuza kumenyeshwa — wigenga ku kwibutsa gukurikirana.
didYouKnow_backupCadence_body: Kora ubukangurambaga bwo kubika amakuru yawe aho ari ho hose kuva buri minsi 1 kugeza kuri buri minsi 365. Preferences → Backups.
didYouKnow_widgetSort_title: Sort the contacts widget your way
didYouKnow_widgetSort_body: Hitamo ikiganiro kimaze igihe kirekire uvuganye, ikiganiro giherutse kuvugana, inyuguti cyangwa kwiga Bibiliya. Preferences → Widgets.
didYouKnow_swipeDeleteTime_body: Swipe a time entry from the right to remove it. Rollover pairs zimenyekana kugirango iminota mike idahagarara.
howToDeleteTime: Siba ibyinjijwe usunitse uva iburyo, bigerageze!
howToArchiveContact: Shyira mu bubiko aderesi za kera usunika uva iburyo. Aderesi ziri mu bubiko zishobora kugarurwa nyuma mu igenamiterere.
howToEditAndDeleteConversation: Gira ibyo uhindura ku kuganiro ukanzeho cyangwa usunitse uva ibumoso. Kugira ngo usibe, sunika uva iburyo.
detailedProgressBar_description: Bihindura udukoni twa aho bigeze, ikagaragaza raporo bitewe n'ibyiciro. Nanone, igaragaza igihe nk'ibice kugira ngo bibe bihuje n'ukuri.
viewTimeReportsForThisDate: Reba raporo z'uyu munsi. Sunika hirya cyangwa hino kugira ngo usibe.
noReportsThisDay: Nta raporo y'igihe y'uyu munsi kugeza ubu.
noPlansThisDay: Kugeza ubu nta gahunda n'imwe iteganyijwe kuri uwo munsi.
daysSinceLastBackup: Iminsi ishize ubwo uheruka gukora backup
daysSinceLastBackup_description: Umurimo w'Umuhamya izajya ikwibutsa hashize iyi minsi ukoze backup, kugira ngo ukore indi backup.
recommendedBackup_description: Hashize iminsi {{count}} ubwo uheruka gukora backup. Birasabwa gukora indi backup ubu.
thisGloballyOffsetsTextSize: Kugira ngo ubone neza, hindura ingano y’inyandiko mu igenamiterere rya iOS. Iyi ngenzura ihindura ingano y’inyandiko muri WitnessWork gusa.
visitDetails_wentBackNotHome: Wasubiyeyo {{when}}, ariko nta wari mu rugo
timePlanned_description: Ijanisha ry'igihe cyagenwe mu kwezi rishingira ku ntego z'umubwiriza uri we. Gerageza ku gena nibura 100% y'intego zawe.
projectedHoursDescription: Combines hours you've already logged with hours you have planned. Intego yawe ni ukugera ku ntego yawe 100%.

scheduleCalendar.monthOverviewHint: Yerekana uko intego itegurwa, umuvuduko, n'Umufasha

scheduleInsights.coverageDescription: Combines logged time with the effective contribution of remaining Plans. Left to plan accounts for the credit time cap.
scheduleInsights.paceDescriptionCurrent: Igereranya igihe cyanditswe na gahunda zawe kugeza uyu munsi.
scheduleInsights.paceDescriptionMonth: Igereranya igihe cyanditswe na gahunda zawe z'ukwezi kose.

serviceReportInsights.projectionDescription: Projected combines logged time with the effective contribution of remaining Plans after applying the Credit Time cap.
serviceReportInsights.studiesDescription: Buri guhura n'abantu b'ingeri zitandukanye bigomba kuba bifite agaciro inshuro imwe.
serviceReportInsights.noStudies: No contacts count towards this month's studies.

scheduleIntro_plan_caption: Hitamo iminsi n'amasaha uzajya kubwiriza. Gahunda zawe zuzuza kalendari yawe kandi zikurikirana intego yawe.
scheduleIntro_streak_caption: Andika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ku munsi wari ufite gahunda maze urukurikirane rwawe rurakura, nubwo rwaba ruri munsi ya gahunda. Iminsi idafite gahunda ntibarwa.
scheduleIntro_streak_captionMonths: Buri kwezi ugira uruhare mu murimo wongera ku rukurikirane rwawe. Gutegura bigufasha gukomeza.
scheduleIntro_grace_caption: Ufite kugeza ku iherezo ry'umunsi ukurikiraho kugira ngo wandike umunsi wari ufite gahunda, kandi tuzakwibutsa. Ntushobora kujya kubwiriza uwo munsi? Kuraho gahunda zawo hakiri kare.
scheduleIntro_grace_captionMonths: Ufite kugeza ku iherezo ry'ukwezi gukurikira kugira ngo wandike umurimo w'ukwezi, kandi tuzakwibutsa mbere y'uko karangira.
scheduleIntro_together_caption: Tumira bagenzi bawe muri gahunda zawe kandi mukomezanye. Bagenzi bawe bashobora kubona urukurikirane rwawe.
existingPlansForDay_description: Gahunda nk'izi kuri uyu munsi zirimo. Sunika hirya cyangwa hino kugira ngo usibe.
nwPublisherOnlyAllowsLastMonth: NW Publishwe ikwemerera gutanga raporo y'ukwezi gushize gusa.
howDoYouSubmitYourReport_description: Ohereza raporo yawe y'ukwezi ukanze rimwe.
howDoYouSubmitYourReport_info: Mu mpera za buri kwezi, WitnessWork ikwibutsa kohereza raporo yawe. Ntiyiyohereza yonyine; ifungura uburyo wahisemo, raporo yawe yamaze kuzuzwa kugira ngo uyisuzume. Ushobora guhindura ibi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu Mahitamo.
manageCustomFields_description: Ongera, hindura cyangwa uvanaho imyanya yihariye yawe.
archiveField_description: Kubika "{{label}}" bihisha umwanya kuri aderesi ariko bigakomeza kubika agaciro k'aderesi zose. Ushobora kuwugarura mu igenamiterere igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
archiveConversationField_description: Kubika "{{label}}" mu bubiko bituma uyu mwanya uhishwa mu biganiro, ariko agaciro kawo muri buri kiganiro gakomeza kubikwa neza. Ushobora kuwugarura uvuye ku rupapuro rwo kuwuyobora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

permanentlyDeleteConversationField_warni: Gusiba "{{label}}" burundu bikuraho uyu mwanya n'agaciro kawo kabitswe mu biganiro byose. Ibi ntibishobora gusubirwamo.
resetTimer_description: Urabura ibyari byabazwe nutangiza kubara. Urabyemera?
notEnoughTime_description: Igihe ntigihagije. Ugomba nibura kuba ufite 5 kugira ngo wemeze.
thisContactHasNoConversations: Uyu, nta biganiro muragirana kugeza ubu.
credit_description: Bishyira iki cyiciro mu gihe cy’indi mirimo cyemewe. Icyo gihe kibarwa mu giteranyo cy’ukwezi hakurikijwe umubare ntarengwa uri mu mahitamo y’Umubwiriza.
creditOverCapReasonNoneApplied: Impamvu: Amasaha atari ay'inguzanyo yamaze kugera cyangwa arenga igipimo cy'inguzanyo yawe.

overrideCreditLimit_description: By default, credit hours are limited to 55 hours total when combined with standard time. Special pioneers and circuit overseers have no limit by default.
customCreditLimitHours_description: Set your own credit limit in hours. Enter 0 for no limit.
witnessWorkNowSupportsCredits: Ubu Umurimo w'umuhamya yemerera gukoresha credits ku bafite intego y'umurimo mu mwaka. Numara guhuza n'igihe tag, raporo z'umurimo zawe nazo zizahuzwa n'igihe.
developerTools_info: Byongeraho urupapuro rw'Ibikoresho n'andi makuru ya tekiniki afasha gukemura ibibazo hamwe n'ubufasha. Bimwe mu bikoresho byongeraho amakuru y'ikitegererezo cyangwa bisiba amakuru burundu. Bireke bizimye keretse ubufasha bukubwiye kubifungura.
logHours_description: Kurikirana igihe cyawe ku bwawe. Byongeraho kubara igihe, buto ya Shyiramo igihe n'igice cy'Iterambere. Raporo yawe ikomeza kugaragaza gusa niba waragize uruhare mu murimo wo kubwiriza.
logHoursGoal_description: Si ngombwa. Siga kuri 0 kugira ngo wandike igihe nta ntego.
dontWantGoal_description: Shyira amasaha asabwa kuri 0. Ibi bikwemerera kubara amasaha yawe, nka abapayiniya.

faq_stillNeedHelp_description: Ohereza imeri kugira ngo ubone ubufasha bwihariye, menyesha ikibazo cya porogaramu, cyangwa usabe ikintu gishya ukoresheje amahuza ari hasi. Andika ibyo wagerageje, igikoresho cyawe na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, hamwe na verisiyo ya WitnessWork igaragara hano. Raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara ntizigomba kuba zirimo amakuru y'abantu, inyandiko bwite, dosiye z'ibibitswe, nomero za konti, Kode za Buddies cyangwa amahuza y'ubutumire. Levi asoma buri butumwa ubwe.

faq_timeRollover_a: Yego. Igice cy'amasaha ari munsi y'intego yawe ya buri kwezi gishobora kwiyongera kugeza mu kwezi gutaha. Fungura Preferences → Publisher hanyuma uhindure amahitamo ya rollover. Amasaha yatwawe agaragara mu buryo bwikora iyo ukwezi gutangiye, bityo ntukeneye gukuramo intoki cyangwa kongera kwinjiza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.
faq_bibleStudies_q: Ni mu buhe buryo inyigisho za Bibiliya zibarwa?
faq_bibleStudies_a: Ubushakashatsi bukorwa buri munsi, ntabwo bukorwa buri munsi. To count a study, open a contact, log a conversation, and mark it as "Conducted Bible Study." That contact will count as 1 study for the current month, even if you have multiple sessions with them. Kugira ngo wongere umubare w'abashakashatsi, andika ikiganiro cyo kwiga hamwe n'undi muntu ukora.
faq_iCloudSync_q: Nshobora guhuza amakuru yanjye hagati y'ibikoresho?
faq_iCloudSync_a: iCloud Sync ni ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri iOS. Fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync kuri buri gikoresho gishyigikiwe, ukoresheje konti imwe ya iCloud, kugira ngo uhuze inyandiko z'umurimo, abantu, gusura n'amahitamo yawe. Amafoto afite akuma gatandukanye kitwa Shyiramo amafoto mu guhuza. Iyo nta interineti ihari, imimerere igira iti Gutegereza interineti; impinduka zawe zibikwa ku gikoresho kandi zigahuzwa uzasubira kuri interineti. Niba igikoresho cyinjiye muri Apple Account itandukanye, iCloud Sync iracika kuri cyo mbere y’uko inyandiko iyo ari yo yose isomwa cyangwa yoherezwa, kandi zikomeza kuba ku gikoresho; fungura guhuza nanone kugira ngo uhitemo uko kizahuzwa n’amakuru ya iCloud y’iyo konti. Icyo gikoresho kandi kireka gusangira imimerere y'Umuterankunga yo kuri konti yawe ya mbere; niba yaraguzwe ukoresheje konti ya App Store y'iki gikoresho, koresha Garura ibyigeze kugurwa. Igikoresho cyashyizweho hakoreshejwe backup y'ikindi gikoresho gihuza ubwacyo nk'igikoresho gishya. Guhuza kalendari ni ikiranga gitandukanye kandi cy'ubuntu gishyira Gusubirayo byawe bizaza muri kalendari yihariye; ntigihuza inyandiko za porogaramu hagati y'ibikoresho. Kuri Android, Abaterankunga bahuza telefoni na tablet bya Android bakoresheje Google Drive Sync (reba “Nahuza nte amakuru yanjye hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android?”). Guhuza hagati ya iPhone n'igikoresho cya Android ntibishoboka; koresha Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura kugira ngo wimure backup hagati yabyo.
faq_googleDriveSync_q: Nahuza nte amakuru yanjye hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android?
faq_googleDriveSync_a: Google Drive Sync ni ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri Android, kikiri mu igeragezwa (beta). Kuri buri telefoni cyangwa tablet ya Android, fungura Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync ufungure Guhuza na Google Drive, hanyuma uhitemo Konti imwe ya Google mu idirishya rya Google, wemere ko WitnessWork ibika amakuru yayo muri Google Drive yawe. Ihuza inyandiko z'umurimo, gahunda, abantu, gusura, ibyiciro, ibirometero, umwirondoro n'amahitamo asangiwe; amafoto afite akuma gatandukanye kitwa Shyiramo amafoto mu guhuza. Buri gikoresho gifite akuma kacyo, kandi ibintu nk'uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru, uruhushya rw'isesengura n'intangiriro (onboarding) bikomeza kuba kuri buri gikoresho. Mu gihe WitnessWork ifunguye, impinduka ziturutse ku bindi bikoresho byawe zihagera mu gihe cy'umunota umwe cyangwa hafi, naho ubundi ubutaha uyifunguye; kanda Huza ubu kugira ngo urebe ako kanya. Ku gikoresho gishya cya Android, hitamo Kuri Google Drive ku rupapuro rwo gutangira rwitwa “Ngaho nimukomeze mujye aho mwasize” kugira ngo ugarure amakuru yawe, ibyo bikazana n'imimerere yawe y'Umuterankunga igihe iyo Konti ya Google ihujwe. Niba igikoresho gihuje Konti ya Google itandukanye, guhuza birazima kuri cyo mbere y'uko hagira icyo gisomwa cyangwa cyoherezwa, kandi inyandiko zawe zikomeza kuba ku gikoresho. Guhuza hagati ya iPhone n'igikoresho cya Android ntibishoboka; koresha Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura kugira ngo wimure backup hagati yabyo.
faq_googleDriveSyncPrivacy_q: Google Drive Sync ibika iki, kandi ni nde ushobora kukibona?
faq_googleDriveSyncPrivacy_a: Buri gikoresho cya Android kibika kopi imwe y'amakuru yawe ya WitnessWork, hamwe n'amafoto (niba uyahisemo), mu bubiko buhishwe bwa porogaramu muri Google Drive ya konti wahujije. WitnessWork yonyine ni yo ishobora gufungura ubwo bubiko: ntibugaragara muri porogaramu ya Drive cyangwa kuri urubuga rwayo, izindi porogaramu ntizishobora kubusoma, kandi WitnessWork ntishobora kubona ikindi kintu cyose muri Drive yawe. Amakuru yawe anyura mu buryo butaziguye hagati y'igikoresho cyawe na Google kandi ntanyura kuri seriveri za WitnessWork. Google iyabika kuri Konti yawe ya Google nk'izindi dosiye zawe za Drive; ntahishwe impande zombi (end-to-end). WitnessWork ibika ku gikoresho gusa kode imwe y'iyo konti ihujwe, itari imeri yawe. Ubwo bubiko bubarwa mu bubiko bwawe bwa Google. Kugira ngo ubukureho, zimya guhuza kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma muri Google Drive kuri murandasi ufungure Igenamiterere → Gucunga porogaramu → WitnessWork → Amahitamo → Siba amakuru ahishwe ya porogaramu. Gutandukanya Google Drive muri Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync bihagarika uburyo bwo kugera kuri Drive buturutse kuri icyo gikoresho kandi bisiga ubwo bubiko ku bindi bikoresho byawe. Kugira ngo ukureho uburenganzira bwa WitnessWork ku bikoresho byose, yikureho muri Porogaramu na serivisi z'abandi muri Konti yawe ya Google. Backup zawe za JSON zo muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura zirihariye kandi zikomeza kuba aho wazibitse.
faq_googleDriveSyncTroubleshooting_q: Google Drive Sync ntikora ku gikoresho cyanjye cya Android. Ni iki nakwemeza?
faq_googleDriveSyncTroubleshooting_a: Fungura Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync usome imimerere. Reba ko buri gikoresho gihujwe na Konti imwe ya Google kandi ko serivisi za Google Play zashyizweho kandi zivuguruye. Niba imimerere ivuga ko ugomba kongera guhuza, kanda Ongera uhuze Google Drive wemere kugera nanone; Google irabaza nanone iyo uburenganzira bwakuweho mu igenamiterere rya Konti yawe ya Google. Niba ububiko bwawe bwa Google bwuzuye, impinduka zawe zikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho kugeza habonetse umwanya; vanaho ibintu cyangwa ugure ububiko bwisumbuyeho, hanyuma ukande Huza ubu. Guhuza bikenera interineti; imimerere igira iti Gutegereza interineti kugeza usubiye kuri interineti, kandi impinduka zakozwe nta interineti zoherezwa icyo gihe WitnessWork ifunguye. Niba ivuga ko Google Drive irahuze, Google iri kugabanya ibyifuzo mu gihe runaka; impinduka zawe zikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho kandi guhuza kongera kugerageza ubwako. Niba igikoresho gikoresha verisiyo nshya ya WitnessWork, vugurura ibikoresho byose. Google Drive Sync ikenera uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga; niba burangiye, guhuza birahagarara hanyuma bigakomeza uburenganzira bugarutse. Bika backup yoherejwe n'igikoresho gifite amakuru yawe aheruka mbere yo kongera kubaka amakuru ya Google Drive. Vugana n'ubufasha bwihariye uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba guhuza bikomeje kunanirwa, kandi ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_calendarSetup_q: Nashyira nte Gusubirayo muri kalendari yanjye?
faq_calendarSetup_a: Guhuza kalendari ni ubuntu kuri iPhone, iPad na Android. Iki gisubizo kivuga kuri iPhone na iPad, naho Guhuza kalendari bikora bite kuri Android? kivuga kuri Android. Mu gihe cyo gutangira bwa mbere, cyangwa ukoresheje ubutumire buri mu rwego rw'amamenyesha nyuma yo kuvugurura, kanda Ongeraho kuri kalendari kugira ngo ukore kalendari ya WitnessWork (muri iCloud iyo iboneka). Ushobora no kubikora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari: emera kugera kuri kalendari yose, hanyuma ukore kalendari ya WitnessWork cyangwa uhitemo kalendari ikoreshwa kuri WitnessWork gusa. Kuvugurura bikenera kwinjira muri iCloud na interineti, no kuri kalendari za Google cyangwa Outlook. Kugira ngo ukoreshe Google cyangwa Outlook, kora kalendari kuri uwo mutanga serivisi, wongere konti muri Igenamiterere rya iPhone → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts, ufungure kalendari zayo. Kalendari yawe isanzwe na kalendari zibitswe kuri iki gikoresho gusa ntizishobora guhitwamo. Kalendari imaze guhitwamo, buri Gusubirayo kuzaza kongerwaho ubwako, harimo ibyo wari warabitse, nk'igikorwa cy'iminota 30. Guhuza kalendari byongeraho Gusubirayo byose bizaza cyangwa nta na kimwe; kugira ngo uhagarike kubyongeraho, bizimye muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari. Gusubirayo byashize, Gahunda z'umurimo na Gahunda zisubiramo ntibyongerwaho. Buri gikorwa gihabwa imenyesha rimwe n'urwibutso rwa Menyesha njyewe rwa Gusubirayo kwacyo, kandi nta menyesha iyo Menyesha njyewe izimye. Utanga kalendari yawe ashobora kongeraho amamenyesha ye asanzwe; kuri Google, ubikureho muri Event notifications ya kalendari muri igenamiterere rya Google Calendar. Hindurira muri WitnessWork, kuko impinduka zakozwe muri kalendari, harimo amamenyesha, zishobora gusimbuzwa ku vugurura rikurikira.
faq_calendarPrivacy_q: Guhuza kalendari bisangiza cyangwa bibika iki?
faq_calendarPrivacy_a: Mu buryo busanzwe, ibikorwa byoherejwe bigira umutwe rusange wa Gusubirayo, igihe n'igihe kizamara cy'gahunda, n'ihuza rifungura Gusura muri WitnessWork. Shyiramo amazina na aderesi ni uburyo bw'ubushake kandi bukoreshwa ku bikoresho byawe byose; kuwufungura byongeraho ayo makuru ku bikorwa byoherejwe. Inyandiko za Gusura n'ingingo za Gusubirayo ntizoherezwa na rimwe. Utanga kalendari wahisemo ashobora guhuza ibikorwa ku bindi bikoresho, kalendari zisangiwe na widget, bityo reba igenamiterere ryo gusangira ryo kuri iyo kalendari mbere yo gushyiramo amakuru arambuye. WitnessWork icunga gusa ibikorwa yashyizeho ikimenyetso ko ari ibyayo kandi ntinjiza gahunda zawe bwite zo muri kalendari. Inyandiko yihariye ya iCloud ibika amazina y'ibikoresho n'indangamuntu zihishe, nyiri ugutangaza, izina rya kalendari ihujwe n'ikimenyetso cya konti, amahitamo asangiwe, n'indangamuntu z'ibikorwa. Ibikubiye muri gahunda bikomeza kuba muri konti ya kalendari wahisemo. Indangamuntu ya kalendari ya buri gikoresho n'imimerere y'uguhuza bikomeza kuba ku gikoresho kandi bitandukanye no guhuza amakuru ya porogaramu cyangwa dosiye za backup.
faq_calendarPrimary_q: Kuki Guhuza kalendari bikoresha igikoresho nyamukuru?
faq_calendarPrimary_a: Igikoresho kimwe gusa ni cyo cyohereza Gusubirayo byawe kugira ngo birinde ivugurura rirushanwa. Igikoresho cya mbere gihuza kiba nyamukuru. Ku bikoresho bya iOS bikoresha konti imwe ya iCloud, fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari kugira ngo wandike buri gikoresho, urebe urutonde rw'Igikoresho nyamukuru, kandi uhitemo igikoresho nyamukuru. Guhuza kalendari ubwabyo ntibikenera kuba Umuterankunga. Gusubirayo byahinduwe ku kindi gikoresho bigera ku gikoresho nyamukuru bicishijwe mu guhuza amakuru ya porogaramu gusanzwe, bikenera Umuterankunga na iCloud Sync ifunguye; fungura WitnessWork ku gikoresho nyamukuru kugira ngo bibyoherezwe. Nyuma yo kwimura, igikoresho gishya nyamukuru gikeneye kugera kuri konti imwe ya kalendari n'uruhushya rwuzuye rwa kalendari. Niba kwimura bitegereje, ongera ufungure WitnessWork ku gikoresho nyamukuru cya mbere kugira ngo kirangize igikorwa cyahagaze. Nta gufata inshingano ku buryo bwikora hashize igihe niba icyo gikoresho kitazongera kuboneka; koresha ubufasha bwihariye buri munsi ya Uracyakeneye ubufasha? mu Kigo cy'ubufasha. Gukuraho igikoresho cyashaje ku rutonde ntibisiba inyandiko zacyo cyangwa ibikorwa bya kalendari.
faq_calendarTroubleshooting_q: Ibikorwa bya kalendari birabura cyangwa kuvugurura byarahagaze. Nakora iki?
faq_calendarTroubleshooting_a: Niba Guhuza kalendari kureka kuvugurura, amenyesha Ivugurura rya kalendari ryahagaritswe kigaragara mu rwego rw'amamenyesha (inzogera iri ku Ahabanza): ako kanya iyo hari ikigusabwa, nko kugera kuri kalendari, cyangwa nyuma y'umunsi ku bibazo bikunze gukemuka ubwabyo, nko kubura interineti. Kanda ugire icyo ukemura, cyangwa uhitemo Zimya niba utagishaka Gusubirayo muri kalendari yawe. Ushobora kandi gufungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari ugasoma ikosa ryerekanwa. Reba interineti yawe, kwinjira muri iCloud, konti ya kalendari, n'uruhushya rwuzuye rwa kalendari rwa WitnessWork mu Igenamiterere rya iPhone. Koresha Huza ubu ku gikoresho nyamukuru nyuma y'uko konti ya kalendari n'amakuru ya porogaramu birangiza guhuza. Kalendari yabuze igomba kongera guhuzwa cyangwa gusimbuzwa; kalendari zahinduriwe izina hanze ya WitnessWork zishobora gukenera guhitwamo nanone. Iyo igikorwa kizaza cyari cyoherejwe kibuze, kuvugurura birahagarara n'iyo iki gikoresho ari cyo cyakohereje: gutinda kw'guhuza kalendari, gusiba no kwimura igikorwa bishobora kugaragara kimwe. Tegereza ko konti ya kalendari irangiza guhuza kandi wemeze ko wahisemo kalendari imwe yihariye. Subiza inyuma ibikorwa bya WitnessWork wimuriye ahandi mbere yo kongera kugerageza. Garura ibikorwa byabuze ni uburyo bugaragara bwo gukosora nyuma y’ayo igenzura; ishobora gukora kopi zisubiramo niba kopi zikiri gukururwa cyangwa zikiri ahandi. Gusubirayo cyashize ntikongerwaho mu ntangiriro. Ku kwimura igikoresho bitegereje, ongera ufungure igikoresho nyamukuru cya mbere. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha ushyiremo verisiyo ya porogaramu, igikoresho na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, n'ikosa ryerekanwe. Ntushyire amakuru y'abantu, amafoto ya kalendari, inyandiko na backup muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_calendarDisconnect_q: Bigenda bite iyo nzimije Guhuza kalendari cyangwa nkavanaho WitnessWork?
faq_calendarDisconnect_a: Muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari, hitamo Zimya guhuza kalendari, cyangwa uhitemo Zimya ku kimenyetso Ivugurura rya kalendari ryahagaritswe. Ku gikoresho nyamukuru, kivugurura kalendari yawe, ushobora kubika ibikorwa bimaze kongerwaho cyangwa ukabikuraho. Kuraho ibikorwa bikuraho ibikorwa bifite ikimenyetso muri kalendari wahisemo, harimo amateka yoherejwe mbere; ibikorwa bitari ibya WitnessWork na kalendari ubwayo bisigara. Kuzimya ku gikoresho nyamukuru bihagarika kuvugurura kuri buri gikoresho. Ku kindi gikoresho cyose, Guhuza kalendari kuzima kuri icyo gikoresho gusa kandi ibikorwa bigasigara. Ibikorwa wabitse, cyangwa bisigaye nyuma yo kuvanaho porogaramu, ntibigivugururwa kugeza wongeye gutegura Guhuza kalendari. Kuvanaho WitnessWork ntibikuraho ibikorwa bya kalendari. Ushobora gukuraho kalendari yihariye idakoreshwa muri porogaramu yawe ya kalendari umaze kwemeza ko nta kintu ushaka kubika irimo. Kuzimya Guhuza kalendari ntibisiba Abantu, Gusura cyangwa Gusubirayo byawe muri WitnessWork.
faq_calendarAndroid_q: Guhuza kalendari bikora bite kuri Android?
faq_calendarAndroid_a: Guhuza kalendari ni ubuntu kuri Android. Mu gihe cyo gutangira bwa mbere, mu butumire buri mu rwego rw'amamenyesha, cyangwa muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Guhuza kalendari, kanda Ongeraho kuri kalendari cyangwa Hitamo kalendari, hanyuma wemere kugera kuri kalendari. Kora kalendari ya WitnessWork kuri iki gikoresho, cyangwa uhitemo kalendari isanzweho ikoreshwa kuri WitnessWork gusa, nk'iyo wakoreye muri Google Calendar ugashyiraho ko ihuzwa n'iyi telefoni. Kalendari yakozwe ku gikoresho ikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho; kalendari ya Google igaragara no ku bindi bikoresho byawe no kuri murandasi. Kalendari nkuru ntishobora guhitwamo. Buri Gusubirayo kuzaza noneho kongerwaho nk'igikorwa cy'iminota 30 gifite imenyesha rimwe n'urwibutso rwa Menyesha njyewe; Guhuza kalendari byongeraho Gusubirayo byose bizaza cyangwa nta na kimwe. Gusubirayo byashize na Gahunda ntibyongerwaho. Kuvugurura bikorwa iyo ufunguye WitnessWork no nyuma y'uko ubitse impinduka, kandi Huza ubu bivugurura ako kanya. Ibisobanuro bya buri gikorwa bifite ihuza rya WitnessWork rigaragaza Gusubirayo kwacyo, bityo ivugurura rihindura igikorwa gisanzweho aho kongeraho ikindi, n'iyo ikindi gikoresho cya Android kivugurura kalendari imwe ya Google. Ntuhindure iryo huza. Igikorwa usibye muri porogaramu ya kalendari kigaruka ku vugurura rikurikira. Android nta gikoresho nyamukuru igira kandi ntikoresha iCloud, kandi Shyiramo amazina na aderesi bikoreshwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa. Niba kuvugurura bihagaze, urugero kuko uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri kalendari bwazimijwe, amenyesha Ivugurura rya kalendari ryahagaritswe kigaragara mu rwego rw'amamenyesha; kanda ugire icyo ukemura, cyangwa ufungure Guhuza kalendari usome ikosa, hanyuma ukoreshe Fungura Igenamiterere cyangwa Huza ubu. Zimya guhuza kalendari ubika cyangwa ukuraho ibikorwa bya WitnessWork; ntibisiba kalendari cyangwa ibindi bikorwa byawe. Kuvanaho WitnessWork bisiga ibikorwa byayo, bityo ubikureho mbere niba utabishaka. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye buri munsi ya Uracyakeneye ubufasha? mu Kigo cy'ubufasha, kandi ntushyire amakuru y'abantu n'amafoto ya kalendari muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_widgets_q: Are there home or lock screen widgets?
faq_widgets_a: Yego, kuri iOS. Kanda igihe kirekire ku rugo rwawe cyangwa kuri ecran ifunze, kanda kuri buto +, shakisha WitnessWork, hanyuma uhitemo widget wifuza. Widget y'amasaha yerekana iterambere ryawe rya buri kwezi.
faq_appleWatch_a: Yego, kuri iPhone ifite Apple Watch ikoresha watchOS 26 cyangwa irenzeho. Ishyirwaho ubwayo niba Automatic App Install ifunguye; naho ubundi fungura porogaramu ya Watch kuri iPhone yawe, shaka WitnessWork muri Available Apps, hanyuma ukande Install. Hanyuma fungura WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe rimwe kugira ngo isaha yawe ibone iterambere ryawe. Ku isaha ushobora kongeraho igihe cy'uyu munsi hamwe n'Ubwoko (si ngombwa), gutangiza no guhagarika by'agateganyo igihe kibarwa cya iPhone yawe, no kubika igihe cyacyo nk'inyandiko. Niba utandika amasaha nk'Umubwiriza w'Ubwami, ushobora kwerekana ko wasangije abandi ubutumwa bwiza muri uku kwezi. Complication ebyiri zishobora gushyirwa ku isura y'isaha cyangwa muri Smart Stack: Iterambere ry'ukwezi rigaragaza amasaha yawe ugereranyije n'intego y'uku kwezi, rifite akamenyetso ku hantu gahunda zawe zikugeza uyu munsi; mu mwanya uzengurutse ushobora guhitamo uruziga cyangwa igipimo, intego yawe iri ku mpera yarwo cyangwa isaha iri munsi, kandi nta ntego, rigaragaza amasaha yawe gusa. Ibikurikira bigaragaza gusubirayo kwawe gukurikira cyangwa gahunda yawe ikurikira. Ushobora kandi gukoresha Siri ku isaha yawe kugira ngo wongereho igihe, utangize, uhagarike cyangwa uhagarike burundu igihe kibarwa, wandike urugendo, ukoresheje amagambo amwe nko kuri iPhone, nka "Ongeraho igihe muri WitnessWork" cyangwa "Andika urugendo muri WitnessWork". iPhone yawe ni yo ibika inyandiko zawe. Isaha yakira iterambere ryawe ry'ukwezi, imimerere ya raporo, igihe kibarwa, Ubwoko, amazina y'imodoka n'igipimo cy'intera, naho kuri Ibikurikira yakira izina, aderesi n'ingingo bya gusubirayo kwawe, n'umutwe n'ahantu bya gahunda zawe z'ibyumweru bibiri biri imbere. Ntiyakira inyandiko cyangwa andi makuru y'abantu, kandi ntishobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba inyandiko. Porogaramu y'isaha ikenera iPhone yawe, bityo ntiboneka kuri Apple Watch yashyizweho hakoreshejwe Family Setup. Ukoresha telefoni ya Android, koresha porogaramu ya Wear OS aho.
faq_appleWatchUpNext_q: Ibikurikira kuri Apple Watch yanjye bigaragaza iki?
faq_appleWatchUpNext_a: Ibikurikira bigaragaza icyo kibanjirije ikindi: gusubirayo kwawe gukurikira cyangwa gahunda yawe ikurikira. Gahunda zigaragara gusa niba wandika amasaha. Ongeraho complication ya Ibikurikira ku isura y'isaha cyangwa muri Smart Stack: kanda ufate ku isura y'isaha ukande Edit, cyangwa ukoreshe porogaramu ya Watch kuri iPhone yawe. Kiba kandi ku rupapuro rw'ibanze rwa porogaramu y'isaha. Gusubirayo cyangwa gahunda bikomeza kugaragara iminota 15 nyuma yo gutangira, kugira ngo urebe aderesi cyangwa ingingo ugeze aho, hanyuma ikurikira ikabisimbura. Gahunda idafite igihe cyo gutangira yerekanwa umunsi wose, nyuma y'ibifite igihe by'uwo munsi. Gusubirayo byatinze ntibigaragara; ubibone muri WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe. Amazina n'ingingo bihishwa iyo ukuboko kwawe kuri hasi cyangwa isaha yawe ifunze, kuko abandi bashobora kubona isura y'isaha yawe. Kanda Ibikurikira kugira ngo ubifungure, hanyuma ukande Inzira kugira ngo ubone inzira muri Maps ku isaha yawe, cyangwa Tangiza igihe kibarwa kugira ngo utangize igihe kibarwa cy'umurimo cya iPhone yawe kuri gahunda; igihe kibarwa gikenera iPhone yawe iri hafi. Ibikurikira bireba ibyumweru bibiri biri imbere kandi bikomeza kugenda iPhone yawe itari hafi. Impinduka ukora kuri iPhone yawe zigera ku isaha yawe ubutaha zihuye. Niba itaravugururwa, fungura WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe, hanyuma ku isaha yawe. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha ihuza ry'ubufasha bwihariye ryo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_siri_q: Nshobora gukoresha Siri cyangwa Shortcuts na WitnessWork?
faq_siri_a: Yego, kuri iPhone na iPad zifite iOS 17 cyangwa irenzeho, no kuri porogaramu ya Apple Watch. Fungura WitnessWork rimwe nyuma yo kuvugurura, hanyuma uvuge "Ongeraho igihe muri WitnessWork" (cyangwa "Andika igihe muri WitnessWork"), "Tangiza igihe cyanjye kibarwa muri WitnessWork", "Hagarika by'agateganyo igihe cyanjye kibarwa muri WitnessWork", "Hagarika igihe cyanjye kibarwa muri WitnessWork", "Andika urugendo muri WitnessWork" cyangwa "Andika urugendo rwo kugenda no kugaruka muri WitnessWork". Siri yumva mu rurimi rwa Siri rwawe, rushobora gutandukana n'urwo wahisemo muri WitnessWork. Siri ibaza igihe kingana iki cyangwa intera ingana iki. Intera ikoresha igipimo cyawe cy'intera y'Ibirometero; ku rugendo rwo kugenda no kugaruka, vuga intera y'inzira imwe kandi irikuba kabiri. Guhagarika igihe kibarwa byongeraho iminota yacyo yuzuye nk'inyandiko y'uyu munsi hanyuma kikongera gutangira kuri zeru; niba kitageze ku munota umwe, nta kintu cyongerwaho. Igihe n'ingendo byongerwaho ku munsi w'uyu munsi, nk'igihe gisanzwe kandi n'imodoka wakoresheje bwa nyuma. Kugira ngo uhitemo Ubwoko cyangwa imodoka, ongeraho igikorwa muri porogaramu ya Shortcuts, aho ushobora no kugikoresha ukoresheje Action Button cyangwa shortcut yo kuri Home Screen. Kongeraho igihe no gukoresha igihe kibarwa bisaba ko wandika amasaha (Ababwiriza b'Ubwami babanza gufungura Andika amasaha yanjye). Kwandika ingendo bisaba ko Kurikirana ibirometero ifunguye kandi ufite nibura imodoka imwe. Kuri iPhone na iPad igihe kibarwa gihinduka ako kanya, naho igihe n'ingendo wongeraho ukoresheje Siri bibikwa ubutaha ufunguye WitnessWork, hanyuma bigera ku bindi bikoresho byawe bicishijwe muri iCloud Sync nk'inyandiko iyo ari yo yose. Ku isaha byoherezwa kuri iPhone yawe nk'izindi nyandiko zo ku isaha. Siri ishobora gukoresha gusa Ubwoko bwawe, amazina y'imodoka, igipimo cy'intera n'igihe kibarwa biva muri WitnessWork, kandi ntishobora gukoresha abantu, inyandiko cyangwa raporo. Siri na Shortcuts ntibiboneka kuri Android. Niba Siri itamenye interuro, fungura WitnessWork rimwe, utegereze umunota, hanyuma urebe ko Siri yemerewe WitnessWork muri Igenamiterere. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha ihuza ry'ubufasha bwihariye ryo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire inyandiko zawe muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_appleWatchSync_q: Kuki Apple Watch yanjye igira iti Guhuza na iPhone?
faq_appleWatchSync_a: Igihe n'ingendo wongeraho ku isaha yawe byoherezwa kuri iPhone yawe ako kanya iyo iri hafi, cyangwa ubutaha zihuye, kandi bikabikwa WitnessWork ikora kuri iPhone yawe. Kugeza icyo gihe isaha yawe igaragaza Guhuza na iPhone. Igiteranyo cyayo na complication zayo birimo icyo gihe ako kanya, uretse Igihe cy'inyongera, cyongerwaho iPhone yawe imaze kukibika kandi gishyirwaho imbibi z'ukwezi z'inyongera. Buri nyandiko igumana umunsi wayongeyeho ku isaha, ibikwa rimwe gusa n'iyo yoherejwe kabiri, kandi ntigarurwa niba wari warayisibye kuri iPhone yawe. Inyandiko zibitswe zigera ku bindi bikoresho byawe zicishijwe muri iCloud Sync nk'izindi nyandiko zose. Gutangiza, guhagarika by'agateganyo, guhagarika no kubika igihe kibarwa bikenera iPhone yawe iri hafi. Niba isaha ivuga ko igihe kibarwa cyahindutse kuri iPhone yawe, reba igihe hanyuma ugerageze nanone. Niba isaha yawe ikomeza kutavugururwa, komeza iPhone yawe hafi kandi idafunze, fungura WitnessWork kuri iPhone yawe, hanyuma uyifungure ku isaha yawe. Nyuma yo gutangiza iPhone yawe bundi bushya, yifungure rimwe mbere yo guhuza. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha ihuza ry'ubufasha bwihariye ryo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire inyandiko zawe muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_wearOs_a: Yego, kuri telefoni ya Android ifite isaha ikoresha Wear OS 3 cyangwa irenzeho. Shyira WitnessWork kuva muri Play Store ku isaha yawe, cyangwa kuva ku rupapuro rwa WitnessWork muri Play Store kuri telefoni yawe, hanyuma ufungure WitnessWork kuri telefoni yawe rimwe kugira ngo isaha yawe ibone iterambere ryawe. Ku isaha ushobora kongeraho igihe cy'uyu munsi hamwe n'Ubwoko (si ngombwa), gutangiza no guhagarika by'agateganyo igihe kibarwa cya telefoni yawe, no kubika igihe cyacyo nk'inyandiko. Niba utandika amasaha nk'Umubwiriza w'Ubwami, ushobora kwerekana ko wasangije abandi ubutumwa bwiza muri uku kwezi. Ongeraho complication Iterambere ry'ukwezi na Ibikurikira ku isura y'isaha, na tile ya Iterambere ry'ukwezi kugira ngo utangize cyangwa uhagarike igihe kibarwa cyangwa wongereho igihe ukoresheje gukurura urutoki. Igihe kibarwa gikora, kigaragara ku isura y'isaha gifite Hagarika by'agateganyo na Hagarika; Hagarika yongeraho iminota yose y'igihe kibarwa nk'inyandiko y'uyu munsi. Emera amamenyesha isaha yawe iyabajije, kugira ngo igihe kibarwa gikora gishobore kuhagaragara. Telefoni yawe ni yo ibika inyandiko zawe. Isaha yakira iterambere ryawe ry'ukwezi, imimerere ya raporo, igihe kibarwa, Ubwoko, amazina y'imodoka n'igipimo cy'intera, naho kuri Ibikurikira yakira izina, aderesi n'ingingo bya gusubirayo kwawe, n'umutwe n'ahantu bya gahunda zawe z'ibyumweru bibiri biri imbere. Ntiyakira inyandiko cyangwa andi makuru y'abantu, kandi ntishobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba inyandiko. Kubera ko abandi bashobora kubona isaha yawe, Ibikurikira bigaragaza "Gusubirayo" aho kuba izina ku misura y'isaha, no muri porogaramu iyo ukuboko kwawe kuri hasi; fungura kugira ngo urebe uwo ari we. Wear OS ntishobora kongeraho igihe cyangwa kwandika ingendo mu majwi, bityo koresha tile cyangwa porogaramu aho. Porogaramu y'isaha ikenera telefoni yawe ifite WitnessWork yashyizweho.
faq_wearOsSync_q: Kuki isaha yanjye ya Wear OS igira iti Guhuza na telefoni?
faq_wearOsSync_a: Igihe wongeraho ku isaha yawe cyoherezwa kuri telefoni yawe ako kanya iyo iri hafi, cyangwa ubutaha zihuye, kandi kikabikwa ubutaha ufunguye WitnessWork kuri telefoni yawe. Kugeza icyo gihe isaha yawe igaragaza Guhuza na telefoni. Igiteranyo cyayo, tile na complication zazo birimo icyo gihe ako kanya, uretse Igihe cy'inyongera, cyongerwaho telefoni yawe imaze kukibika kandi gishyirwaho imbibi z'ukwezi z'inyongera. Buri nyandiko igumana umunsi wayongeyeho ku isaha, ibikwa rimwe gusa n'iyo yoherejwe kabiri, kandi ntigarurwa niba wari warayisibye kuri telefoni yawe. Gutangiza, guhagarika by'agateganyo, guhagarika no kubika igihe kibarwa bikenera telefoni yawe iri hafi, n'iyo WitnessWork itaba ifunguye kuri yo. Niba isaha ivuga ko igihe kibarwa cyahindutse kuri telefoni yawe, reba igihe hanyuma ugerageze nanone. Niba isaha yawe ikomeza kutavugururwa, reba ko ihujwe na telefoni yawe muri porogaramu yayo ihuza (companion app), komeza telefoni yawe hafi, fungura WitnessWork kuri telefoni yawe, hanyuma uyifungure ku isaha yawe. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha ihuza ry'ubufasha bwihariye ryo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire inyandiko zawe muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_switchingPioneer_q: Ni gute nahindura hagati y'umubwiriza n'umupayiniya w'umufasha hagati y'ukwezi?
faq_switchingPioneer_a: Fungura ahanditse ahanditse → Umwamamaji maze uhitemo ibikwiriye muri iki gihe: Umubwisi, Umupayiniya Umufasha, Umupayiniya Usaho, Umupayiniya Udasanzwe, Umugenzuzi w'Itorero cyangwa Umugenzuzi Mukuru w'Itorero. Goals and totals adjust to match. Subira inyuma igihe uzaba urangije. Past months keep the time you entered, so your history remains exact.
faq_submitReport_q: Does the app submit my service report for me?
faq_submitReport_a: WitnessWork ntiyohereza raporo yawe ahandi yonyine. Uko wohereza n'uwo woherereza biterwa nawe na komite y'umurimo y'itorero ryanyu. Fungura Raporo y'umurimo wo kubwiriza y'ukwezi, uhitemo uburyo mu rutonde rumanuka ruri hejuru ya buto Emeza, hanyuma ukande Emeza. Ushobora gukoporora incamake y'inyandiko isanzwe, kuyisangiza, cyangwa kuyiha Hourglass cyangwa NW Publisher ako kanya, zifunguka amasaha yawe, inyongera n'ibyigisho bya Bibiliya byamaze kuzuzwa kugira ngo ubisuzume ubyohereze. NW Publisher yemera gusa raporo y'ukwezi gushize. WitnessWork yibuka ibyo wahisemo; ushobora kandi kubihindura mu Mahitamo → Uburyo bwo kohereza.
faq_remainingHours_q: Ni gute namenya umubare w'amasaha nsigaje muri uku kwezi cyangwa mu mwaka?
faq_remainingHours_a: Open the Progress tab from the bottom bar. Igishushanyo mbonera cy'ukwezi kigaragaza igihe n'amasaha asigaye muri uku kwezi. Abapayiniya barashobora kwimukira kuri sub-screen y'umwaka kugira ngo barebe iterambere ry'intego y'umwaka, igihe kugeza ubu, amasaha asigaye, hamwe n'isesengura rya buri kwezi ugereranije amasaha nyayo na teganyo.
faq_goalPacing_q: Ni gute namenya niba ndi imbere cyangwa inyuma y'intego yanjye y'isaha?
faq_goalPacing_a: Fungura Iterambere ukoresheje umurongo wo hasi. Ecran ya Ukwezi igaragaza intego yawe ya buri munsi kugira ngo urebe niba uri ku murongo mu kwezi kwa none. Abapayiniya bashobora guhindukirira ecran ya Umwaka, aho ikarita y'Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo igaragaza uko uri imbere cyangwa inyuma y'Intego yawe y'umwaka uyu munsi, naho umurongo wa buri kwezi ugaragaza uko uko kwezi kwagenze ugereranyije n'intego yako.
faq_serviceYearPace_q: Nasoma nte ikarita y'Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo?
faq_serviceYearPace_a: Fungura Iterambere uhindukire kuri Umwaka. Niba imimerere yawe ifite Intego y'umwaka, nk'umupayiniya w'igihe cyose, ikarita y'Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo igaragara munsi y'intambwe zawe. Umurongo w'imvi ucagaguye ni aho Intego yawe y'umwaka ikugeza mu mpera za buri kwezi. Wubakwa ku ntego ya buri kwezi ubwayo, bityo gushyirwaho hagati mu mwaka cyangwa ukwezi k'ubupayiniya bwungirije bibihindura, ariko Intego y'ukwezi wihinduriye wowe ntibihindura.
