Umurongo w'icyatsi ni igihe cyawe kugeza ubu, kibarwa nk'uko Raporo yawe y'umurimo ibarwa, harimo imbibi z'inyongera za buri kwezi. Umurongo w'icyatsi ucagaguye wongeraho igihe wateganyije. Umurongo urabagirana gato ni umwaka w'umurimo ushize, ugaragara iyo warawanditsemo igihe, kandi umubare uri ku mpera yawo ni igiteranyo cy'umwaka ushize. Niba umurongo urenze cyane Intego yawe y'umwaka, umwanya uri hejuru y'intego ushushanywa ku gipimo gifunze (logarithmic) kugira ngo amezi ari munsi akomeze gusomeka. Kanda ufate ku ikarita, hanyuma unyuze urutoki, kugira ngo urebe ibiteranyo by'ukwezi kose. "Uri imbere y'umuvuduko" bigereranya igihe cyawe n'aho umurongo w'intego uri uyu munsi. Munsi y'ikarita, buri kwezi gifite umurongo: ukomeye ni igihe cyanditswe, woroheje ni igihe cy'inyongera, ufite imirongo ni gahunda, ufite akarongo ku ntego y'uko kwezi. Ibisobanuro biri hejuru y'amezi bisobanura ibyo bimenyetso, naho inkingi z'Amasaha na Ugereranyije n'intego zitanga imibare. Imirongo yose ikoresha igipimo kimwe, bityo ushobora kugereranya amezi. Nta Ntego y'umwaka, ubona imirongo y'amezi ariko ntubona ikarita. Niba ukwezi kugaragara nabi, kanda ukufate kugira ngo uhindure imimerere cyangwa intego yako. Ikarita ishushanywa ku gikoresho cyawe ikoresheje inyandiko zawe bwite kandi ntisangizwa.
faq_timeFormat_q: Nshobora kwerekana igihe nka "1h 30m" aho kuba "1.5"?
faq_timeFormat_a: Yego. Fungura Preferences → Appearance hanyuma uhitemo igihe ushaka. Aya mashusho yombi aboneka ahantu hose hagaragara.
faq_weekStart_q: Ese nshobora gutangira icyumweru ku wa mbere aho kuba ku cyumweru?
faq_weekStart_a: Yego. Ibyifuzo → isura bigufasha guhitamo umunsi wa mbere w'icyumweru. Iri tegeko rireba ingengabihe y'icyumweru, ingengabihe n'ibindi bikorwa byose by'icyumweru.
faq_darkMode_q: Ese nshobora gukoresha uburyo bw'umwijima cyangwa uburyo bw'urumuri?
faq_darkMode_a: Yego. Fungura Preferences → Appearance → Color Scheme hanyuma uhitemo System, Light, or Dark. Porogaramu ihagarika gukurikirana imiterere ya telefoni yawe hanyuma ukoreshe iyo uhitamo.
faq_appIcon_q: Ese nshobora guhindura indangamuntu ya porogaramu ya USU?
faq_appIcon_a: Amashusho asimburwa ya porogaramu ni inyungu y'Umuterankunga kuri iOS. Fungura Igenamiterere → Kwihitiramo → App Icon uhitemo ishusho isimbura. Amashusho asimburwa ya porogaramu ntaboneka kuri Android.
faq_reorderHome_q: Nshobora kongera gutumiza amakarita kuri ecran yanjye yo mu rugo?
faq_reorderHome_a: Yego. Fungura Preferences → Home Screen kugirango wereke, guhisha, no kongera gutunganya amakarita. Home Amakuru Amakuru Mashya Rayon Sports izakomeza gukurikirana imiterere y'ikipe y'igihugu Amavubi.
faq_reorderTabs_a: Yego. Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Uko utubuto dutondetse ukoreshe imyambi yo hejuru no hasi iri iruhande rwa buri gikoresho cy'ikibuto, cyangwa ukande igihe kirekire ku izina ry'ikibuto kugira ngo ukimure hejuru cyangwa hasi. Uko gukurikirana gushya gukoreshwa ako kanya ku murongo wo hasi ku matelefoni no ku murongo w'ibumoso kuri tablet, kuri iOS na Android. Utubuto dushobora gutondekwa ariko ntidushobora guhishwa. WitnessWork igifungukira ku Ahabanza, kandi Iterambere rigaragara gusa ku nshingano zandika amasaha; rigumana umwanya waryo mu gutondeka iyo uhinduye inshingano. Kuri iPad, ibimenyetso bya Command-nomero bya clavier na byo bikurikiza uko watondetse. Gutondeka ni ihitamo, bityo kubikwa muri backup kandi bihuzwa na iCloud iyo guhuza gufunguye; ntibihindura inyandiko zawe zose. Kugira ngo usubire uko byari bimeze, subiza utubuto kuri Ahabanza, Abantu, Iterambere, Ingengabihe. Niba gutondeka bidahinduka, ongera utangize porogaramu hanyuma ukoreshe Uracyakeneye ubufasha? hepfo.
faq_timerRounding_q: Why was my timer rounded to the nearest 5 minutes?
faq_timerRounding_a: Iyo yari imyitwarire ya kera. Version ziherutse kuzigama igihe nyacyo cyo guhagarara mugihe uhagaritse isaha, nta kuzunguruka. Niba ugifite iminota 5 yo kuzenguruka, vugurura porogaramu kuri verisiyo iheruka.
faq_addNotesToTime_q: Ese nshobora kongeramo inyandiko ku gihe cyo kwiyandikisha?
faq_addNotesToTime_a: Yego. Mu gihe wongeyeho cyangwa uhinduye inyandiko y'igihe, ushobora gushyiramo inyuguti (urugero: "Gutanga ubuhamya bw'ikarita" cyangwa "gukata ngufi"). You can also tag entries with categories so similar entries stay grouped in your time reports.
faq_specialPioneerAnnual_q: Ndi umupayiniya udasanzwe, kuki porogaramu inyereka intego y'umwaka?
faq_specialPioneerAnnual_a: Abapayiniya badasanzwe ntibagira intego y'umwaka. If yours appears, open Preferences → Publisher and turn off the annual goal. Your monthly goal remains in place and the annual bar on the Progress tab's Year sub-screen will be hidden.
faq_ldcCreditCap_q: Are LDC and other credit hours included in my totals?
faq_ldcCreditCap_a: Yego. Amasaha y'inguzanyo abarwa ku isaha yawe ya buri kwezi. Mu mwaka w'umurimo, amasaha 55 y'inguzanyo buri kwezi arabarwa, hakurikijwe ibipimo byatangajwe n'ishami. Buri kintu cyose kiri hejuru y'igipimo kiracyashyirwa ku rutonde rw'ibicuruzwa, ariko ntikijya mu gipimo cy'umwaka.
faq_timezoneShift_q: Will my time entries or plans shift days if I travel between timezones?
faq_timezoneShift_a: Oya. Kuva mu ivugurura rya Mata 2026, igihe cyose kwinjira na gahunda bihujwe n'itariki ya kalendari yigenga, bityo kugenda cyangwa kwambuka umupaka w'izuba ntibizamura kwinjiza ku wundi munsi. Older entries created before that update are migrated automatically the first time you open the new version. Niba ubonye inyandiko ku munsi utari wo nyuma yo kuvugurura, nyamuneka wohereze raporo ya bug hanyuma tuzareba.
faq_scheduleViews_q: Nteganya nte mu mezi menshi cyangwa nkareba umwaka wanjye w'umurimo wose?
faq_scheduleViews_a: Ingengabihe ifite uburyo bubiri bwo kureba; hindura hagati yabwo ukoresheje buto ziri hejuru. Ukwezi kigaragaza ibyumweru byawe nk'ikalendari imwe unyuzamo urutoki udahagarara ku mpera y'ukwezi, bityo ushobora gutegura uku kwezi n'ukuzakurikiraho icyarimwe. Ukwezi urimo gusoma guhora kurabagirana naho utundi tugahera, naho amakarita abiri ari hejuru ya kalendari agaragaza intego y'uko kwezi n'iy'ukuzakurikiraho: igihe cyanditswe, igihe giteganyijwe, n'igisigaye gutegurwa. Kanda ikarita kugira ngo ujye ku kwezi kwayo, cyangwa ukande iyo irabagirana kugira ngo urebe uko intego yuzuye, umuvuduko wa gahunda n'Umufasha. Buri munsi ugaragaza igihe wateganyije, cyangwa igihe wanditse iyo hari icyo wanditse. Kanda umunsi kugira ngo ubone cyangwa uhindure, cyangwa uwukande ugafate kugira ngo wongereho igihe cyangwa uwuteganye. Umwaka ugaragaza amezi cumi n'abiri y'umwaka w'umurimo (kuva muri Nzeri kugeza muri Kanama), buri munsi ufite ibara nka kalendari, hamwe n'intego yawe y'umwaka hejuru niba uyifite. Kanda ukwezi, cyangwa ufungure intoki zombi, kugira ngo ukwegere; funga intoki zombi muri Ukwezi kugira ngo usubire inyuma. Umurongo ufite izina ugaragaza aho umwaka w'umurimo umwe urangirira ukurikiraho utangirira; uwukande kugira ngo urebe uwo mwaka. Koresha imyambi cyangwa unyuze urutoki kugira ngo uhindure imyaka, hanyuma ukande Uyu munsi kugira ngo usubire. Uburyo bwombi bugaragaza gusa ibiri mu nyandiko zawe; guhindura uburyo bwo kureba nta cyo bisangiza.
faq_planDetails_q: Ni iki kiri ku rupapuro rwa Gahunda, kandi nyihindura nte?
faq_planDetails_a: Kanda umunsi ku Ingengabihe, hanyuma ukande imwe muri Gahunda zawo, cyangwa ukande Gahunda ku Ahabanza, kugira ngo uyifungure. Urupapuro rwayo rugaragaza itariki, igihe itangirira n'igihe irangirira (hamwe n'itariki y'umunsi ukurikira niba irenga saa sita z'ijoro) cyangwa Igihe cyose kuri Gahunda idafite igihe, igihe imara, Ubwoko bwayo, inshuro isubirwamo, ahantu, n'icyitonderwa; kanda ahantu kugira ngo uhafungure muri Maps. Kugira ngo uhindure Gahunda, kanda Hindura (ikaramu). Kuri gahunda yisubiramo, kubika bibaza niba impinduka ireba gusa iyi tariki, iyi n'izizakurikiraho, cyangwa amatariki yose. Ibindi (•••) birimo Kora kopi, Andika nk'igihe (ku munsi w'uyu munsi cyangwa mbere), Fungura muri Maps, Koporora aderesi, Koporora icyitonderwa, na Siba. Hamwe na Buddies, urupapuro runerekana abo watumiye n'uko buri wese yasubije, hamwe n'uwo ari we wese wasabye kwifatanya, hamwe na Tumira. Kanda Tumira bagenzi kugira ngo utumire umuntu ako kanya mu gihe Gahunda ikiri imbere; bahabwa itariki, igihe, umutwe, ahantu n'icyitonderwa. Kugira ngo ukureho umuntu, koresha Hindura. Kuri Gahunda wifatanyije binyuze ku butumire bwa mugenzi wawe, urupapuro rugaragaza uwayitegetse n'igisubizo cyawe. Hindura hagati ya Ndagenda na Sinshobora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose kugeza umunsi umwe nyuma ya Gahunda: Sinshobora ikura Gahunda ku ngengabihe yawe, naho Ndagenda ikayigarura.
faq_editRecurringPlan_q: Ese nshobora gukuraho cyangwa gukuraho inyandiko imwe y'ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe?
faq_editRecurringPlan_a: Yego. Ku Ingengabihe, kanda umunsi, hanyuma ukande gahunda kugira ngo uyifungure. Kugira ngo uhindure gusa iyo tariki, kanda Hindura (ikaramu), kora impinduka zawe, ubike, hanyuma uhitemo Gusa kuri iyi tariki. Guhindura Ubwoko, umutwe cyangwa ahantu ku itariki imwe bituma iyo tariki iba gahunda yayo y'inshuro imwe. Kugira ngo ukureho gusa iyo tariki, kanda Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda. Gahunda yawe yisubiramo ikomeza uko iri ku yindi minsi yose.
faq_awayDay_q: How do I mark a day I'm not going out without breaking my repeat plan?
faq_awayDay_a: Kanda gahunda iri kuri uwo munsi ku Ingengabihe kugira ngo uyifungure, kanda Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda. Kora ibi kuri buri gahunda yo kuri uwo munsi. Hakurwaho gusa uwo munsi, kandi gahunda yisubiramo ikomeza guhera ku munsi ukurikira. Kugira ngo ujye kubwiriza mu kindi gihe kuri uwo munsi, kanda Hindura, uyihindure, hanyuma uhitemo Gusa kuri iyi tariki iyo ubitse.
faq_multiplePlansOneDay_q: Nshobora guteganya ibikorwa birenze kimwe ku munsi umwe?
faq_multiplePlansOneDay_a: Yego. Umunsi ushobora kugira gahunda nyinshi uko ushaka, z'inshuro imwe, zisubiramo, cyangwa zombi, nko kubwiriza buri wa gatanu mu gitondo n'icyigisho cya Bibiliya buri wa gatanu nimugoroba. Gahunda zose zo ku munsi zirakusanywa: igihe giteganyijwe cy'uwo munsi ku ngengabihe, igihe gisigaye gutegurwa, n'igiteranyo cyawe giteganyijwe byose bibara buri imwe. Kugira ngo wongereho indi gahunda, kanda umunsi ku Ingengabihe, hanyuma ukande + iruhande rwa Gahunda. Kugira ngo usimbuke gahunda yisubiramo ku munsi umwe, uyifungure, kanda Ibindi (•••), hanyuma Siba → Siba iyi gahunda; indi minsi yawe ikomeza uko iri. Kugira ngo uyihindure ku munsi umwe gusa, kanda Hindura uhitemo Gusa kuri iyi tariki iyo ubitse. Mbere, gahunda z'inshuro imwe zasimbuzaga gahunda zisubiramo z'umunsi. Igihe wavugururaga, iminsi byabayeho yashyizweho yo gusimbuka gahunda yisubiramo, bityo ibiteranyo byawe ntibyahindutse. Niba umunsi ugaragaza igihe kirenze icyo utekereza, uwukande usibe gahunda udakeneye. Gahunda zikomeza ku gikoresho cyawe, zihuzwa na iCloud Sync niba wayifunguye, kandi umunsi wazo, igihe n'uburebure gusa ni byo bisangizwa bagenzi bawe niba ukoresha Buddies.
faq_planJustHours_q: Nshobora guteganya amasaha nta gutoranya igihe?
faq_planJustHours_a: Yego. Ku ifishi ya Gahunda, kanda buto Bimara igihe kingana iki? iruhande rw'itariki. Hitamo Amasaha gusa kugira ngo uteganye amasaha y'uwo munsi nta gihe, cyangwa Igihe cyuzuye kugira ngo uhitemo igihe utangirira n'igihe urangirira; amasaha arakusanywa kuri wowe. Gahunda nshya zifungukira muri ubwo buryo wakoresheje bwa nyuma, bityo uburyo busanzwe bwawe buba bwiteguye ubutaha. Gahunda ya Amasaha gusa igaragaza Igihe cyose ku Ingengabihe yawe kandi ibarwa ku ntego zawe nk'izindi Gahunda zose. Menyesha njyewe ifunguye, iguhumuriza saa 8:00 z'igitondo cy'uwo munsi aho kuba mbere y'igihe cyo gutangira. Bagenzi wawe utumira babona umunsi n'igihe imara, nta saha. Kugira ngo uyihe igihe nyuma, hindura Gahunda uhindukire kuri Igihe cyuzuye. Niba ikindi gikoresho cyawe kigikoresha verisiyo ishaje ya WitnessWork, kigaragaza Gahunda saa sita kugeza kivuguruwe.
faq_planFirstMonth_a: Yego. Mu gihe cyo gutegura, niba wandika amasaha kandi ufite intego y'ukwezi, ubona incamake yihuse y'Umufasha: hitamo iminsi ujyaho kubwiriza kenshi, ugabanye intego yawe kuri iyo minsi y'uku kwezi, cyangwa ukwezi gukurikira niba hasigaye iminsi itarenze irindwi. Kanda umunsi uwo ari wo wose kugira ngo uhindure gahunda yawo ukoresheje slider, cyangwa uteganye umunsi wowe ubwawe. Kanda Ongeraho kuri ingengabihe yanjye kugira ngo uzibike nka gahunda ku Ingengabihe, aho ushobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba iyo ari yo yose, cyangwa ukande Nzateganya nyuma kugira ngo ukomeze nta gahunda. Iminsi y'icyumweru utahisemo iba iminsi y'ikiruhuko, bityo Umufasha ntazagusaba gahunda kuri yo; hindura ibi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Gahunda → Kuboneka. Nyuma yo gutegura, uteganya ku Ingengabihe ukanda umunsi uwo ari wo wose, kandi Umufasha uriho agusaba gahunda igihe cyose ubuze ku ntego yawe. Gahunda zibikwa hamwe n'izindi nyandiko zawe kandi ntizibarwa ku raporo yawe; andika igihe ukoresha koko. Ababwiriza b'Ubwami batandika amasaha, n'umuntu wese udafite intego y'ukwezi, basimbuka iki gice ariko bashobora kongeraho gahunda bakoresheje Ingengabihe.
faq_importContacts_q: Ese nshobora kwinjiza contacts muri book ya aderesi ya telefoni yanjye?
faq_importContacts_a: Si muri iki gihe. Contacts are entered manually in WitnessWork. This keeps your ministry contacts private and avoids accidentally pulling in personal contacts.
faq_importOtherApps_q: Nshobora kwinjiza amakuru kuri MyTime, Ministry Assistant, cyangwa indi porogaramu?
faq_importOtherApps_a: Backup za MyTime zirashyigikiwe. Fungura Igenamiterere → MyTime Import, uhitemo backup y'umwimerere ya .mytimedb iva kuri MyTime, hanyuma usuzume incamake mbere yo kwinjiza. Imiterere ya backup z'izindi porogaramu ntishyigikirwa ubwayo. Niba ushobora kohereza inyandiko isomeka, Kwinjiza inyandiko bishobora gufasha kuyinjiza ukoresheje Scribe AI ku bikoresho bishyigikiwe iyo iboneka. Suzuma inyandiko n'imiburo bitangwa mbere yo kubika. Backup za WitnessWork za JSON zijya muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura.
faq_backupRestore_q: Ni gute nabika no kubika amakuru yanjye?
faq_backupRestore_a: Fungura Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura → Kora Backup cyangwa Garura ukoresheje backup kugira ngo wohereze cyangwa ugarure backup ya JSON kuri iOS cyangwa Android. Ku gikoresho gishya, ushobora kandi guhitamo Kuri dosiye y'ububiko ku rupapuro rwo gutangira rwitwa “Ngaho nimukomeze mujye aho mwasize”; kugarura aho birangiza gutegura hamwe n'umwirondoro wawe wagaruwe. Backup zirimo inyandiko z'umurimo, gahunda, abantu, gusura, ibyiciro, umwirondoro n'amahitamo asangiwe. Kugarura bisimbuza amakuru yo kuri iki gikoresho arimo; backup za kera zishobora kutagira ibyiciro cyangwa umwirondoro, bikomeza uko biri. Indangamuntu y'igikoresho, igenamiterere ryo guhuza rya iCloud cyangwa Google Drive, uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru, uruhushya rw'isesengura n'intambwe zo gutangira bikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho. Amafoto ntashyirwa muri backup za JSON. Ku mafoto ya iCloud kuri iOS, fungura guhuza amafoto ukwako. Bika backup ya none mbere yo kugarura kandi uyibike ahantu hiherereye; ishobora kuba irimo amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu. Koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha ku bufasha mu kugarura.
faq_shareAddress_q: Ni gute nabona amabwiriza yo kubonana n'umuntu runaka?
faq_shareAddress_a: Fungura aderesi hanyuma ukande kuri aderesi yawe. Uzahabwa Apple Maps, Google Maps, cyangwa Waze bitewe n'ibyo washyizweho. Urashobora kandi guhitamo aho uherereye udafite aderesi, ibi bikaba ari ingirakamaro kuturere tudafite nimero z'imihanda.
faq_manualPin_q: Igitambaro cyanjye kiri ahantu habi. Ese nshobora kuyihindura?
faq_manualPin_a: Yego. Fungura aderesi ya contact hanyuma ushyiremo pin ahantu hakwiye. Urashobora kandi gushiraho pin udafite aderesi na gato, ibi bifasha ahantu hatagira amakuru yihariye ya geolocation.
faq_profilePic_q: Ese nshobora kongeramo ifoto y'umuntu ku giti cyanjye?
faq_profilePic_a: Yego. Fungura contact, kanda kuri avatar, hanyuma utore ifoto mu isomero ryawe cyangwa ufate indi nshya. Ibi bifasha cyane cyane mu gihe abakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga basangiye amazina cyangwa iyo ifoto igufasha kumenya urugi rwiza.
faq_dismissContact_a: Fungura umuntu hanyuma ukande "Reka." Uzahitamo igihe uzamureka (icyumweru 1, ukwezi 1, amezi 3, amezi 6, cyangwa umwaka 1). Umuntu avanwa ku nyandiko zawe zikora muri icyo gihe, hanyuma agasubira ubwabyo igihe kirangiye. Niba amamenyesha afunguye, uzabona kandi urwibutso igihe agarutse, bityo abantu warekeye ntibazibagirana bucece. Ushobora kubona cyangwa kugarura abantu warekeye igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ukoresheje ihuza riri hasi ku rutonde rw'Abantu bawe, ibikubiyemo bya ••• muri Abantu, cyangwa Igenamiterere → Abantu warekeye.
faq_contactStalenessFilter_a: Munsi y'aho gushakisha muri Abantu, kanda akarango kugira ngo werekane gusa abantu bo muri iryo tsinda: Bamaze igihe, Uku kwezi, Iki cyumweru, cyangwa Ntiwigeze ubasura. Buri karango kagaragaza umubare w'abantu bakora kabamo, kandi ibara ryako rihura n'iry'akamenyetso k'umuntu ku ikarita. Nyuza uturango ku ruhande kugira ngo ubirebe byose. Kanda akarango nanone, cyangwa ukande Byose, kugira ngo werekane bose. Uturango tumwe tuba hejuru y'ikarita, aho tubara gusa abantu bafite aho baherereye kandi tunyungurura utumenyetso; dukubama iyo wimura ikarita, bityo kanda umutwe Abantu kugira ngo udusubize. Kugira ngo uhindure uko dukurikirana, kanda akarango, utegereze gato, hanyuma ugakurure ku murongo; Byose guhora ari ako mbere. Gutondeka ni ihitamo, bityo kubikwa muri backup kandi bihuzwa na iCloud Sync kuri iOS. Amatsinda yubakwa ku gusura kwawe kwa nyuma, kandi "Ntari mu rugo" bibarwa nk'gusura. Kugira ngo uhindure igihe umuntu ava mu itsinda ajya mu rindi, cyangwa amabara, kanda buto y'amakuru iri ku mpera y'uturango (ku ikarita, buto y'ibisobanuro) hanyuma ikaramu. Akarango kongeraho umuyunguruzi ushobora no kubona no gukuraho muri Tondeka & Shungura, kandi gakoreshwa ku rutonde no ku ikarita kimwe. Abantu warekeye ntibabarwa. Nta kintu gisangizwa; amatsinda abarwa ku gikoresho cyawe.
faq_reportBug_q: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
faq_reportBug_a: Koresha buto ziri hasi kugira ngo umenyeshe ikibazo cya porogaramu cyangwa usabe ikintu gishya. Andika intambwe zo kukigaragaza, ibyo wari witeze, igikoresho cyawe na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, hamwe na verisiyo ya WitnessWork igaragara munsi ya Uracyakeneye ubufasha?. Kuraho amakuru bwite y'abantu, inyandiko, nomero za konti, Kode za Buddies cyangwa amahuza y'ubutumire muri raporo n'amafoto ya ecran bishyirwa ahagaragara. Ku bibazo bya backup cyangwa ibindi byihariye, koresha ihuza rya imeri ryihariye riri muri Uracyakeneye ubufasha? aho. Kode y'inkomoko, Politiki y'ubuzima bwite, n'Amabwiriza yo gukoresha biri muri Igenamiterere → Ibyerekeye.
faq_translations_q: WitnessWork ishyigikira indimi ki, kandi nsobanura nte ubusobanuzi bwakozwe nabi?
faq_translations_a: WitnessWork iboneka mu ndimi 18. Ikurikiza ururimi rw'igikoresho cyawe mu buryo busanzwe; kugira ngo uhitemo urundi, fungura Igenamiterere uhindure Ururimi. Niba ururimi rwawe rudashyigikiwe, porogaramu yerekana Icyongereza. Ubusobanuro bukorwa hakoreshejwe AI, bityo ijambo cyangwa interuro bishobora rimwe na rimwe kuba bidahuye, cyane cyane amagambo Abahamya ba Yehova bakoresha mu buryo bwihariye. Kugira ngo umenyeshe imwe, koresha ihuza rya imeri riri muri Uracyakeneye ubufasha? ushyiremo ururimi rwawe, ecran, inyandiko ubona, n'icyo yagombye kuvuga. Ifoto ya ecran irafasha; banza upfuke amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko. Ibikosorwa bigera mu ivugurura rya porogaramu rikurikira. Nta mushinga w'abakorerabushake w'ubusobanuro wo kwifatanyamo ukiriho.
faq_becomeSupporter_q: What does becoming a Supporter unlock?
faq_becomeSupporter_a: Ifatabuguzi rikora ry'Umuterankunga rigufasha kubona ikimenyetso cy'Umuterankunga, amabara nyamukuru wihitiramo, uburyo bw'abantu bubitswe, na Tegura inzira y'uyu munsi, ishyira gusubirayo na gahunda by'umunsi mu murongo w'inzira ngufi, hamwe na iCloud Sync n'amashusho asimburwa ya porogaramu kuri iOS, na Google Drive Sync kuri Android. Abaterankunga kandi bahabwa umubare munini wemewe wa Scribe AI mu Kwinjiza inyandiko kuri iOS na Android aho iboneka; imibare yemewe y'ubuntu n'iy'Abaterankunga ubu igaragara mu Bufasha no ku rupapuro rw'inkunga. Ibiranga by'ingenzi bikomeza kuba ubuntu, harimo kuyungurura no gutondeka abantu, na Buddies iyo iboneka; Abaterankunga kandi bashobora guhitamo ibara rya buri mugenzi. Impano imwe (Tip) iguha izina ry'Uwatanze impano ariko ntifungura ibiranga by'Umuterankunga.
faq_stillFree_a: Yes — and will always be. Buri kintu cy'ingenzi kiba ku buntu kuri buri wese. Supporting is completely optional; Ifasha mu gutera inkunga iterambere rikomeza kandi igafungura ibintu bike by'umuntu ku giti cye nk'ishimwe ryo gushimira.
faq_stopSupporting_q: Bigenda bite mu gihe nahagaritse gushyigikirwa?
faq_stopSupporting_a: Kugira ngo uhagarike, fungura Igenamiterere → Gucunga ifatabuguzi uhitemo Gusesa cyangwa guhindura ifatabuguzi, cyangwa uhagarike mu mafatabuguzi yawe ya App Store cyangwa Google Play. Uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga bukomeza kugeza ku iherezo ry'igihe wishyuriye, kandi amakuru yawe asanzweho na backup zo ku gikoresho bikomeza kuboneka. Nyuma yaho, iCloud Sync irahagarara mu gihe uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga budahari. Niba guhuza byari bifunguye, bikomeza uburenganzira bugarutse; niba warahisemo kuzimya, bikomeza kuba bizimye. Guhuza amafoto bikurikiza igenamiterere ryako. Ibara ryawe nyamukuru n'ishusho ya porogaramu bisubira ku bisanzwe, ariko ibyo wahisemo bibikwa kugeza ukomeje gutera inkunga. Uburyo bw'abantu bubitswe buhishwa kandi ntibugikoreshwa, bityo Abantu hagaragaramo imyunguruzi yawe bwite; bugaruka uteye inkunga nanone. Reba Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync ku mimerere y'ubu. Niba ukeneye kuruhuka gusa, ushobora guhagarika by'agateganyo aho gusesa.
faq_pauseSupport_q: Nshobora guhagarika inkunga yanjye by'agateganyo aho kuyisesa?
faq_pauseSupport_a: Yego. Fungura Igenamiterere → Gucunga ifatabuguzi. Kuri iPhone na iPad, hitamo guhagarika kwishyura amezi 1, 3, cyangwa 6. Guhagarika bitangira igihe cyawe cy'ubu kirangiye. Ntukatwa amafaranga muri icyo gihe, kandi ibiranga by'Umuterankunga bikomeza, harimo iCloud Sync, ibara ryawe nyamukuru n'ishusho ya porogaramu. Kwishyura bisubukura ubwabyo ku mubare umwe ku itariki yerekanwe, kandi ushobora gusesa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu mafatabuguzi yawe ya App Store. Ushobora guhagarika rimwe mu mezi 12; amatariki yo guhagarika abikwa hamwe n'igenamiterere ryawe kugira ngo ibindi bikoresho byawe bibyubahirize. Kuri Android, hitamo Hagarika muri Google Play kugira ngo uhagarike ifatabuguzi ry'ukwezi ku kwezi amezi 1 kugeza kuri 3. Ibiranga by'Umuterankunga nk'ikimenyetso n'ibara nyamukuru na byo birahagarara, hanyuma bigasubira ubwabyo igenamiterere ryawe rikabikwa, kandi ushobora gusubukura hakiri kare muri Google Play. Uburyo bwo guhagarika ntibugaragara mu gihe cy'igeragezwa ry'ubuntu, ikibazo cyo kwishyura, ifatabuguzi rya Family Sharing, cyangwa mu mezi 12 uhereye ku guhagarika kwawe kwa nyuma. Niba guhagarika binaniwe, nta cyahindutse; ongera ugerageze nyuma cyangwa ucunge ifatabuguzi ryawe mu iduka ryawe. Ku bindi, koresha Uracyakeneye ubufasha? kugira ngo uvugane n'ubufasha mu ibanga.
faq_acceptDonations_a: Kubera ko ndi umuvandimwe wo mu Ngoro, mbona ari iby'agaciro gukoresha ubuhanga bwanjye mu gufasha abandi bo mu itorero. N'ubwo bimeze gutyo ariko, buri wese akoresha uburyo bwo kugenzura no kubungabunga ibidukikije, bitwara amafaranga menshi n'igihe. Njye mbona gutanga ari kimwe n'uburyo umuntu ashobora kwishyura gaz y'undi nyuma yo kujya mu murimo - ni igikorwa cy'urukundo gishimwa cyane.
faq_donationsUsedFor_a: Your donation helps keep this app running! There are costs with buying real devices as development equipment, paying for location API service fees, build service API fees, app store fees, and opportunity cost of my many hours spent developing this app. Buri gice cy'ubufasha kirashimwa cyane!
faq_whatsNew_q: Where can I see what changed in the latest update?
faq_findNavigation_q: Ikarita, Buddies na Igenamiterere biri he?
faq_findNavigation_a: Umurongo wo hasi ugaragaza Ahabanza, Ingengabihe, Abantu, na Iterambere, hamwe na Ongeraho iruhande rwabyo yo kwandika igihe, gukora Gahunda, cyangwa kongeraho umuntu. Iterambere na Ongeraho igihe bigaragara iyo inshingano yawe yandika amasaha. Ikarita iri muri Abantu: kanda buto y'ikarita iruhande rw'umutwe Abantu, maze WitnessWork ifungure uburyo wakoresheje bwa nyuma. Buddies, iyo iboneka kuri iOS, ifungurwa na buto ya Buddies iri hejuru ya Ingengabihe. Reba raporo iri hejuru ya Iterambere ifungura Raporo y'umurimo y'ukwezi urimo kureba. Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe iri hejuru ibumoso ku mpapuro zose z'ingenzi kugira ngo ubone Umwirondoro (inshingano yawe, igihe umaze mu murimo, n'imibare), Igenamiterere, Inkunga, n'Ikigo cy'ubufasha; ku miterere ya tablet ngari, Igenamiterere kandi rigumana mu murongo w'ibumoso. Niba warahishe umurongo w'ibumoso, kanda Erekana umurongo w'ibumoso mu mutwe w'urupapuro kugira ngo uwugarure. Niba warafunguye Hisha akamenyetso ko gutanga impano, Inkunga ivanwa muri iyo menu ikaguma mu Igenamiterere. Abantu, gahunda n'inyandiko byawe ntibihinduka; ahantu ubisanga ni ho hahindutse gusa. Niba hari ikintu kikiboneka ko cyabuze, vugurura porogaramu, hanyuma ukoreshe Uracyakeneye ubufasha? hepfo.
faq_tabletSidebar_q: Mpindura nte ubugari bw'umurongo w'ibumoso cyangwa nkawuhisha kuri tablet yanjye?
faq_tabletSidebar_a: Ku idirishya rigari rya tablet kuri iOS cyangwa Android, kurura akabari gato kari hagati mu nkombe y'iburyo y'umurongo w'ibumoso kugira ngo uhindure ubugari bwawo. Kugabanya umurongo bihisha amazina y'aho ujya bigasigaramo amashusho yabyo gusa; wongere ubugari kugira ngo amazina agaruke. Kanda Hisha umurongo w'ibumoso iruhande rwa WitnessWork (hejuru y'umurongo w'ibumoso urimo amashusho gusa) kugira ngo uhishe kujya ahandi burundu. Kanda Erekana umurongo w'ibumoso mu mutwe w'urupapuro kugira ngo ugarure ubugari bwawe bwa nyuma bwabitswe. Ubugari bwawe n'uko bugaragara bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho nubwo wafunga porogaramu; ntibihuzwa kandi ntibishyirwa muri backup z'umurimo, kandi guhindura ubugari ntibihindura inyandiko zawe. Umurongo w'ibumoso ukenera idirishya rya nibura points 1.000 z'ubugari n'ingano y'inyandiko ishyigikiwe. Mu idirishya rito cyangwa inyandiko nini cyane, umurongo wo hasi uragaruka ubwawo; ongera ubugari bw'idirishya cyangwa uhindurire iramburiye kugira ngo wongere ukoreshe umurongo w'ibumoso. Abakoresha porogaramu zisoma ecran bashobora guhindura igikoresho Hindura ubugari bw'umurongo w'ibumoso kugira ngo bongere cyangwa bagabanye ubugari bwawo. Niba kujya ahandi bikibura, ongera utangize porogaramu hanyuma ukoreshe Uracyakeneye ubufasha? hepfo; ntushyire amakuru y'abantu n'andi makuru bwite muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_whatsNew_a: Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, hanyuma Igenamiterere → Ibishya, ubone incamake y'impinduka ziheruka. Ivugurura rinini rinafungura urugendo rugufi ubwa mbere ufunguye porogaramu nyuma yo kuvugurura. Niba uhisemo Nyuma, inzogera y'amamenyesha igumana inzira ya bugufi igana kuri rwo, kandi Ibishya bifite buto yo gusubiramo urwo rugendo.
faq_notificationsTray_q: Ni iki kiri mu nzogera iri ku Ahabanza?
faq_notificationsTray_a: Inzogera iri hejuru ya Ahabanza ikusanya ibyibutso n'ivugurura, bityo bikaharira aho kwirundanya ku Ahabanza iyo ufunguye porogaramu. Uhasanga ibintu nka Raporo y'umurimo y'ukwezi gushize, kwimura igihe bitegereje, ibyibutso bya backup no kurinda amakuru, Gusubirayo byatinze, ibyibutso byamaze kugera, ibikorwa bya Buddies (aho Buddies iboneka), Kwinjiza inyandiko byiteguye, n'Ibishya. Akamenyetso gatukura kabara ibintu utaraba. Amakuru ava kuri bagenzi bawe, nk'ikimenyetso gishya cya mugenzi wawe cyangwa igisubizo ku cyawe, aba hasi munsi ya Ayo kuri bagenzi bawe kandi ntiyongera kuri uwo mubare; akadomo gato ku nzogera kerekana ko hari ayo ari mashya. Kanda ikintu kugira ngo ugire icyo gikoraho, kanda X kugira ngo ugikureho, cyangwa ukande Kuraho byose. Ubutumire n'ibisabwa bigitegereje igisubizo cyawe bigumaho kugeza usubije. Ikintu wakuyeho ntigaruka. Ibyo wabonye cyangwa wakuyeho bibukwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa.
faq_shareApp_a: Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, hanyuma Igenamiterere → Sangiza WitnessWork. Hitamo Android cyangwa iPhone, maze incuti yawe ishobore gusikana kode ikoresheje kamera ya telefoni yayo kugira ngo ifungure WitnessWork muri Google Play cyangwa App Store. Sangiza ihuza yohereza ubutumwa burimo amahuza yombi y'amaduka, bityo bikora ku muntu wese. WitnessWork ni ubuntu kuri byombi. Ubutumwa burimo amahuza y'amaduka gusa — nta kintu kikuvuga cyangwa inyandiko zawe. Niba kode itasikanwa, ongera urumuri rwa ecran yawe cyangwa ukoreshe Sangiza ihuza.
faq_android_a: Yego. WitnessWork yagarutse kuri Google Play, kandi ni ubuntu. Igihe na raporo, igihe kibarwa, abantu na gusubirayo, gahunda, ikarita (hamwe na Google Maps), ibirometero, ibyibutso, na backup byose bikora kuri Android. Buddies na yo ikora kuri Android, harimo na bagenzi bakoresha iPhone. Abaterankunga bashobora guhuza ibikoresho byabo bya Android bakoresheje Google Drive Sync. Ibiranga bimwe bishingiye kuri serivisi za Apple bigume kuri iPhone na iPad: iCloud Sync, widget, Live Activities, n'amashusho ya porogaramu. Kwinjiza inyandiko ukoresheje Scribe AI biri gutangwa buhoro buhoro kuri Android. Kugira ngo wimukire kuri telefoni nshya ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose, kora backup (Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura → Kora Backup), wimure dosiye kuri telefoni nshya, hanyuma uhitemo Kuri dosiye y'ububiko ku rupapuro rwo gutangira rwitwa “Ngaho nimukomeze mujye aho mwasize”. Hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android ushobora kandi guhitamo Kuri Google Drive aho. Bika dosiye za backup mu ibanga; zishobora kuba zirimo amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu.
openSourceLicenses_description: WitnessWork yubatswe ku mapaki {{packages}} y'inkomoko ifunguye. Urakoze ku bantu bayakomeza. Kanda paki kugira ngo ubone uruhushya rwayo n'inkomoko.
faq_about_q: Politiki y'ubuzima bwite, Amabwiriza yo gukoresha, n'impushya z'inkomoko ifunguye biri he?
faq_about_a: Kanda ifoto y'umwirondoro wawe, hanyuma Igenamiterere, maze umanuke ugere ku Ibyerekeye. Rifite amahuza ya Politiki y'ubuzima bwite, Amabwiriza yo gukoresha, na kode y'inkomoko ya WitnessWork. Ku bikoresho aho Kwinjiza inyandiko biboneka, rifite kandi ihuza rya politiki ya OpenRouter ZDR igenga inyandiko wohereza kuri Scribe AI. Impushya z'inkomoko ifunguye zirondora buri paki y'inkomoko ifunguye WitnessWork yubakishijwe, hamwe na verisiyo yayo, uruhushya n'uwayikoze; kanda paki kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwayo, rugaragaza uruhushya rwuzuye n'inkomoko. Shakisha ukoresheje izina rya paki, uruhushya cyangwa uwayikoze. Kanda igihe kirekire ihuza iryo ari ryo ryose kugira ngo ukopore cyangwa risangize.
faq_debugTools_a: Ibikoresho byo gukemurisha bifasha gukemura ibibazo hamwe n'ubufasha. Ubifungure muri Igenamiterere → Ibyisumbuye; bikoreshwa gusa ku gikoresho wabifunguyeho, kuri iOS na Android. Byongeraho urupapuro rw'Ibikoresho rufite ibikorwa byo gusuzuma, amakuru y'ikitegererezo no gukosora, bigaragaza amakuru ya tekiniki yiyongera kuri ecran zimwe, kandi bifungura kwandika amakuru arambuye yo gusuzuma. Ibikorwa bimwe by'Ibikoresho byongeraho amakuru y'ikitegererezo cyangwa bisiba amakuru burundu, bityo ubikoreshe gusa iyo ubufasha bubisabye, kandi banza ubike backup muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura. Gufungura cyangwa kuzimya akuma ntibihindura amakuru yawe; kazimye kugira ngo uhishe urupapuro rw'Ibikoresho n'amakuru yongeye.
faq_backupRecovery_q: Backup yanjye isa nk'idasomeka cyangwa inyandiko nagaruye zirabura. Nkore iki?
faq_backupRecovery_a: Backup ya WitnessWork ni JSON itunganyije igenewe porogaramu gusoma, bityo ntisa na Raporo y'umurimo ishobora gucapwa. Komeza dosiye y'umwimerere uko iri kandi uyigarure ukoresheje Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura → Garura ukoresheje backup. Niba inyandiko zibuze, bika backup y'umwimerere, kandi ukore backup itandukanye y'amakuru y'ubu y'igikoresho mbere yo kugerageza kugarura nanone. Ohereza imeri ku bufasha ushyiremo verisiyo ya porogaramu n'ibyabaye; tegura mu ibanga uko dosiye zisangizwa. Dosiye za backup zishobora kuba zirimo amakuru y'abantu n'inyandiko, bityo uzirinde muri raporo z'ibibazo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_syncTroubleshooting_q: Ibikoresho byanjye ntibiri guhuza. Nakwemeza iki?
faq_syncTroubleshooting_a: Kuri iOS, koresha Apple Account imwe, fungura iCloud Drive, hanyuma wemerere WitnessWork muri iCloud kuri buri gikoresho. Kuri Android, reba “Google Drive Sync ntikora ku gikoresho cyanjye cya Android. Ni iki nakwemeza?” iCloud Sync ikenera uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga. Fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync ukoreshe Huza ubu. Impinduka zitegereje koherezwa zongera kugeragezwa; dosiye idasomeka cyangwa verisiyo nshya ya porogaramu bigaragara mu mimerere, bityo vugurura ibikoresho byose hanyuma wongere ugerageze. Imimerere igaragaza Kohereza kuri iCloud kugeza Apple yemeje koherezwa, kandi Guhuza kwa nyuma kubara gusa ibyoherejwe byemejwe. Niba ububiko bwawe bwa iCloud bwuzuye, impinduka zikomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho; vanaho ibintu cyangwa wongere ububiko muri Igenamiterere → [Izina ryawe] → iCloud maze koherezwa gukomeza ubwako. Bika backup yoherejwe n'igikoresho gifite amakuru yawe aheruka. Ongera wubake amakuru ya iCloud isimbuza amakuru ya iCloud n'amakuru y'iki gikoresho kandi ikuraho amafoto ya iCloud atarimo gukoreshwa. Ibindi bikoresho byawe bihindukirira ayo makuru ubutaha bizahuza, bigasimbura impinduka zakozwe kuri byo mbere yaho, kandi inzogera yo ku Ahabanza irabigaragaza. Banza uvugurure WitnessWork ku bikoresho byose: verisiyo ishaje ikomeza amakuru yayo kugeza ivuguruwe. Vugana n'ubufasha bwihariye uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba guhuza bikomeje kudashira. Ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_syncPhotos_q: Kuki amafoto y'abantu abura ku kindi gikoresho cyanjye?
faq_syncPhotos_a: Guhuza amafoto ni ikiranga cy'ubushake cy'Umuterankunga kuri iOS na Android. Fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync (Google Drive Sync kuri Android) ufungure Shyiramo amafoto mu guhuza. Ibi byohereza amafoto y'umwirondoro n'ay'abantu mu bubiko bwawe bwite bwa iCloud (cyangwa mu bubiko buhishwe bwa WitnessWork muri Google Drive) kandi bigakurura amafoto yifashishwa; abarwa mu bubiko bwawe bwa iCloud cyangwa Google. Vugurura WitnessWork ku bikoresho byose kugira ngo ukoreshe ivugurura ry'amafoto neza. Guhagarika guhuza amafoto ku gikoresho kimwe bigumana dosiye zoherejwe na kopi zo ku gikoresho. Kugira ngo ukureho amafoto yoherejwe, hitamo Kuraho amafoto ya iCloud kandi banza uhagarike guhuza amafoto ku bindi bikoresho, bitabaye ibyo bishobora kongera kohereza kopi zabyo. Gukuraho umuntu cyangwa ifoto ye bikuraho kopi zakuruwe iyo iyo mpinduka ihagereye; kopi zishaje zo mu ikusanyirizo zisukurwa nyuma y'igihe cy'umunsi umwe cyo gutegereza. Niba ifoto ibuze, komeza igikoresho gifite iy'umwimerere, reba ububiko n'uburenganzira, hanyuma ukoreshe Huza ubu. Koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba bikomeje kunanirwa; ntushyiremo amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_mytimeTrouble_q: MyTime Import ivuga ko dosiye atari database. Nakoresha iki?
faq_mytimeTrouble_a: MyTime Import ikenera backup y'umwimerere ya .mytimedb yakozwe na MyTime. PDF, inyandiko yoherejwe, backup ya JSON ya WitnessWork, cyangwa dosiye yahinduriwe izina ikitwa .mytimedb ntibizakora. Bika kopi yuzuye ya backup ya MyTime ku gikoresho cyawe uyihitemo ukoresheje Igenamiterere → MyTime Import. Komeza dosiye y'umwimerere uko iri. Niba backup nziza ikomeje kunanirwa, ohereza imeri ku bufasha mu ibanga ushyiremo ikosa na verisiyo ya porogaramu; ntushyire backup mu kibazo gishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_notesImportHelp_q: Kwinjiza inyandiko bikora bite, kandi bigura iki?
faq_notesImportHelp_a: Iyo Kwinjiza inyandiko biboneka kuri iPhone, iPad cyangwa igikoresho cya Android gishyigikiwe, bifungure uciye mu Igenamiterere hanyuma ushyiremo inyandiko z'umurimo wo kubwiriza zisomeka. Kuri iPhone na iPad ushobora kandi kwandika mu majwi cyangwa gusikana ifoto y'inyandiko zawe. Scribe AI itanga igitekerezo cy'abantu, gusura n'inyandiko z'igihe; suzuma incamake, ibyo yitaye n'imiburo mbere yo kubika inyandiko wahisemo. Buto y'Ubufasha isobanura icyo gushyiramo kandi ikerekana imibare yemewe y'ubuntu n'iy'Abaterankunga y'ubu. Kwinjiza kunaniwe, guhagaritswe, no kwisubiramo ntibibarwa mu mubare wemewe. Ibyanditswe mu majwi n'amafoto bihinduka inyandiko ku gikoresho cyawe mbere. Inyandiko zawe zoherezwa kuri serivisi y'icyitegererezo cy'ururimi (language model) hakurikijwe amasezerano ya Zero Data Retention (nta makuru abikwa); amateka yo kwinjiza akomeza kuba kuri iki gikoresho. Ushobora kubona politiki ya OpenRouter ZDR mu Bufasha bwa Kwinjiza inyandiko cyangwa muri Igenamiterere → Ibyerekeye. Kuri Android biri gutangwa buhoro buhoro kandi bikenera WitnessWork iva kuri Google Play; reba Kwinjiza inyandiko bikora kuri Android?
faq_notesImportRetry_q: Kwinjiza inyandiko kwanze, kurakomeje gukora, cyangwa nta nyandiko kwabonye. Nkore iki?
faq_notesImportRetry_a: Reba interineti yawe ukurikize ubutumwa ubwo ari bwo bwose bugira buti Vugurura WitnessWork. Niba kwinjiza kugikora, ongera ufungure Kwinjiza inyandiko urebe amateka yako mbere yo gutangira indi kopi. Ku nyandiko nyinshi cyane, koresha ibice bito; niba Scribe AI itashoboye kuzisobanura, shyiramo amazina asobanutse, amatariki, n'igihe cyakoreshejwe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze. Niba serivisi itaboneka by'agateganyo, ongera ugerageze nyuma. Incamake nta nyandiko ifite bivuze ko nta kintu cyabonetse cyo kwinjiza. Suzuma incamake mbere yo kubika, kandi wohereze imeri ku bufasha mu ibanga niba ikosa rikomeje.
faq_notesImportAndroid_a: Yego, uko biri gutangwa. Iyo Kwinjiza inyandiko bigaragaye muri Igenamiterere kuri telefoni cyangwa tablet yawe ya Android, bikora nk'uko bikora kuri iPhone: shyiramo inyandiko zisomeka, usuzume ibyo Scribe AI itanga, ubike inyandiko wahisemo. Kwandika mu majwi no kwinjiza amafoto ntibiboneka kuri Android, bityo andika cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko zawe. Bikenera WitnessWork yashyizwe iva kuri Google Play ku gikoresho cyemejwe na Play Protect, hamwe na Google Play Store na serivisi za Google Play bivuguruye. Mbere ya buri kwinjiza, Google Play Integrity igenzura ko porogaramu n'igikoresho ari ibyukuri. Google yakira iryo genzura riturutse ku gikoresho cyawe n'ikimenyetso kidasomeka cy'ibyo winjiza, ntiyakira inyandiko zawe; inyandiko zawe zijya gusa kuri serivisi ya Scribe AI isobanuwe muri Kwinjiza inyandiko bikora bite. Ibikoresho byakuweho imbibi (rooted), software ya sisitemu yihariye, emulators, na kopi zahinduwe cyangwa zitemewe za porogaramu ntibishobora kugenzurwa. Niba Scribe AI igusabye kuvugurura Google Play, vugurura Google Play Store na serivisi za Google Play, hanyuma wongere ugerageze. Niba itashoboye kugenzura igikoresho cyawe, ongera ushyire WitnessWork iva kuri Google Play hanyuma wongere ugerageze; niba ikinanirwa, Kwinjiza inyandiko ntibishyigikiwe kuri icyo gikoresho. Imibare yemewe y'ubuntu n'iy'Abaterankunga ni imwe nk'iya iPhone. Imimerere y'Umuterankunga iva mu iduka wiyandikishijemo, bityo ifatabuguzi rya App Store ntirifungura ibiranga kuri Android. Niba Kwinjiza inyandiko bitagaragara, vugurura WitnessWork; birashoboka ko bitaragera ku gikoresho cyawe. Ku bindi, koresha ihuza ry'ubufasha bwihariye ryo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire inyandiko zawe muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_notesImportVoicePhoto_q: Kwandika mu majwi no kwinjiza amafoto bikora bite, kandi ni iki kiva ku gikoresho cyanjye?
faq_notesImportVoicePhoto_a: Muri Kwinjiza inyandiko, kanda mikoro kugira ngo wandike mu majwi. Urugero, nyuma yo guhamagara, vuga uwo mwaganiriye, ibyo mwaganiriyeho, n'igihe uteganya gusubirayo, hanyuma ukande akamenyetso k'ukuri. Cyangwa ukande kamera kugira ngo usikane inyandiko zanditse n'intoki cyangwa inyandiko yo gusura ku nzu n'inzu, cyangwa uhitemo amafoto agera kuri atanu. Amagambo avuzwe n'inyandiko y'intoki bihinduka inyandiko ku gikoresho cyawe, kandi inyandiko igaragara mu gasanduku k'ubutumwa kugira ngo ukosore ikintu cyose cyumvikanye nabi cyangwa cyasomwe nabi mbere yo kuyohereza. Amajwi n'amafoto ntibibikwa cyangwa ngo byoherezwe. Inyandiko wohereje gusa ni yo ijya kuri Scribe AI, nk'inyandiko washyizemo, kandi buri kwinjiza gushya gukoresha Amahirwe yo kwinjiza. Kwandika mu majwi guhagarara nyuma y'iminota 10, kandi mikoro igaragara gusa iyo iki gikoresho gishyigikiye kumenya amagambo ku gikoresho ubwacyo ku rurimi rwa porogaramu cyangwa urw'igikoresho cyawe. Kwandika bwa mbere mu rurimi bishobora gutegereza mu gihe igikoresho cyawe gikuramo icyitegererezo cy'amagambo cya Apple. Kwandika bikenera uburenganzira bwa mikoro, hamwe n'uburenganzira bwo kumenya amagambo mbere ya iOS 26. Gusikana bikenera uburenganzira bwa kamera; guhitamo amafoto nta burenganzira bwiyongera bisaba. Niba warabyanze, fungura Mikoro, Kumenya amagambo, cyangwa Kamera ya WitnessWork mu Igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe. Niba nta kintu kimenyekanye, ongera ugerageze ahantu hatuje cyangwa ufite urupapuro ruringaniye kandi rufite urumuri, cyangwa wandike cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko zawe. Niba bikomeza kunanirwa, ohereza imeri ku bufasha mu ibanga uciye muri Uracyakeneye ubufasha? mu Kigo cy'ubufasha. Kwandika mu majwi no kwinjiza amafoto bikora gusa kuri iPhone na iPad; kuri Android, andika cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko zawe.
faq_hourglassSetup_q: Nohereza nte raporo yanjye kuri Hourglass cyangwa NW Publisher?
faq_hourglassSetup_a: Fungura Raporo y'umurimo y'ukwezi, uhitemo Hourglass cyangwa NW Publisher mu rutonde rumanuka ruri hejuru ya Emeza, hanyuma ukande Emeza. Suzuma kandi wohereze raporo muri porogaramu wohereje. Gukoporora no Gusangiza na byo birahari. NW Publisher yemera gusa raporo y'ukwezi gushize. Hourglass yakira igihe cyo kubwiriza ukwacyo, Igihe cy'inyongera cyashyizwe mu bisobanuro bya raporo bisanzwe; niba usimbuye ibisobanuro, reba ko biracyavuga ibyo ukeneye. Vugurura WitnessWork niba uburyo bwo kohereza bubura.
faq_savedContactViews_q: Nshobora kubika umuyunguruzi w'abantu nkawuhindukiraho vuba?
faq_savedContactViews_a: Yego, hamwe n'uburyo bubitswe, ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri iOS na Android. Muri Abantu, kanda buto y'umuyunguruzi iruhande rw'ishakisha (cyangwa ••• → Tondeka & Shungura…), hitamo imyunguruzi n'uburyo bwo gutondeka, hanyuma ukande Bika nk'uburyo hejuru, ubuhe izina (kugeza ku nyuguti 30), nka Ibyigisho bya Bibiliya cyangwa Ifasi y'Icyesipanyoli. Uburyo bwawe bugaragara nka buto munsi y'aho gushakisha, hejuru y'uturango tw'igihe cyo gusura bwa nyuma, no hejuru y'ikarita: kanda ubumwe kugira ngo ubugaragaze, hanyuma ububukande nanone kugira ngo usubire ku myunguruzi yawe bwite. Uburyo bukoreshwa ku rutonde no ku ikarita kimwe. Inyandiko zishakishwa ntizibikwa mu buryo. Mu gihe uburyo bugaragara, impinduka ukora muri Tondeka & Shungura cyangwa ukoresheje uturango tw'igihe cyo gusura bwa nyuma zishyirwaho Byahinduwe; kanda Vugurura uburyo kugira ngo uzibike, Bika nk'uburyo bushya kugira ngo ubike byombi, cyangwa Subizaho kugira ngo uzireke. Kugira ngo utondeke uburyo bwawe, kanda ubumwe, utegereze gato, hanyuma ububukurure ku murongo. Kanda ufate uburyo utimuye kugira ngo ubuhindure izina cyangwa ubusibe, cyangwa uhitemo ••• → Hindura uburyo bubitswe kugira ngo uhindure amazina, utondeke kandi usibe uburyo. Gusiba uburyo ntibihindura abantu bawe. Guhindura izina cyangwa kubika mu bubiko umwanya w'umuntu bituma uburyo bukomeza gukora; niba usibye umwanya burundu, imyunguruzi iwuriho irirengagizwa. Uburyo bubikwa ku gikoresho cyawe, bushyirwa muri backup, kandi buhuzwa na iCloud Sync kuri iOS na Google Drive Sync kuri Android; vugurura WitnessWork kuri buri gikoresho kugira ngo ubibone aho. Uburyo bugaragara bukomeza kuba kuri buri gikoresho. Kubaka imyunguruzi utayibitse bikomeza kuba ubuntu. Niba uburenganzira bw'Umuterankunga burangiye, uburyo bwawe buhishwa muri Abantu kandi ntibugikoreshwa, ariko burabikwa kandi bugaruka uburenganzira bugarutse. Niba uburyo bugaragaza abantu utari witeze, fungura Tondeka & Shungura urebe imyunguruzi yabwo, cyangwa ukande Subizaho kugira ngo ukureho impinduka zitabitswe. Ku bindi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.
faq_contactsSuggestedSort_q: Gutondeka kwa Byatanzwe muri Abantu bikora iki?
faq_contactsSuggestedSort_a: Byatanzwe ni uburyo busanzwe bwo gutondeka urutonde rw'Abantu kuri iOS na Android. Iyo udashakisha, urutonde rutangira n'ibice bigufi bigera kuri bitatu: Hafi (abantu bari muri metero 250 hafi yawe, uwa hafi akabanza, hamwe n'umuhanda wabo), Gusubirayo bigeze (gusubirayo bigeze uyu munsi cyangwa byatinze mu minsi 30 ishize, ibyatinze cyane bikabanza), na Vuba aha (abasuwe mu byumweru 2 bishize). Buri gice kigaragaza abantu bagera kuri 5, kandi buri muntu agaragara rimwe gusa. Abandi bose bakurikira munsi ya Abandi bantu: abakunzwe babanza, hanyuma ibyigisho bya Bibiliya bikorwa, hanyuma ibyigisho byashize, hanyuma ukurikije gusura kwa vuba. Imyunguruzi yawe n'Uburyo bubitswe bikoreshwa mbere, bityo ibice birimo gusa abantu urutonde rwagaragaza. Ibice ubusa bihishwa, kandi niba bitatu byose ari ubusa urutonde ruba urutonde rumwe rworoshye. Gushakisha cyangwa guhitamo ubundi buryo bwo gutondeka na byo bigaragaza urutonde rumwe rworoshye. Hafi ni ubushake. Kigaragara gusa niba warimaze kwemera aho uri kuri WitnessWork; urutonde rw'Abantu ntirubisaba. Gikoresha akamenyetso ku ikarita ka buri muntu, kava kuri aderesi ye cyangwa akamenyetso washyizeho, bityo umuntu udafite aho aherereye ntashobora kuba Hafi. Aho uri hasomwa ku gikoresho cyawe iyo ufunguye Abantu, gusa kugira ngo hatondeke urutonde, kandi ntihabikwa cyangwa ngo hoherezwe ahandi. Kugira ngo imirongo itimuka mu gihe usoma, aho uri hashya hagaragara ubutaha ufunguye Abantu. Kugira ngo ukoreshe indi gahunda yo gutondeka, kanda buto y'umuyunguruzi iruhande rw'ishakisha (cyangwa ••• → Tondeka & Shungura…) uhitemo uburyo; Subizaho isubira kuri Byatanzwe. Niba Hafi ibura, reba ko aho uri hemewe kuri WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe kandi ko umuntu afite akamenyetso ku ikarita. Ku bindi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina na aderesi.
faq_conversationFields_q: Nshobora kubika andi makuru ku kiganiro, nk'igitabo nakoresheje?
faq_conversationFields_a: Yego. Fungura Amahitamo → Imyanya y'ibiganiro, cyangwa ukande Ongeraho imyanya yihariye ku ifishi y'ikiganiro, wongereho umwanya nka Igitabo. Amazina y'imyanya ashobora kugira inyuguti zigera kuri 14. Buri mwanya ugaragara ku ifishi y'ibiganiro no gusura Ntari mu rugo; usige ubusa iyo bitareba. Agaciro kabitswe kagaragara kuri uko gusura mu mateka y'umuntu. Ushobora guhindura izina no gutondeka imyanya igihe icyo ari cyo cyose utabuze ibyo wanditse. Kubika umwanya mu bubiko biwuhisha ariko bikabika agaciro kawo. Uwusibe ku rutonde rw'Ibibitswe kugira ngo ukureho umwanya n'agaciro kawo mu biganiro byose burundu. Imyanya n'agaciro bikomeza ku gikoresho cyawe, bishyirwa muri backup, kandi bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho na iCloud Sync kuri iOS; vugurura WitnessWork kuri buri gikoresho kugira ngo ubibone aho. Ntibishyirwa mu byo usangiza iyo usangiza umuntu. Imyanya y'umuntu icungwa ukwayo mu Mahitamo → Imyanya y’amakuru y’abantu. Iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bufunguye, ntukandike idini, ubuzima, imimerere yo mu muryango, ururimi cyangwa ubwoko. Niba umwanya ubura ku ifishi, reba niba warabitswe mu bubiko. Ku bindi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.
faq_visitDetails_q: Mbona nte ikiganiro n'igikurikira cyacyo, cyangwa nkazana mugenzi wanjye?
faq_visitDetails_a: Kanda ikiganiro mu Biganiro byahise by'umuntu, ikarita ya Ibikurikira ku muntu, cyangwa umuntu ku ikarita y'ibiganiro yo ku Ahabanza, maze gifunguke mu rupapuro rutuma utava aho uri. Gukanda urwibutso rwa gusubirayo na byo bifungura aho. Hejuru haragaragara uwo mwari kumwe: umukande kugira ngo ufungure umuntu, cyangwa ukoreshe Hamagara, Ubutumwa na Genda. Hasi, umurongo uva ku byabaye ("Wavuganye na…", igihe, icyitonderwa cyawe n'imyanya yacyo) ukagera kuri gusubirayo, ufite akamenyetso ka Uyu munsi hagati, kugira ngo urebe ako kanya niba gusubira gusura biri imbere cyangwa inyuma. Gusubirayo bigaragaza igihe uzasubirayo n'uko hasigaye igihe kingana iki, ingingo, abazajyana, n'urwibutso. Andika gusura kigaragara umunsi wacyo ugeze, naho Hindura igihe igihe kikiri gifunguye. Gusubirayo kwatinze guhinduka ibara rya amberi, kwakozwe kuhuza no gusura kwakwubahirije, naho kwarekewe gushobora gutegurwa nanone. Nta gusubirayo, urupapuro ruhuza n'ugusura gukurikira n'uwo muntu, cyangwa rugatanga Tegura gusura gukurikira nyuma y'ukwa vuba. Kanda ikaramu kugira ngo uhindure, cyangwa ••• kugira ngo uhindure igihe, ukoporore icyitonderwa cyangwa ingingo, ureke gusubirayo, cyangwa usibe ikiganiro; gusiba ntibishobora gusubirwamo. Niba ukoresha Buddies, bagenzi batumiwe n'ibisubizo byabo bigaragara imbere muri gusubirayo. Igihe kikiri imbere, + icagaguye itumira umuntu ako kanya kandi isangiza gusa itariki n'igihe byacyo, izina rya mbere rya nyir'inzu, aderesi n'ingingo. Kugira ngo ukureho umuntu, hindura ikiganiro. Ubutumire bwa gusubirayo ntibuboneka mu Buryo bwo kurinda amakuru. Gufungura ikiganiro nta cyo bihindura, kandi gutumira mugenzi gusa ni ko gusangiza. Niba hari ikintu kigaragara nabi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.
faq_followUpReminders_q: Nshobora kubika inyandiko z'gusura nta gutegura gusubirayo cyangwa urwibutso?
faq_followUpReminders_a: Yego. Iyo wongeraho cyangwa uhindura gusura, zimya Gusubirayo hanyuma ubike. Gusura n'inyandiko zako bikomeza, ariko uko gusura nta gusubirayo cyangwa urwibutso rwateganyijwe kandi ntikuzagaragara nk'icyatinze. Ushobora kongera gufungura Gusubirayo nyuma ugahitamo itariki n'igihe. Kugira ngo uhagarike urwibutso rwa gusubirayo rwa kera, hindura uko gusura uzimye Gusubirayo.
faq_followUpCard_q: Nkoresha nte ikarita y'Ibiganiro by'uyu munsi ku Ahabanza?
faq_followUpCard_a: Ikarita igaragaza gusubirayo watekereje ku munsi w'uyu munsi. Guhera saa kumi n'imwe z'umugoroba (5 PM) igaragaza Ibiganiro biri vuba aha, byongeraho iby'ejo; ibyo bishobora guhindurirwa igihe ariko ntibyandikwa kugeza umunsi wabyo. Nyuza urutoki ku ruhande kugira ngo uve ku muntu ujye ku wundi. Iyo wagiyeyo, kanda Twaganiriye kugira ngo wandike ikiganiro ku ifishi yo gusura, cyangwa ukande Ntari mu rugo kugira ngo wandike igerageza ako kanya. Subiramo igaragara munsi y'ikarita amasegonda make nyuma ya Ntari mu rugo. Buto ya kalendari ihindura igihe cya gusubirayo. Kanda umuntu kugira ngo ubone icyo kiganiro na gusubirayo kwacyo mu rupapuro. Koresha buto ya ••• cyangwa ukande ufate umuntu kugira ngo uhamagare, wohereze ubutumwa, ubone inzira, Fungura umuntu, na Reka gusubirayo. Gusubirayo bibarwa nk'ibyarangiye iyo wanditse gusura kwose kuri uwo muntu ku munsi wabyo cyangwa nyuma yawo. Umurongo uri hejuru wuzura uko ugenda, kandi ikarita igaragaza Byose byarangiye iyo byose birangiye. Kanda Byarangiye, cyangwa ukande ufate umutwe uhitemo Funga ubu, kugira ngo uhishe ikarita kugeza wongeyeho cyangwa uhinduye igihe cya gusubirayo. Gusubirayo kutarangiye nyuma y'amasaha 4 y'igihe cyako kijya muri gusubirayo byatinze mu rwego rw'amamenyesha. Ntari mu rugo ntiboneka iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bufunguye. Gusura bibikwa nk'ugusura kwose ku gikoresho. Kugira ngo ukureho ikarita burundu, kanda ufate umutwe wayo uhitemo Hisha iki gice, cyangwa uyifungure nanone muri Hindura Ahabanza. Niba hari ikintu kigaragara nabi, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi udashyiramo amazina, aderesi n'inyandiko.
faq_logVisit_a: Kanda + uhitemo Andika gusura, hanyuma uhitemo umuntu. Kuri iPad, Andika gusura… kandi iri muri menu ya File y'umurongo wa menu. Nta gushakisha, urutonde rutangira na Hafi (abari muri metero 250 hafi yawe, uwa hafi akabanza), hanyuma Gusubirayo bigeze (iby'uyu munsi n'ibyatinze mu minsi 30 ishize), hanyuma Vuba aha (abasuwe mu byumweru 2 bishize), hanyuma Abantu bose A–Z. Andika kugira ngo ushakishe; niba umuntu atarimo, kanda Ongeraho nk'umuntu mushya kugira ngo umukore wandike gusura nyuma. Umaze guhitamo umuntu, kanda Twaganiriye kugira ngo wongereho inyandiko na gusubirayo ku ifishi yo gusura, cyangwa Ntari mu rugo kugira ngo wandike ako kanya, hamwe na Subiramo hasi kuri ecran amasegonda make. Mu buryo bwo kurinda amakuru, Ntari mu rugo ntitangwa kandi ifishi yo gusura irifungura ako kanya. Hafi ni ubushake: igaragara gusa niba wemeye aho uri, kandi ntubazwa keretse ukanze Fungura. Aho uri hakoreshwa ku gikoresho cyawe gusa mu gutondeka urutonde; ntihabikwa cyangwa ngo hoherezwe ahandi. Niba Hafi ibura, reba ko aho uri hemewe kuri WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe kandi ko umuntu afite aho ari ku ikarita. Kanda ufate umuntu kugira ngo ufungure umuntu aho kubikora.
faq_reminders_q: Ibyibutso bya gusubirayo, gahunda n'abantu bikora bite?
faq_reminders_a: Fungura Menyesha njyewe iyo wongeraho cyangwa uhindura Gusubirayo cyangwa Gahunda y'inshuro imwe, hanyuma uhitemo igihe mbere y'uko itangira urwibutso rugomba kugera. Kureka umuntu na byo bikwibutsa igihe yongeye kuboneka. Niba Menyesha njyewe izimye kuko amamenyesha atemewe, kuyifungura bigusaba uruhushya; niba warabyanze mbere, bifungura igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe. Niba igihe cy'urwibutso cyamaze gushira, ifishi irabivuga kandi nta rwibutso rwoherezwa. Guhindura igihe bigumana igihe cy'urwibutso wahisemo. Iyo urwibutso rugeze, runashyirwa ku nzogera yo ku Ahabanza, n'iyo amamenyesha ya sisitemu yazimye, kandi gukanda urwo ari rwo rwose bifungura gusubirayo, gahunda cyangwa umuntu. Buri gikoresho kiteganya ibyibutso byacyo gikoresheje inyandiko zawe zibitswe, bityo nyuma ya iCloud Sync cyangwa kugarura backup, fungura WitnessWork rimwe kuri icyo gikoresho kugira ngo ibyibutso bitegurwe. Gusiba gusura, gahunda cyangwa umuntu bikuraho ibyibutso byabyo, harimo ibyamaze kugaragara. Iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bufunguye, ibyibutso ntibigaragaza amazina n'ingingo. Kuri Android, sisitemu ishobora gutanga urwibutso rutinze iminota mike kugira ngo ibike bateri. Niba ibyibutso bitagera, reba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork mu Mahitamo no mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe, kandi ko Focus cyangwa Do Not Disturb bitabihagaritse. Niba bikomeje kutagera, menyesha ikibazo uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha utashyizemo amazina cyangwa andi makuru bwite.
faq_appIconBadge_q: Kuki hari umubare ku ishusho ya porogaramu ya WitnessWork?
faq_appIconBadge_a: Kuri iOS, umubare uri ku ishusho ya porogaramu ni ibintu bingahe biri mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza utarasoma. Amakuru aturuka kuri bagenzi bawe, nk'ikimenyetso gishya cya mugenzi wawe cyangwa igisubizo ku cyawe, ntabarwa na rimwe. Fungura inzogera uyimanure kugira ngo ushyire ibintu ku bisomwe; kubikuraho cyangwa kubisiba na byo bigabanya umubare. Uravugururwa WitnessWork ifunguye no iyo urwibutso rwa Gusubirayo, Gahunda cyangwa umuntu rugeze. Ibindi bintu, nka raporo y'ukwezi gushize cyangwa ubutumire bwa mugenzi, bibarwa ubutaha ufunguye WitnessWork, bityo umubare ushobora gutinda porogaramu ifunze. Buri gikoresho kigira umubare wacyo. Umubare ukenera uruhushya rw'amamenyesha; kugira ngo uwuhishe, zimya Badges kuri WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe. Iryo genamiterere rikora ku mubare gusa, si ku bimenyetso ukuza ku mwirondoro wawe. Kuri Android, ishusho ya porogaramu ntigaragaza umubare utarasomwa; launcher yawe ishobora kwerekana akadomo ku mamenyesha ari mu rwego rw'amamenyesha. Niba umubare ugaragara nabi, fungura WitnessWork, hanyuma uyivemo kugira ngo yivugurure. Niba ukomeje kudahura n'inzogera, vugana n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha.
faq_soundEffects_a: Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Amajwi n'Ibinyeganyega ukazimya Vuza amajwi. Ibi bigenzura amajwi y'ibyishimo n'ibyibutso WitnessWork ifunguye; ibyibutso biracyagaragara, ariko nta jwi (kuri Android, ni ubutumwa bugufi muri porogaramu). Ibyibutso bigeze porogaramu ifunze bikurikiza igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe; ugahindure ukwabyo nibiba ngombwa.
faq_haptics_a: Fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Amajwi n'Ibinyeganyega ukazimya Ibinyeganyega. WitnessWork noneho ireka ibinyeganyega byayo byose, nko gukanda, gukurura ku ikarita y'ibishushanyo, n'ibyishimo byo kugera ku ntego. Igenamiterere rikoreshwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa kandi ntirihuzwa n'ibindi bikoresho byawe. Ibikoresho bimwe bya sisitemu, nka menu na switch, bishobora gukomeza kunyeganyega bitewe n'igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe ubwacyo; ugahindure mu igenamiterere ry'amajwi n'ibinyeganyega ry'igikoresho cyawe.
faq_routePlanning_q: Nteganya nte inzira ngufi y'aho nzahagarara uyu munsi?
faq_routePlanning_a: Gutegura inzira ni ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga kuri iPhone, iPad na Android, kandi gikenera interineti. Ku Ahabanza, kanda Tegura inzira hejuru y'ikarita y'ibiganiro. Ushobora kandi gukanda itariki y'uyu munsi ku Ahabanza cyangwa muri Ingengabihe (kuri iPad, amakuru y'uyu munsi agaragara iruhande rwa kalendari), hanyuma ukande Tegura inzira y'uyu munsi. Igaragara iyo nibura ahantu habiri uhagarara hafite aho biri ku ikarita. Umuntu wese ashobora kuyifungura ngo arebe aho uhagarara uyu munsi; gushaka urukurikirane rugufi bikenera kuba Umuterankunga. Aho uhagarara ni gusubirayo kutarangiye kw'uyu munsi na gahunda z'uyu munsi. Gusubirayo byamaze gusubizwa no gusura uyu munsi, na gusubirayo kw'abantu warekeye, ntibirimo. Aho uhagarara hatagira aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso na ho ntihashyirwamo; ongeraho aderesi cyangwa ushyire akamenyetso ku muntu cyangwa ahantu gahunda iri kugira ngo hashyirwemo. Hitamo aho utangirira, haba aho uri ubu cyangwa kimwe mu bihagararwaho, kuraho ahantu uzasimbuka, hanyuma ukande Shakisha inzira ngufi. Inzira ishobora kugira ahantu hagera ku 10, kandi ushobora gutegura inzira zigera ku 10 mu masaha 24 yose. Urukurikirane ni urugendo rwihuta cyane hakurikijwe imodoka zo mu muhanda ubu. Ibihe bya gusubirayo na gahunda ntibitekerezwaho, bityo reba urukurikirane ugereranyije n'amasaha yose yagenwe. Niba nta nzira ibonetse, kuraho ahantu hatagerwa n'imodoka. Niba gutegura bitaboneka, ongera ugerageze nyuma. Gutegura inzira ntibihindura abantu bawe, gusubirayo cyangwa gahunda. Ku bindi bibazo, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwihariye bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru ya ba nyir'inzu muri raporo zishyirwa ahagaragara.
faq_routePlanningNavigation_q: Inzira yanjye ifungukira ite muri Apple Maps, Google Maps cyangwa Waze?
faq_routePlanningNavigation_a: Inzira yawe ifungukira muri Ikarita isanzwe yo gukoresha wahisemo muri Igenamiterere → Amerekezo. Google Maps ifungura inzira yose nk'urugendo rumwe hamwe n'aho uhagarara hose ukurikije urukurikirane. Apple Maps ikora kimwe kuri iOS 18.4 cyangwa irenzeho; ku mavugurura ya kera ifungura ahantu hamwe icyarimwe. Waze ihora ifungura ahantu hamwe icyarimwe kuko amahuza yayo yemera aho ujya hamwe gusa. Iyo ahantu hafungurwa hamwe hamwe, kanda Genda aho uhagarara hajya 1, hanyuma usubire muri WitnessWork ukande buto nanone ku hantu hakurikira, cyangwa ukande umwambi uri iruhande rw'aho uhagarara hose. Buri rugendo rutangirira aho uri, bityo aho wahisemo gutangirira ni ho hantu ha mbere gusa. Niba Google Maps itashyizweho, inzira ifungukira muri porogaramu yo kureba urubuga, ishobora kwerekana ahantu hake; shyiraho porogaramu cyangwa uhitemo indi porogaramu y'inzira. Kuri Android, hitamo Google Maps cyangwa Waze. Niba porogaramu y'ikarita idafunguka, reba ko yashyizweho hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
faq_routePlanningPrivacy_q: Ni iki gisangizwa iyo ntegura inzira?
faq_routePlanningPrivacy_a: Kugira ngo hamenyekane urukurikirane, WitnessWork yohereza imyanya y'ikarita y'aho utangirira na buri hantu uhagarara kuri seriveri ya WitnessWork, ihereza iyo myanya gusa kuri HERE, serivisi y'amakarita, kugira ngo ibare urugendo. Amazina, aderesi, inyandiko, ingingo n'amakuru ya gusura ntibyoherezwa na rimwe. Ibyo bisabwa binatwara indangamuntu y'ibanga ya konti ya porogaramu, ifitanye isano no kugura kwawe kw'Umuterankunga, kugira ngo seriveri yemeze imimerere y'Umuterankunga kandi ibare inzira zawe; ntoherezwa kuri HERE. Seriveri ntibika imyanya. Ibika gusa ibihe by'ibisabwa by'inzira zawe byo mu masaha 24 ashize kugira ngo ikoreshe imbibi za buri munsi. Iyo ufunguye inzira, porogaramu yawe y'inzira yakira aderesi ya buri hantu uhagarara, cyangwa imyanya yaho ku kamenyetso washyizeho, nk'uko bigenda iyo ugiye ku muntu umwe. Isesengura ry'imikoreshereze ribika imibare nk'ahantu inzira yari ifite hangana iki, ntirihe aho uri na rimwe.
faq_locationTrouble_q: Kuki ikarita itabona aho ndi ubu?
faq_locationTrouble_a: Reba ko serivisi z'aho uri zifunguye kandi WitnessWork ifite uruhushya rwo kumenya aho uri mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe. Ongera ufungure ikarita ugerageze nanone ahantu igikoresho cyawe gishobora kubona aho uri. Ushobora kandi kwinjiza aderesi cyangwa gushyira ku ntoki akamenyetso k'umuntu udakoresheje aho uri ubu. Niba ikibazo gikomeje, menyesha ikosa ushyiremo igikoresho cyawe na verisiyo ya sisitemu y'imikorere, udashyize amakuru bwite y'abantu mu mafoto ya ecran.
faq_mapFilters_q: Kuki abantu bamwe babura ku ikarita?
faq_mapFilters_a: Ikarita igaragaza abantu bawe bakora bafite aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso, kandi ikoresha imyunguruzi imwe n'urutonde rw'Abantu. Uturango tw'igihe cyo gusura bwa nyuma, Uburyo bubitswe, n'imyunguruzi yo muri Tondeka & Shungura bikoreshwa kuri byombi, bityo umuntu uhishwe ku rutonde ahishwe no ku ikarita. Uturango two hejuru y'ikarita twerekana ibiriho; kanda Byose, kanda nanone Uburyo bubitswe bwahiswemo, cyangwa ufungure ••• → Tondeka & Shungura… hanyuma ukande Subizaho kugira ngo ubone bose. Niba uturango twihishe nyuma yo kwimura ikarita, kanda umutwe Abantu kugira ngo ubugarure. Ishakisha ry'ikarita ryonyine rigabanya gusa utumenyetso kandi ntirihindura urutonde. Umuntu ukora ushyiraho akamenyetso agumaho ku ikarita kugeza uhinduye ujya ku rutonde, n'iyo imyunguruzi yawe yamuhisha. Abantu warekeye ntibagaragara; ubashake munsi ya ••• → Abantu warekeye. Umuntu udafite aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso na we ntashobora kugaragara; fungura umuntu wongereho aderesi cyangwa ushyire akamenyetso ke. Bikora kimwe kuri iOS na Android, kandi imyunguruzi ibarwa ku gikoresho cyawe; nta kintu gisangizwa. Niba umuntu agikomeje kubura, reba aderesi ye, hanyuma uvugane n'ubufasha uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha udashyizemo amazina na aderesi.
faq_restoreSupporter_q: Nishyuye, ariko ibiranga by'Umuterankunga cyangwa ibiciro birabura. Nkore iki?
faq_restoreSupporter_a: Reba interineti yawe, kandi urebe ko iduka ry'igikoresho cyawe rikoresha konti wakoresheje ugura. Fungura Igenamiterere → Ba umuterankunga ukoreshe Garura ibyigeze kugurwa iyo igaragara. Impano imwe (Tip) ntifungura ibiranga by'Umuterankunga. Niba nta byo waguze bibonetse, ibiciro bidakururwa, cyangwa ifatabuguzi ryawe rikomeje kutamenyekana, ohereza imeri ku bufasha mu ibanga ushyiremo verisiyo ya porogaramu n'ibyabaye. Niba ubufasha bukeneye indangamuntu ya konti yawe, koresha buto y'ubufasha iri mu mutwe w'iyi ecran kugira ngo ufungure Uracyakeneye ubufasha?, hanyuma ukande Koporora indangamuntu ya konti. Sangiza iyo ndangamuntu mu ibanga. Kugarura ibyaguzwe bigarura uburenganzira, si inyandiko zawe z'umurimo.
faq_foundingSupporter_a: Abaterankunga ba mbere bari basanzwe bateye inkunga WitnessWork mbere y'uko urwego rw'Abaterankunga rutangira muri Gicurasi 2026, igihe inkunga yazanaga nta nyungu na nke. Izina ni ukubashimira gusa. Si urwego rwihariye: Abaterankunga ba mbere bafite ibiranga bimwe n'abandi Baterankunga bose, kandi ntirishobora kugurwa cyangwa kugerwaho ubu. Mu gihe inkunga yawe ikora, izina Umuterankunga wa mbere rigaragara ku mwirondoro wawe no mu Igenamiterere. Riturutse ku itariki watangiyeho kuba Umuterankunga, bityo nta kindi kibikwa cyangwa gisangizwa. Niba inkunga yawe irangiye, izina rihishwa kugeza utanze inkunga nanone. Rigaruka niba konti yawe y'iduka igaragaza itariki yawe y'ibanze, ibyo bikunze kuba iyo wiyandikishije nanone ukoresheje konti imwe. Niba witezeho kurigaragara, fungura Igenamiterere → Ba umuterankunga ukoreshe Garura ibyigeze kugurwa. Niba rikomeje kutagaragara, koresha buto y'ubufasha iri mu mutwe w'iyi ecran kugira ngo ufungure Uracyakeneye ubufasha? uvugane n'ubufasha mu ibanga.
faq_buddiesOverview_q: WitnessWork Buddies ni iki, kandi kuki ntayibona?
faq_buddiesOverview_a: Buddies igufasha guhuza n'abantu bagera kuri batanu mujyana kubwiriza no kubonana gahunda zanyu z'iminsi, ibihe byo gutangira, n'igihe bimara mu byumweru umunani biri imbere. Unabona ibimenyetso buri mugenzi asangiza. Ikora kuri iPhone, iPad na Android, kandi bagenzi bari ku mbuga zitandukanye bashobora guhuza. Ku ngengabihe ya Ingengabihe, ifoto cyangwa inyuguti ya mbere ya mugenzi ku munsi bivuze ko muzajyana kubwiriza, naho akadomo gato munsi y'umunsi kavuga ko abandi bagenzi bateganya kujya kubwiriza. Kanda umunsi ubone abo ari bo. Kuri iPhone na iPad, widget ya Kalendari igaragaza ibimenyetso bimwe kandi ivugurura iyo WitnessWork ivuguruye Buddies, bityo fungura porogaramu niba igaragara ko itinze. Ni ubuntu aho iboneka. Fungura Ingengabihe, ukande Buddies hejuru, urangize intangiriro ukoresheje izina ry'umwirondoro wawe. Akadomo kuri iyo buto kavuga ko hari icyifuzo gitegereje ko wemeza. Buddies ishobora kutaboneka mu gihe cyo gutangizwa buhoro buhoro. Vugurura porogaramu washyizeho niba buto ya Buddies ibura. Niba buto yijimye, Buddies ntiboneka by'agateganyo; bagenzi wabitse bagumaho ku ngengabihe yawe, bityo ongera ugerageze nyuma.
faq_buddiesAdd_q: Nongeraho nte mugenzi, kandi ni nde wemeza icyifuzo?
faq_buddiesAdd_a: Fungura Buddies ukande Tumira mugenzi cyangwa buto + kugira ngo usangize Ubutumire bwa Buddies. Kugira ngo muhuze imbonankubone, koresha buto ya kode kugira ngo werekane Kode yawe ya Buddies undi muntu ayisikane muri WitnessWork. Ushobora no gushyiramo ihuza ukoresheje Andika ihuza ry'ubutumire. Uwakiriye akanda Emera; uwakoze ubutumire akoherezwa gufungura Buddies → Ibisabwa agakanda Emeza. Utangira kubona gahunda za buri wese nyuma y'uko kwemeza gusa. Emeza gusa umuntu wari ugamije gutumira.
faq_buddiesInviteTrouble_q: Kuki Ubutumire bwanjye bwa Buddies butegereje, bwararangiye, cyangwa buvuga ko imyanya yose ikoreshwa?
faq_buddiesInviteTrouble_a: Icyifuzo cyakiriwe gitegereza kugeza uwatumiye acyemeje muri Buddies → Ibisabwa. Buri Butumire bwa Buddies bukora rimwe kandi burarangira nyuma y'iminsi irindwi; saba ihuza rishya niba ryarakoreshejwe, ryarahagaritswe cyangwa ryararangiye. Imyanya yawe itanu ibarwamo bagenzi n'ubutumire cyangwa ibyifuzo bitegereje. Hagarika ubutumire budakoreshwa cyangwa ukureho mugenzi kugira ngo habeho umwanya. Umubare muto gusa w'amahuza y'ubutumire adakoreshwa ushobora kuba ufunguye icyarimwe. Niba gukanda ihuza ry'ubutumire bifungura urubuga aho gufungura WitnessWork, shyiraho WitnessWork iva muri App Store cyangwa Google Play ukande ihuza nanone, cyangwa ukoporore ihuza ukarishyira muri Buddies → Andika ihuza ry'ubutumire. Niba gusikana bidashoboka, emerera kamera mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe cyangwa usangize kandi ushyiremo ihuza ry'ubutumire.
faq_buddiesPrivacy_q: Bagenzi banjye babona iki, kandi gusangira ni ibanga?
faq_buddiesPrivacy_a: Gusangira kalendari mu buryo bwikora bikubiyemo izina ryawe n'iminsi wateganyije, ibihe byo gutangira n'igihe bimara mu byumweru umunani biri imbere. Ifoto, ubupayiniya, n'urukurikirane rwawe ni ibyo guhitamo; bihindure muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Ibimenyetso byawe na byo birasangizwa, nta terambere, imibare cyangwa amatariki; zimya Ibimenyetso muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies kugira ngo ubihagarike. Gusangira kalendari ntibikubiyemo igihe cy'umurimo wawe cyanditswe, raporo, intego, ibyiciro, urutonde rw'abantu, amateka yo gusura cyangwa inyandiko. Ibisangizwa bihishwa impande zombi (end-to-end) kugira ngo wowe na bagenzi wahisemo gusa mubishobore gusoma. Ubutumire bugaragara bwa Gahunda na Gusubirayo busangiza andi makuru, harimo icyitonderwa cya Gahunda cyangwa aderesi ya Gusubirayo; suzuma ayo makuru mbere yo gutumira umuntu. Shaka Politiki y'ubuzima bwite munsi ya Uracyakeneye ubufasha?, ukoresheje buto y'ubufasha iri mu mutwe w'iyi ecran.
faq_buddiesAskToJoin_q: Nsaba nte kwifatanya muri Gahunda ya mugenzi wanjye?
faq_buddiesAskToJoin_a: Kanda umunsi ku ngengabihe yawe ya Ingengabihe, hanyuma ukande Saba kwifatanya iruhande rwa mugenzi uteganya kujya kubwiriza uwo munsi. Ushobora kandi gukanda umwe mu minsi ye munsi ya Ibyumweru bibiri bikurikira ku rupapuro rw'amakuru ye. Icyifuzo cyawe gisangiza gusa ibyo usanzwe ubona: umunsi, igihe n'uburebure bwa Gahunda ye. Kigaragara nka Wasabye kugeza mugenzi wawe agutumiye, ukisubiza, cyangwa Gahunda itangiye; kanda Wasabye kugira ngo ucyisubize. Gusaba bifunga amasaha abiri mbere y'uko Gahunda itangira, kandi ushobora kugira ibyifuzo bigera ku bitatu bitegereje kuri buri mugenzi. Mugenzi wawe amenyeshwa gusa ubwa mbere usabye Gahunda, kandi ku byifuzo bitarenga bitatu ku munsi. Niba yimuye cyangwa akuyeho iyo Gahunda, icyifuzo cyawe kirisubizwa kuri wowe. Wasabye kigaragara gusa ku gikoresho wasabyeho. Mugenzi wawe nagutumira, subiza mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza. Niba uhisemo Ndagenda ufite Gahunda yawe bwite icyo gihe, y'inshuro imwe cyangwa yisubiramo, ushobora kuyisimbuza kuri uwo munsi kugira ngo igihe cyawe kitabarwa kabiri. Gahunda yisubiramo ikomeza ku yindi minsi yawe.
faq_buddiesJoinRequests_q: Nsubiza nte cyangwa nzimya nte ibyifuzo byo kwifatanya muri Gahunda zanjye?
faq_buddiesJoinRequests_a: Iyo mugenzi asabye kwifatanya muri imwe muri Gahunda zawe, icyifuzo cye kigaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza. Kanda Tumira kugira ngo umwongere kuri Gahunda yawe kandi wohereze ubutumire ako kanya; buto ihinduka akamenyetso k'ukuri. Kanda icyifuzo ubwacyo kugira ngo ufungure Gahunda, aho Tumira ikora kimwe. Kanda Si ubu (cyangwa ukireke) kugira ngo ugikureho bucece: mugenzi wawe ntabimenyeshwa na rimwe, kandi icyifuzo kirangira Gahunda itangiye. Niba Gahunda yaturutse ku butumire bw'undi, uwayiteguye gusa ni we ushobora gutumira. Gutumira umuntu ku itariki imwe ya gahunda yisubiramo bituma iyo tariki iba Gahunda yayo y'inshuro imwe, kandi gahunda yisubiramo ikomeza uko iri ku yindi minsi yawe. Niba Gahunda zawe z'uwo munsi zahindutse kuva yasaba, fungura Gahunda ugumana kugira ngo umutumire. Kugira ngo uhagarike amamenyesha y'ibyifuzo byose, zimya Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Kugira ngo uhagarike amamenyesha ya mugenzi umwe, zimya Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya ku rupapuro rw'amakuru ye, cyangwa ukande igihe kirekire icyifuzo cye uhitemo Zimya amamenyesha. Ibyifuzo biracyagaragara mu nzogera uko byaba bimeze kose. Si ubu n'ayo magenamiterere bikora kuri iki gikoresho gusa, bityo icyifuzo wakuyeho ku gikoresho kimwe gishobora kugaragara ku kindi.
faq_buddiesInvitations_q: Ntumira nte mugenzi muri Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo, nkasubiza ubutumire?
faq_buddiesInvitations_a: Koresha Tumira bagenzi iyo wongeraho cyangwa uhindura Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo giteganyijwe, hitamo bagenzi bemejwe, hanyuma ubike. Ku rupapuro rwa Gahunda, cyangwa ku rupapuro rw'ikiganiro cya Gusubirayo giteganyijwe, Tumira bagenzi itumira umuntu ako kanya. Ushobora kandi gukanda Tumira muri Gahunda ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi. Ubutumire bwa Gahunda busangiza itariki, igihe, uburebure, umutwe, ahantu n'icyitonderwa byayo. Ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo busangiza itariki n'igihe byayo, izina rya mbere rya nyir'inzu, aderesi cyangwa akamenyetso, n'ingingo; ayo makuru arangira umunsi umwe nyuma yo gusura. Reba ko ushaka gusangiza ayo makuru n'abantu wahisemo. Ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo ntibuboneka mu Buryo bwo kurinda amakuru. Kugira ngo usubize, hitamo Ndagenda cyangwa Sinshobora mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza, ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi muri Buddies, cyangwa ku rupapuro rw'ubutumire ubwarwo (rukande mu nzogera, ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi, cyangwa ku munsi muri Ingengabihe kugira ngo urufungure); ushobora guhindura igisubizo cyawe nyuma. Urupapuro rw'ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo rugaragaza igihe mugenzi wawe azagenda, izina rya mbere rya nyir'inzu, ingingo n'ahantu, hamwe n'inzira. Ubutumire buguma mu nzogera kugeza usubije cyangwa buhagaritswe cyangwa bukarangira, bityo ntibushobora gukurwaho kubw'impanuka; nyuma yo gusubiza, ushobora kubukuraho. Kujya muri Gahunda byongera Gahunda ihujwe ku ngengabihe yawe, ikurikiza impinduka cyangwa guhagarikwa n'uwatumiye. Sinshobora ikura Gahunda ku ngengabihe yawe, kandi guhindukira ukagaruka kuri Ndagenda ku rupapuro rwa Gahunda iragarura. Ubutumire bwa Gusubirayo ntibwinjiza umuntu cyangwa amateka yo gusura.
faq_buddiesNotifications_q: Amamenyesha ya Buddies avuga iki, kandi ni nde ushobora kuyabona?
faq_buddiesNotifications_a: Amamenyesha ya Buddies avuga uwakoze iki, akoresheje izina ry'irihimbano wahaye mugenzi niba warariteguye: urugero, “Anna yagutumiye muri Gahunda” hamwe n'umunsi n'igihe byayo, “Joe ntashobora”, “Levi yifuza kwifatanya nawe” cyangwa “Levi yabonye ikimenyetso” hamwe n'izina ry'ikimenyetso. Amenyesha ya Gusubirayo yerekana gusa umunsi n'igihe byayo, ntiyerekana izina rya nyir'inzu, aderesi cyangwa ingingo, naho amenyesha ya Gahunda ntiyerekana umutwe wayo, ahantu cyangwa icyitonderwa. Seriveri ya WitnessWork ntibona na rimwe aya mazina cyangwa amakuru: buri menyesha rigera ubutumwa bwa mugenzi wawe bugihishe, kandi igikoresho cyawe kirabufungura kikandika amenyesha ubwacyo. Ako kanya nyuma yo gutangiza igikoresho bundi bushya, mbere y'uko ugifungura bwa mbere, cyangwa iyo ubutumwa budasomeka, ubona amenyesha rusange nka “Ubutumire bushya” aho kubona izina; fungura inzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza kugira ngo urebe uwabukoze. Niba amamenyesha atigeze yerekana izina ry'umuntu, vugurura WitnessWork. Amamenyesha ashobora kugaragara kuri ecran ifunze; kugira ngo uhishe ibyo avuga kugeza ufunguye, hindura igenamiterere rya ecran ifunze mu igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe. Kugira ngo uhitemo amamenyesha ya Buddies iki gikoresho kibona, koresha Amamenyesha ya Buddies, Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya, na Imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies, cyangwa uzimye Imenyesha ryo Saba kwifatanya kuri mugenzi umwe ku rupapuro rw'amakuru ye. Byose biracyagaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha. Kuri Android, amamenyesha ya Buddies akenera serivisi za Google Play. Niba areka kugera, reba ko amamenyesha yemerewe WitnessWork mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho cyawe, hanyuma ufungure Buddies kugira ngo ivugurure. Niba akomeje kutagera, menyesha ikibazo uciye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha utashyizemo amazina cyangwa andi makuru bwite.
faq_buddiesDetail_q: Ni iki kiri ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi, kandi nshobora kumuhindurira izina cyangwa ibara?
faq_buddiesDetail_a: Fungura Buddies ukande mugenzi. Bikeneye igisubizo cyawe ni urutonde rw'ubutumire bwe utarasubiza; hitamo Ndagenda cyangwa Sinshobora aho cyangwa mu nzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza. Hamwe ni urutonde rwa Gahunda na Gusubirayo bizaza hagati yanyu, uwatumiye uwo ari we wese, hamwe na buri gisubizo; kanda Gahunda kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwayo, cyangwa ukoreshe menu iri ku butumire bwa mugenzi kugira ngo uhindure igisubizo cyawe. Ibyumweru bibiri bikurikira bigaragaza iminsi mugenzi wawe ateganya kujya kubwiriza iruhande rw'iyawe; kanda umwe mu minsi ye kugira ngo uteganye igihe kimwe cyangwa usabe kwifatanya. Tumira muri Gahunda ifungura Gahunda nshya na mugenzi uwo asanzwe yatumiwe, naho Reba kuri kalendari ifungura Ingengabihe. Izina ry'irihimbano ni izina ry'ibanga ubona wenyine; mugenzi wawe ntabimenyeshwa, kandi kurikuraho bigarura izina rye bwite. Abaterankunga bashobora guhitamo ibara rya mugenzi muri ibara rimwe n'ibara nyamukuru, cyangwa ibara iryo ari ryo ryose bakoresheje eyedropper; Ibisanzwe bigarura ibara ryatanzwe igihe mwahujwe, ibyo abandi bose bakomeza kugira. Amazina y'irihimbano n'amabara bibikwa hamwe n'amakuru yawe ahishwe ya Buddies, bityo bigaruka iyo Buddies igarurwa ku kindi gikoresho. Gahunda ye yose y'ibyumweru umunani biri imbere iri kuri kalendari yawe mu gihe Erekana kuri kalendari yanjye ifunguye.
faq_buddiesMissingPlans_q: Kuki gahunda cyangwa ubutumire bwa mugenzi bibura cyangwa ntibigezweho?
faq_buddiesMissingPlans_a: Reba ko icyifuzo cyemejwe kandi Erekana kuri kalendari yanjye ifunguye kuri uwo mugenzi. Gusangira kalendari bikubiyemo ibyumweru umunani biri imbere gusa. Abantu bombi bakeneye interineti kugira ngo bohereze kandi bakire impinduka; fungura Buddies umanure kugira ngo uvugurure. Gahunda zakuruwe mbere zikomeza kugaragara nta interineti, ariko impinduka nshya zikeneye interineti; Buddies ivuga iyo udafite interineti cyangwa itashoboye kuvugurura. Kubona kalendari ya mugenzi ntibyongera gahunda ze ku zawe. Fungura Amamenyesha ya Buddies muri Igenamiterere rya Buddies no mu igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha ry'igikoresho cyawe, kandi urebe inzogera y'amamenyesha yo ku Ahabanza ku butumire n'iyo nta menyesha ryaje. Kuri Android, amamenyesha ya Buddies akenera serivisi za Google Play; nta zo, impinduka zigeraho iyo ufunguye WitnessWork. Inzogera igenzura ibikorwa bishya bya Buddies iyo uyifunguye n'iyo usubiye muri WitnessWork; niba ivuga ko itashoboye kugenzura, ongera uhuze kandi ukande Ongera ugerageze.
faq_buddiesNotSent_q: Kuki igisubizo cyanjye kigira kiti Kohereza nyuma ya cyangwa Ntiharoherezwa, cyangwa icyifuzo cyanjye kigira kiti Gutegereza koherezwa?
faq_buddiesNotSent_a: Ndagenda yoherezwa kuri mugenzi wawe ako kanya. Sinshobora itegereza amasegonda 15 mbere, mu gihe wayikanze kubw'impanuka: kanda Hindura kugira ngo uyikosore mbere y'uko yoherezwa. Kuva muri porogaramu bihita byohereza. Ntiharoherezwa cyangwa Gutegereza koherezwa bivuze ko igisubizo cyawe cyangwa icyifuzo cyawe cyo Saba kwifatanya kitaragera kuri mugenzi wawe, akenshi kuko udafite interineti cyangwa Buddies itaboneka by'agateganyo. Ntukeneye gusubiza cyangwa gusaba nanone: kibitswe kuri iki gikoresho kandi cyoherezwa ubwacyo ubutaha Buddies ivugurura, nko iyo ufunguye Buddies cyangwa usubiye muri WitnessWork ufite interineti. Kugira ngo cyoherezwe vuba, ongera uhuze, ufungure Buddies, umanure kugira ngo uvugurure. Mugenzi wawe ntazabona igisubizo cyangwa icyifuzo kugeza cyoherejwe.
faq_buddiesRemove_q: Mpisha nte mugenzi, nkareka gusangira, cyangwa nkasiba amakuru yanjye ya Buddies?
faq_buddiesRemove_a: Fungura amakuru ya mugenzi uzimye Erekana kuri kalendari yanjye kugira ngo uhishe gahunda ze kuri iki gikoresho; gusangira birakomeza, kandi Gahunda zawe bwite hamwe na we ziracyagaragara. Kuraho mugenzi irangiza isano ku bantu bombi, kandi kongera guhuza bisaba ubutumire bushya. Ntibamenyeshwa, ariko bashobora kubibona. Niba gukuraho bitegereje udafite interineti, bashobora kubona gahunda zawe zasangijwe za nyuma kugeza WitnessWork yongeye guhuzwa ikarangiza. Igenamiterere rya Buddies → Siba amakuru yanjye ya Buddies ikuraho amasano yose n'ubutumire kandi isiba amakuru yawe ahishwe ya Buddies n'indangamuntu y'ihishwa. Ntishobora gusubirwamo; ongera uhuze kandi wongere ugerageze niba gusiba bitegereje. Inyandiko zawe bwite z'umurimo n'abantu birakomeza.
faq_buddiesRestore_q: Nshobora kugarura bagenzi banjye ku kindi gikoresho cyangwa mu backup?
faq_buddiesRestore_a: Kuri iPhone na iPad, urufunguzo rwawe rwo guhisha rwa Buddies rubikwa muri iCloud Keychain, bityo Buddies igarura amasano yayo ku kindi gikoresho gikoresha Apple Account imwe, cyangwa nyuma yo kongera gushyiraho WitnessWork, iyo ihuza.
