Kuri Android, serivisi za Google Play zibika urufunguzo: rugaruka iyo wongeye gushyiraho WitnessWork kuri telefoni imwe mu gihe backup ya Google ifunguye (Igenamiterere → Google → Backup), kandi iyo ufite gufunga ecran, runabikwa, rwahishwe impande zombi, muri backup yawe ya Google, bityo rushobora kugaruka iyo utegura telefoni nshya uvuye kuri iyo backup. Nta gufunga ecran, urufunguzo rukomeza kuba kuri iyo telefoni. Ibikoresho bya Android ntibisangira urufunguzo rumwe nk'uko iCloud Keychain ibikora, bityo buri gikoresho cya Android, na iPhone na telefoni ya Android, bifite amasano yabyo bwite ya Buddies. Dosiye zisanzwe za backup ya WitnessWork ntizirimo urufunguzo rwo guhisha. Kugarura Buddies bitandukanye na iCloud Sync y'Umuterankunga ku nyandiko z'umurimo. Niba urufunguzo rutaboneka, cyangwa wakoresheje Siba amakuru yanjye ya Buddies, ongera uhuze ukoresheje ubutumire bushya. Bika inyandiko zawe bwite muri backup ukwazo.
faq_mileageStart_a: Kurikirana ibirometero ni ubushake kandi bihari ku bwoko bwose bw'ababwiriza. Subiza Yego ku ikarita "Gukurikirana ibirometero?" yo ku Ahabanza, cyangwa ufungure Kurikirana ibirometero muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umubwiriza. Hanyuma ongeraho imodoka yawe ya mbere; izina ni ryo ryonyine rikenewe. Andika urugendo ukoresheje Andika urugendo ku ikarita y'Ibirometero yo ku Ahabanza, kuri buto Ongeraho, cyangwa ku ecran y'Ibirometero. Andika intera (fungura Kugenda no kugaruka kugira ngo yikube kabiri) cyangwa uhindukire kuri Igipimo cy'ibirometero wandike ibipimo byo gutangira no kurangira. Igipimo cyo gutangira cyuzuzwa kuva ku gipimo cya nyuma ry'iyo modoka. Ingendo ntizishobora gushyirwaho amatariki yo mu gihe kizaza. Kanda urugendo kugira ngo urebe amakuru yarwo, cyangwa urukande igihe kirekire kugira ngo urihindure, urwandike nanone uyu munsi, urusangize cyangwa urusibe.
faq_mileageCost_q: Igiciro cya lisansi giteganyijwe kibarwa gite, kandi bigenda bite iyo ibiciro bya lisansi bihindutse?
faq_mileageCost_a: Igiciro cya lisansi giteganyijwe ni intera ÷ ikoreshwa rya lisansi ry'imodoka × igiciro cya lisansi yayo, hakoreshejwe agaciro gakurikizwa ku itariki ya buri rugendo. Kigaragara gusa iyo imodoka ifite ikoreshwa rya lisansi kandi lisansi yayo ifite igiciro; ingendo zitagira byombi zirasigara kandi raporo irabivuga. Igiciro cya lisansi gisangiwe n'imodoka zose zikoresha iyo lisansi. Iyo uhinduye igiciro cyangwa ikoreshwa rya lisansi ry'imodoka, hitamo Guhera ku itariki kugira ngo bikurikizwe guhera kuri uwo munsi (ingendo za mbere zigumana agaciro ka kera) cyangwa Kosora agaciro ka none kugira ngo ukosore ikosa, ibyo binavugurura ingendo zashize zakoresheje agaciro. Buri lisansi na buri modoka bigira amateka; kanda igihe kirekire inyandiko kugira ngo uyisibe. Umubare ni ugereranya gusa. Niba usubizwa amafaranga, umubare nyawo ubarwa n'ukusubiza.
faq_mileageUnits_q: Nshobora gukoresha kilometero, litiro, cyangwa L/100 km?
faq_mileageUnits_a: Yego. Fungura Ibirometero → Igenamiterere (agashushanyo k'ibikoresho) → Ibipimo. Intera ishobora kuba mayili cyangwa kilometero, kandi ikoreshwa rya lisansi rishobora kuba mpg (US), mpg (UK), L/100 km, cyangwa km/L. Auto ikurikiza akarere k'igikoresho cyawe. Lisansi ihabwa igiciro kuri galoni na mpg (US) no kuri litiro n'ibindi byose. Ifaranga rikurikiza akarere k'igikoresho cyawe. Guhindura ibipimo bihindura gusa uko imibare yerekanwa; ingendo zawe ntizihindurwa.
faq_mileageShare_q: Nsangiza nte cyangwa nohereza nte raporo yanjye y'ibirometero?
faq_mileageShare_a: Fungura Ibirometero, uhitemo Umunsi, Icyumweru, Ukwezi, cyangwa Umwaka (umwaka w'umurimo, Nzeri kugeza Kanama), hanyuma ukoreshe imyambi cyangwa unyuze urutoki kugira ngo uhitemo igihe. Kanda buto yo gusangiza hejuru kugira ngo Kopi raporo, uyisangize nk'inyandiko, cyangwa Sohora CSV ku buryo bwa spreadsheet. Inyandiko igaragaza ibiteranyo, ibiteranyo by'imodoka imwe imwe iyo ufite imodoka irenze imwe, na buri rugendo uretse mu Mwaka. CSV ifite umurongo umwe ku rugendo ufite imodoka, ibipimo bya odometer, intera, icyitonderwa, lisansi, ikoreshwa rya lisansi, igiciro n'igiciro giteganyijwe. Ibyitonderwa by'ingendo birimo, bityo ubisuzume mbere yo kohereza. Kugira ngo usangize urugendo rumwe, urufungure ukande buto yo gusangiza.
faq_mileageCars_q: Itandukaniro riri hagati yo kubika mu bubiko no gusiba imodoka ni irihe?
faq_mileageCars_a: Fungura Ibirometero → Igenamiterere, ukande imodoka, uhitemo Ububiko cyangwa Siba…. Kubika mu bubiko bihisha imodoka ku ngendo nshya ariko bigakomeza ingendo zayo muri raporo zawe; uyigarure mu bubiko igihe icyo ari cyo cyose uciye mu Imodoka zabitswe. Gusiba bikuraho imodoka n'ingendo zayo zose ku bikoresho byose bihuza n'iki, kandi ntibishobora gusubirwamo. Gusiba lisansi bikuraho amateka y'ibiciro byayo, bityo imodoka zikoresha iyo lisansi zireka kwerekana igiciro giteganyijwe.
faq_mileageSync_q: Ibirometero byanjye birahuzwa, kandi bikora kuri Android?
faq_mileageSync_a: Ibirometero bikora kuri iOS na Android. Imodoka, lisansi, ibiciro n'ingendo bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho bya iOS na iCloud Sync, ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga, kandi bishyirwa muri backup zo muri Igenamiterere → Kubika & Kugarura ku mbuga zombi. Kuri Android bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho bya Android na Google Drive Sync, na yo ikiranga cy'Umuterankunga. Hagati ya iPhone n'igikoresho cya Android, koresha backup. Ibirometero ntibisangizwa na Buddies na rimwe kandi ntibigaragara kuri kalendari yawe cyangwa Raporo y'umurimo.
faq_mileageTurnOff_q: Nzimya nte cyangwa nfungura nte kurikirana ibirometero?
faq_mileageChart_q: Ikarita ku ecran y'Ibirometero igaragaza iki?
faq_mileageChart_a: Fungura ecran y'Ibirometero uhitemo Icyumweru, Ukwezi, cyangwa Umwaka. Ikarita igaragaza uko wagenze kure buri munsi, cyangwa buri kwezi k'umwaka w'umurimo (Nzeri kugeza Kanama). Iyo imodoka irenze imwe ifite ingendo muri icyo gihe, buri murongo ugabanywamo ku modoka, hakoreshejwe amabara ari iruhande rw'igiteranyo cya buri modoka. Kanda umurongo kugira ngo ufungure uwo munsi cyangwa ukwezi urebe ingendo zaho. Ubwo buryo bwa Umunsi nta karita bufite, kandi igihe kitagira ingendo nta kigaragaza. Imirongo igaragaza intera, si igiciro giteganyijwe.
faq_mileageTurnOff_a: Koresha akuma Kurikirana ibirometero muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umubwiriza. Kuzimya bihisha ikarita yo ku Ahabanza, igikorwa Andika urugendo, na ecran y'Ibirometero, ariko bigakomeza ingendo zawe; fungura nanone byose bigaruka. Niba warahisemo Oya, murakoze ku ikarita yo ku Ahabanza, aka kuma kayifungura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Kugira ngo usibe ibirometero byawe, fungura Ibirometero → Igenamiterere → Siba amakuru yose y'ibirometero. Ibi bisiba ku bikoresho byose bihuza n'iki kandi ntibishobora gusubirwamo. Ushobora kandi guhisha ikarita yo ku Ahabanza gusa ukoresheje Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Ekara y'ahabanza.

serviceYearPace.title: Umuvuduko w'umwaka w'umurimo
serviceYearPace.info: Umurongo w'imvi ucagaguye ni aho Intego yawe y'umwaka ikugeza mu mpera za buri kwezi, wubakwa ku ntego ya buri kwezi ubwayo. Umurongo w'icyatsi ni igihe cyawe kugeza ubu, nyuma y'imbibi z'inyongera za buri kwezi, naho umurongo w'icyatsi ucagaguye wongeraho gahunda zawe. Umurongo urabagirana gato ni umwaka w'umurimo ushize, iyo wawanditsemo igihe, ufite igiteranyo cyawo ku mpera. Ibiteranyo biri hejuru cyane y'intego yawe bishushanywa ku gipimo gifunze kugira ngo igice gisigaye cy'umwaka gikomeze gusomeka. Kanda ufate ku ikarita kugira ngo urebe ukwezi kose.

dataProtectionDesc: Birasabwa mu Muryango w'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi, mu Bwongereza no mu Busuwisi.
dataProtectionInfoDesc: Inkiko zo mu Bumwe bw'u Burayi zemeje ko ibyo wandika ku bantu uhura na bo mu murimo wo kubwiriza bigengwa n'itegeko ryo kurinda amakuru. Iyo ubu buryo bufunguye, WitnessWork ibika amakuru ya nyir'inzu ari uko yabyemeye gusa, igahisha imyanya y'amafoto n'igitsina, ikakuburira ku myanya yihariye irimo amakuru y'ibanga, ntiyandika gusura abatari mu rugo, igashakira aderesi kuri telefoni yawe gusa, ikazimya gusangira aderesi, kandi ikagusaba gusiba aderesi utasuye mu minsi 90. Kwinjiza amakuru avuye mu Nyandiko biracyohereza inyandiko wanditse kuri serivisi ya AI y'indi sosiyete kugira ngo iyitunganye, ariko ntibyohereza urutonde rw'aderesi usanganywe. Nufungura iCloud Sync, amakuru yawe azabikwa muri iCloud kandi ahuzwe ku bikoresho byawe byose. Iyi si inama mu by'amategeko — kurikiza amabwiriza y'ibiro by'ishami.
dataProtectionInfoDescAndroid: Inkiko zo mu Muryango w'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi zemeje ko inyandiko zerekeye abantu duhura na bo mu murimo wo kubwiriza zigengwa n'amategeko arengera amakuru. Iyo ibi bifunguye, WitnessWork ibika amakuru ya nyir'inzu gusa nyuma y'uko abyemeye, ihisha imyanya y'amafoto n'igitsina, iburira ku myanya yihariye y'amakuru yihariye, ntiyandika gusura Ntari mu rugo, ibika ishakisha ry'aderesi ku gikoresho cyawe, izimya gusangiza abantu, kandi itanga igitekerezo cyo gusiba abantu utasuye mu minsi 90. Kwinjiza inyandiko biracyohereza inyandiko winjije kuri serivisi ya AI y'undi muntu kugira ngo ibitunganye, ariko ntiyohereza urutonde rw'abantu rusanzweho. Niba ufunguye Google Drive Sync, inyandiko zawe zibikwa muri Google Drive yawe kandi zihuzwa ku bikoresho byawe. Si inama y'amategeko — kurikiza ubuyobozi bw'ishami ryanyu.

faq_syncRecovery_q: Ni iki kiba ku byo nahisemo mu gutegura, abantu basibwe n'inyibutsa mu gihe cyo guhuza?
faq_syncRecovery_a: Gutangira bushya gutegura bigira ingaruka kuri iki gikoresho gusa. Guhitamo Tangira bushya bihagarika guhuza na iCloud kugeza ubyemereye mu Igenamiterere; hanyuma uhitemo Huza byose cyangwa Garura uvuye kuri iCloud bijyanye n'ibyo ushaka. Garura uvuye kuri iCloud isoma amafoto y'amakuru y'ibindi bikoresho kandi igasimbuza amakuru yo kuri iki gikoresho nyuma yo kwemeza. Mu gihe cyo gutegura, igikoresho gisanzwe gifite inyandiko kikubaza mbere yo kuzisimbuza, kandi Abaterankunga bashobora guhitamo Huza. Gumana amakuru y'iki gikoresho bituma ibindi bikoresho byawe bihindura bigakoresha amakuru y'iki gikoresho ubutaha bihuza, bigasimbuza impinduka byakozwe mbere. Kugarura amakuru ntibyohereza mu Buddies kwanga gahunda zitari mu bubiko. Amakuru y'abantu basibwe ashobora kugarurwa abikwa kugeza ku minsi 90, hanyuma agakurwaho hagasigara gusa ibigaragaza ko yasibwe. Inyibutsa zongera kubakwa kuri iki gikoresho nyuma yo guhuza no kugarura, zigumana igihe cyo kwibutswa cyahiswemo kuri buri gusubirayo na gahunda; hakenewe uruhushya rw'amamenyesha kandi hategurwa inyibutsa z'ahazaza gusa. Kugira ngo ugarure, gumana igikoresho gifite inyandiko za vuba kandi ubike ububiko mbere yo gusimbuza amakuru. Koresha ubufasha bwa bwite bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha niba ukeneye ubufasha.
faq_syncRemoveDevice_q: Nakuraho nte igikoresho cya kera kuri iCloud Sync?
faq_syncRemoveDevice_a: Buri gikoresho gikoresha iCloud Sync kibika kopi yacyo y'amakuru yawe muri iCloud yawe, kandi iyo kopi iguma nubwo wareka gukoresha icyo gikoresho, harimo na nyuma yo kongera gushyiraho porogaramu cyangwa kugura telefoni nshya. Gikureho igihe utagikoresha, urugero icyo wagurishije, wasimbuje cyangwa wasubije uko cyari kimeze. Ku gikoresho kigihuza, fungura Igenamiterere → iCloud Sync → Ibikoresho maze ukande Kuraho iruhande rw'igikoresho cya kera. Ibikoresho bitahuje mu minsi 90 cyangwa irenga biragaragazwa. Gukuraho bisiba gusa kopi y'icyo gikoresho muri iCloud, harimo n'amakuru yacyo y'abantu basibwe ahandi. Iki gikoresho kigumana ibyo cyamaze guhuza, kandi ibindi bikoresho byawe ntibihinduka. Niba igikoresho cyakuweho kigikoreshwa, cyongera kohereza amakuru yacyo ubutaha gihuza; banza uzimye iCloud Sync kuri cyo niba ushaka ko gihagarara. Mbere yo gukuraho igikoresho, iki gikoresho kigomba kurangiza guhuza amakuru yacyo; nibisabwa, garuka, ukande Huza ubu, ukosore ikibazo cyose uko gihagaze kigaragaza. Niba igikoresho gikoresha verisiyo nshya ya WitnessWork, banza uvugurure iki. Ibikoresho byasimbuwe na Ongera wubake amakuru ya iCloud bishobora gukurwaho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Amafoto ntabikwa kuri buri gikoresho, bityo gukuraho igikoresho ntibikuraho amafoto; koresha Kuraho amafoto ya iCloud kuri ibyo. Ibikoresho ni igice cya iCloud Sync kuri iOS na Google Drive Sync kuri Android (Igenamiterere → Google Drive Sync → Ibikoresho), byombi ni ibiranga by'abaterankunga; kuri Android kopi ziri muri Google Drive yawe. Niba ukeneye ubufasha, koresha uburyo bw'ubufasha bwa bwite bwo mu Kigo cy'ubufasha kandi ntushyire amakuru y'abo usura mu bitekerezo rusange.

contactDetails.historyInfo: Igishushanyo cyerekana amezi atandatu ashize. Akadomo kuzuye ni icyigisho cya Bibiliya, akadomo gafite umurongo gusa ni ikiganiro, naho kare bivuze ko nta wari mu rugo. Umurongo wijimye werekana uyu munsi, naho umurongo w'utudomo werekeza ku gusubirayo gukurikira. Hasi, buri gusura kugaragaza niba gusubirayo kwakurikijwe, kwasibye cyangwa kwakuweho.

faq_badgesOverview_q: Ibimenyetso bikora bite, kandi nabibona he?
faq_badgesOverview_a: Ibimenyetso byishimira imigenzo myiza mu murimo wawe, nko kugira uruhare mu murimo buri kwezi, kohereza raporo yawe, no gusubira gusura abantu. Nta cyo ugomba gutegura: WitnessWork igenzura inyandiko zawe kandi ikongeraho ikimenyetso iyo ugezeho. Kugira ngo ubone ibyawe, kanda ifoto yawe, hanyuma Umwirondoro. Ibimenyetso byawe biri munsi y'ikarita y'umwirondoro wawe; kanda kimwe kugira ngo ukirebe neza, cyangwa ukande Reba byose kugira ngo ufungure Ibimenyetso, aho ubona buri kimenyetso ufite n'icyo cyafasha buri kimwe gukura. Ibimenyetso byinshi bikura mu nzego enye: Umuringa, Ifeza, Zahabu, n'Imaragarita. Ibimenyetso bike by'inshuro imwe, nka Icyigisho cya mbere cya Bibiliya, bigumaho bihishe kugeza ubibonye. Iyo ikintu wakoze vuba aha gihesha ikimenyetso, nko kwandika igihe, kwemeza ko wagize uruhare mu murimo, kubika gusura cyangwa gahunda, kohereza raporo yawe, gusubiza Ndagenda, cyangwa kwemeza mugenzi, cyishimirwa ako kanya. Ikimenyetso kije muundi buryo, nko kugera kw'umunsi wa gahunda nijoro, igihe cyanditswe kuri watch yawe cyangwa ku kindi gikoresho, cyangwa igisubizo cya mugenzi, nticyakubangamira: ikarita y'Ikimenyetso gishya hejuru ya Ahabanza igitangaza. Kanda Reba kugira ngo ukirebe neza, cyangwa X kugira ngo ukureho ikarita; uko byagenda kose ikimenyetso kirabikwa kandi kigumaho kiranzwe gishya ku mwirondoro wawe kugeza ufunguye ibimenyetso byawe. Niba inyandiko imwe ihesha ikimenyetso kandi ikageza urukurikirane ku ntambwe, urukurikirane rurishimirwa naho ikimenyetso kigategereza kuri Ahabanza. Niba inyandiko zawe zimaze kugera ku bimenyetso ubwa mbere WitnessWork izigenzuye ku gikoresho, ecran y'inshuro imwe “Ibimenyetso byawe biri hano” ikubwira umubare ufite: Reba ifungura umwirondoro wawe, naho Nyuma ikayifunga. Itegereza igihe ufunguye WitnessWork nta rugendo rw'ivugurura. Uko byagenda kose, ibimenyetso byawe byamaze kubikwa. Ibimenyetso bikora kuri iOS na Android kandi bivugururwa mu kanya gato nyuma y'uko inyandiko zawe zihindutse n'igihe cyose usubiye muri WitnessWork. Si nomero itukura uri ku kimenyetso cya porogaramu, ubara ibitarasomwa mu nzogera y'amamenyesha.
faq_badgesView_q: Nabona nte ikimenyetso neza cyangwa nkagisangiza?
faq_badgesView_a: Kanda ikimenyetso icyo ari cyo cyose, ku mwirondoro wawe, kuri ecran y'Ibimenyetso, cyangwa ku rupapuro rwa mugenzi muri Buddies, maze gifunguke ku ecran yose: ikimenyetso, urwego rwacyo, icyo kibara, n'igihe wagiriye. “Byabonetse mu mateka yawe” bisobanura ko inyandiko za kera zagezeho kandi ukwezi kutazwi. Munsi y'ibimenyetso byawe, umurongo nka “Ikurikira: Imaragarita · amezi 41 kuri 60” werekana uko ikimenyetso kiri kure y'urwego rukurikira, cyangwa “Inzego zose uko ari enye zabonetse” iyo ufite Imaragarita; kanda akabuto k'amakuru kari iruhande rwacyo kugira ngo ubone icyafasha gukura. Urwego utaragera rwerekana “Ntiragerwaho” n'uko wagerayo. Kanda ikimenyetso kugira ngo gikuruke. Kugira ngo ugisangize, fata ifoto ya ecran: ecran yerekana izina ryawe, nka “Ikimenyetso cya Anna,” na WitnessWork hasi, kandi nta kintu cyoherezwa ubwacyo. Izina ryawe rituruka ku mwirondoro wawe, muri Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umwirondoro; nta zina, ecran irisiga. Funga ikimenyetso ukoresheje X, unyeganyeza umanuka, cyangwa Garuka kuri Android. Muri Buddies, ibisubizo bya bagenzi bawe bigaragara munsi y'ikimenyetso cyawe, kandi ikimenyetso cya mugenzi kikwemerera kumwoherereza kimwe; reba ikibazo kijyanye n'ibyo bagenzi babona.
faq_badgesMonths_q: Kuki ibimenyetso bibara amezi aho kubara amasaha?
faq_badgesMonths_a: Kugira ngo buri wese akure ku muvuduko umwe, uko ibimeze kose. Buri kimenyetso kibara amezi y'ikalendari, ntikibara amasaha cyangwa intego. Ukwezi kubarwa rimwe, waba warabwirije iminota mike cyangwa umunsi wose, kandi waba wemeza ko wagize uruhare mu murimo cyangwa wandika amasaha nk'umupayiniya. Ibimenyetso ntibisubira kuri zeru cyangwa ngo bishingire ku mezi akurikirana, bityo kuruhuka kubera uburwayi, ingendo cyangwa igihe kigoye nta cyo bigukuraho; ukwezi gukurikira ugize uruhare mu murimo kurabarwa. Urukurikirane rwawe ni urundi kandi ntirwigera rugira ingaruka ku bimenyetso byawe. Umwaka wose ubara imyaka y'umurimo ifite nibura amezi 10 yo kugira uruhare mu murimo, bityo amezi abiri utagiyemo mu mwaka w'umurimo ntabarwa nabi. Kubera ko buri kwezi kubarwa rimwe gusa, urwego rwo hejuru, Imaragarita, rumara imyaka. Ni ko bigenewe.
faq_badgesCollections_q: Buri kimenyetso kibara iki, kandi kuki ukwezi kutabaruwe?
faq_badgesCollections_a: Gutangaza Ubutumwa Bwiza kibara amezi wandikiyemo igihe cyangwa wemeje ko wagize uruhare mu murimo. Umwaka wose kibara imyaka y'umurimo ifite nibura amezi 10 nk'ayo. Raporo zoherejwe kibara amezi raporo yayo wayohereje uvuye muri WitnessWork cyangwa wemeje ko yamaze koherezwa. Witeguye kibara amezi afite Gahunda, umunsi wa Gahunda ugeze. Amagambo meza kibara amezi afite gusura aho waganiriye n'umuntu; gusura Ntari mu rugo ntibibarwa. Gusubira gusura kibara amezi wasubiyemo gusura umuntu wari warasuye mbere. Ubutaha kibara amezi afite Gusubirayo gufite ingingo. Kuguma mu itumanaho kibara amezi menshi atandukanye waganiriyemo n'umuntu umwe, imbonankubone, kuri telefoni cyangwa mu rwandiko. Babiri babiri kibara amezi mugenzi yagiye nawe muri Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo, kandi kigaragara gusa aho Buddies iboneka. Niba ukwezi kutabaruwe: amasaha yimuwe n'uburyo bwo kwimura ntabarwa wenyine, Gahunda ibarwa gusa umunsi wayo ugeze, kandi Babiri babiri bisaba mugenzi wasubije Ndagenda. Ibimenyetso by'inshuro imwe bigaragaza ibya mbere: icyigisho cyawe cya mbere cya Bibiliya, na mugenzi wawe wa mbere.
faq_badgesBuddies_q: Bagenzi banjye babona iki, ibisubizo bikora bite, kandi nahagarika nte gusangiza ibimenyetso cyangwa imenyesha ryabyo?
faq_badgesBuddies_a: Bagenzi bawe babona ibimenyetso ufite, buri kimwe ku rwego rwacyo rwo hejuru, iyo bafunguye urupapuro rwawe muri Buddies. Ntibigera babona iterambere ryawe, imibare, amatariki, cyangwa ibimenyetso utaragira. Mu buryo bwo kurinda amakuru, Icyigisho cya mbere cya Bibiliya ntigisangizwa. Kugira ngo uhagarike gusangiza ibimenyetso, zimya Ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Iyo mugenzi abonye ikimenyetso gishya, ubona imenyesha ririmo izina rye n'ikimenyetso, nka “Levi yabonye ikimenyetso” hamwe na “Umwaka wose, Ifeza” hepfo yaryo; rikande kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwe. Ubona imenyesha rimwe gusa kuri buri mugenzi ku munsi, kandi ibimenyetso bikurikira uwo munsi biza bucece mu nzogera y'amamenyesha. Ibimenyetso byabonetse mu mateka yinjijwe cyangwa yagaruwe, n'ibimenyetso by'inshuro imwe, ntibitangazwa. Kugira ngo ukomeze mugenzi mu mutima, fungura urupapuro rwe muri Buddies, ukande kimwe mu bimenyetso bye, maze uhitemo igisubizo: 🎉, 🎊, 🔥, 👏, 👍, cyangwa 🙌. Ushobora gusubiza kuri buri kimenyetso rimwe; guhitamo ikindi gisubizo gisimbuza icya mbere. Uwo mugenzi gusa ni we ubona uwasubije, kandi nta kindi cyoherezwa: nta butumwa, kandi nta bimenyetso byawe. Niba nta interineti, igisubizo cyawe cyoherezwa usubiye kuri interineti. Iyo mugenzi asubije ku kimenyetso cyawe, ubona imenyesha nka “Anna yasubije 🔥 ku kimenyetso cyawe,” rimwe gusa kuri buri mugenzi ku munsi, kandi igisubizo kigaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha no mu gihe ufunguye icyo kimenyetso. Kugira ngo uhagarike imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso bishya n'ibisubizo kuri igikoresho, zimya Imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies; byombi biracyagaragara mu nzogera y'amamenyesha. Iyo Erekana ibimenyetso izimye, ntushobora gusubiza, kandi ibisubizo ku bimenyetso byawe ntibigaragara.
faq_badgesBuddyNews_q: Ibimenyetso bishya n'ibisubizo bya bagenzi banjye bigaragara he?
faq_badgesBuddyNews_a: Mu nzogera y'amamenyesha iri kuri Ahabanza, munsi ya Ibivuye kuri bagenzi bawe, munsi y'ikintu cyose gitegereje igisubizo cyawe. Ikimenyetso gishya cya mugenzi cyerekana ikimenyetso gifite ibisubizo bitandatu: 🎉, 🎊, 🔥, 👏, 👍, na 🙌. Kanda kimwe kugira ngo umukomeze mu mutima ako kanya. Nyuma yaho, umurongo werekana ibyo wohereje; kanda Hindura kugira ngo uhitemo ikindi. Kanda umurongo cyangwa ikimenyetso cyawo kugira ngo ukibone ku ecran yose, kiranzwe Gishya niba utari wakibonye. Ibimenyetso byinshi bya mugenzi umwe mu munsi umwe bisangira umurongo umwe. Iyo mugenzi asubije ku kimenyetso cyawe, kikande kugira ngo ufungure ikimenyetso cyawe hamwe n'ibisubizo bya buri mugenzi. Amakuru ya bagenzi ntiyongera ku mubare utukura uri ku nzogera cyangwa ku kimenyetso cya porogaramu; akadomo gato ku nzogera bisobanura ko hari ikintu gishya kivuye kuri bagenzi bawe. Rivuga gusa Uyu munsi, Iki cyumweru, cyangwa Mbere, ntirivuga igihe. Rikureho ukoresheje X cyangwa Kuraho byose, cyangwa ureke rikurweho ubwaryo nyuma y'iminsi 30. Rigaragara gusa kuri bagenzi bawe ba none, aho Buddies iboneka hose, kuri iPhone, iPad na Android, kandi gusa mu gihe Erekana ibimenyetso ifunguye. Kugira ngo uhagarike amenyesha ariko ugumane amakuru mu nzogera, zimya Imenyesha ry'ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies. Niba nta interineti, igisubizo cyawe kirabikwa kandi cyoherezwa usubiye kuri interineti. Iyo wowe ubona ikimenyetso gishya kandi usangiza ibimenyetso na bagenzi bawe, ikarita y'Ikimenyetso gishya ivuga uzakibona, nka “Ben na Grace bazakibona.” Kugira ngo uhagarike gusangiza ibimenyetso, zimya Ibimenyetso mu Igenamiterere rya Buddies.
faq_badgesKeep_q: Nshobora gutakaza ibimenyetso byanjye, kubimurira ku gikoresho gishya, cyangwa kubihisha?
faq_badgesKeep_a: Ibimenyetso ni urwibutso: iyo ufite kimwe, kiguma, nubwo wasiba nyuma igihe, gusura cyangwa gahunda biri inyuma yacyo, cyangwa mugenzi akagenda. Iterambere rijya ku rwego rukurikira naryo rirabikwa iyo uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru buvuze gusiba amakuru ya kera. Ibimenyetso byawe bihuzwa hagati y'ibikoresho byawe na iCloud Sync kandi bishyirwa muri dosiye z'ububiko, bityo kugarura ububiko kuri telefoni nshya biragarura. Iyo amateka yinjijwe cyangwa yagaruwe agera ku bimenyetso bishya, byongerwa bucece hamwe n'incamake imwe aho kwishimirwa kimwe kimwe. Kugira ngo uhishe ibimenyetso, fungura Igenamiterere → Amahitamo → Umwirondoro maze uzimye Erekana ibimenyetso. Ibyo bibihisha hose, harimo no kuri bagenzi bawe no mu byishimo, nta kubyibagirwa; ubifunguye bwongera bikagaruka.

onboardingBuddies_description: Huza n'abantu bagera kuri batanu mujyana kubwiriza. Mubone iminsi n'amasaha bya buri wese kuri kalendari yanyu, mutumirane muri Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo, cyangwa musabe kwifatanya muri ibyabo.
onboardingBuddies_private: Birinzwe n'ibanga kuva ku ikorwa kugeza ku isomwa. Amasaha na raporo byawe bigumaho ari ibanga.
onboardingBuddies_private_info: Bagenzi babona izina ryawe, ifoto (si ngombwa) n'ubupayiniya, n'iminsi n'amasaha uteganya kujya kubwiriza. Amasaha yawe, raporo, intego, abantu n'inyandiko bigumaho ari ibanga. Gutumira mugenzi muri Gahunda cyangwa Gusubirayo bisangiza ibisobanuro bigaragaramo. Nta kintu gisangizwa kugeza mwembi mwemeje, kandi ni wowe na bagenzi bawe gusa mushobora kukisoma.
